records.title_en: Stable Randomisation
records.title_cn: 稳定随机化
records.abstract_en: We design a laboratory experiment to identify whether a preference for randomisation defines a stable type across different choice environments. In games and individual decisions, subjects face 20 simultaneous repetitions of the same choice. Subjects can randomise by making different choices across the repetitions. We find that randomisation does define a type that is predictable across domains. A sizeable fraction of individuals randomise in all domains, even in questions that offer a stochastically dominant option. For some mixers, dominated randomisation is responsive to intervention. We explore theoretical foundations for mixing, and find that most preference-based models are unable to accommodate our results.
records.abstract_cn: 我们设计了一个实验室实验，以识别在不同选择环境中，对随机化的偏好是否定义了一种稳定的类型。在博弈和个体决策中，受试者面临20次相同选择的重复。受试者可以通过在不同重复中做出不同选择来进行随机化。我们发现，随机化确实定义了一种在领域间可预测的类型。相当大比例的个体在所有领域都进行随机化，即使在提供随机占优选项的问题中也是如此。对于某些混合者，占优随机化对干预有反应。我们探索了混合的理论基础，并发现大多数基于偏好的模型无法容纳我们的结果。

records.title_en: Partitioned Pricing and Collusion on Surcharges
records.title_cn: 分项定价与附加费合谋
records.abstract_en: Partitioned pricing is a pricing practice that divides the price of a product into a base price and one or more mandatory surcharges. This paper develops a theory of partitioned pricing using a duopoly model where the owner of each firm determines the surcharge, but delegates the setting of the base price to a manager. In equilibrium, both firms choose partitioned pricing over the conventional all-inclusive pricing. Moreover, partitioned pricing leads to higher full prices and larger profits than all-inclusive pricing. Most surprisingly, collusion on surcharges without any coordination on base prices is as profitable as collusion on all-inclusive prices.
records.abstract_cn: 分项定价是一种将产品价格划分为基础价格和一项或多项强制性附加费的定价做法。本文利用一个双寡头模型发展了分项定价理论，在该模型中，每家企业的所有者决定附加费，但将基础价格的设定委托给经理。在均衡状态下，两家企业都选择分项定价而非传统的全包定价。此外，分项定价导致比全包定价更高的全价和更大的利润。最令人惊讶的是，在没有任何基础价格协调的情况下，对附加费的合谋与对全包价格的合谋一样有利可图。

records.title_en: Does Homeownership Reduce Crime? A Radical Housing Reform from the UK
records.title_cn: 自有住房能否减少犯罪？来自英国的一项激进住房改革
records.abstract_en: ‘Right to Buy’, a large-scale natural experiment whereby incumbent tenants in public housing could buy properties at heavily subsidised prices, increased the United Kingdom homeownership rate by over 10 percentage points between its 1980 introduction and the 1990s. This paper studies the impact of this reform on crime by leveraging exogenous variation in eligibility for the policy. Results show that Right to Buy generated significant property crime reductions. Behavioural changes of incumbent tenants and renovation of public properties were the main drivers of this crime reduction. This is evidence of a novel means by which subsidised homeownership and housing policy can reduce criminality.
records.abstract_cn: “购买权”是一项大规模自然实验，公共住房的现有租户可以以高额补贴价格购买房产，在1980年引入至1990年间，英国自有住房率提高了超过10个百分点。本文通过利用政策资格的外生变化，研究了这项改革对犯罪的影响。结果表明，“购买权”显著减少了财产犯罪。现有租户的行为变化和公共房产的翻新是犯罪减少的主要驱动因素。这为补贴性自有住房和住房政策可以减少犯罪提供了一种新途径的证据。

records.title_en: Gender Differences in Reference Letters: Evidence from the Economics Job Market
records.title_cn: 推荐信中的性别差异：来自经济学就业市场的证据
records.abstract_en: Academia, and economics in particular, faces increased scrutiny because of gender imbalance. This paper studies the job market for entry-level faculty positions. We employ machine learning methods to analyse gendered patterns in the text of 12,000 reference letters written in support of over 3,700 candidates. Using both supervised and unsupervised techniques, we document widespread differences in the attributes emphasised. Women are systematically more likely to be described using ‘grindstone’ terms and at times less likely to be praised for their ability. Using information on initial placement, we highlight the implications of these gendered descriptors for the quality of academic placement.
records.abstract_cn: 学术界，尤其是经济学领域，因性别失衡而面临越来越多的审视。本文研究了初级教职岗位的就业市场。我们采用机器学习方法分析了超过3,700名候选人的12,000封推荐信文本中的性别模式。通过监督和无监督技术，我们记录了所强调特质上的广泛差异。女性更系统性地被描述为使用‘磨盘’类术语，有时较少因能力而受到赞扬。利用初始就业信息，我们强调了这些性别描述词对学术就业质量的影响。

records.title_en: Trade-Offs of Attending Better Schools: Achievement, Self-Perceptions and Educational Trajectories
records.title_cn: 就读更好学校的权衡：学业成就、自我认知与教育轨迹
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impacts of attending better middle schools on the test scores, on-time graduation, self-reported socio-emotional skills, aspirations and high school track choices of marginally admitted students. A regression discontinuity design comparing students just above and below the admission threshold to higher-achieving middle schools in Mexico shows some modest gains on externally graded tests, but adverse effects on grade point average and on-time graduation. By the end of middle school, marginally admitted students feel academically inferior to their peers, obtain worse scores on measures of conscientiousness, and are more likely to shift their aspirations and subsequent schooling choices from academic to vocational programmes. The results are consistent with the hypothesis that unfavourable peer comparisons, stemming from direct observation or subjective teacher assessments, can be sufficiently important to affect students’ educational trajectories.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了就读更好的中学对边缘录取学生的考试成绩、按时毕业、自我报告的社会情感技能、抱负和高中轨道选择的影响。一项回归不连续设计比较了墨西哥更高成就中学录取分数线上下附近的学生，结果显示在外部评分测试中有些适度收益，但对平均绩点和按时毕业有不利影响。到中学结束时，边缘录取学生感到在学业上不如同龄人，在尽责性测量上得分更差，并且更可能将他们的抱负和后续教育选择从学术转向职业项目。结果与以下假设一致：不利的同龄人比较，源于直接观察或主观教师评估，可能足以影响学生的教育轨迹。

records.title_en: Effects and Mechanisms of CEO Quality in Public Education
records.title_cn: 公立教育中CEO质量的影响与机制
records.abstract_en: ‘CEOs’ of public schools in many countries have authority and responsibilities that can greatly affect the quality of schooling. This paper estimates the impact of CEOs on student outcomes in Israeli elementary schools. We estimate CEO quality in two ways—once using schools that do not switch CEOs and once using schools that do. We show that switches are exogenous and are not correlated with potential outcomes. CEO quality positively affects students’ test scores and behavioural outcomes, with pronounced effects for disadvantaged schools. Potential mechanisms show that high-quality CEOs lead to improvements in school priorities, working procedures and violence reduction.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多国家，公立学校的‘CEO’拥有极大的权力和责任，这些权力和责任可能对教育质量产生重大影响。本文估算了以色列小学中CEO对学生成绩的影响。我们通过两种方式估算CEO质量——一种使用未更换CEO的学校，另一种使用更换CEO的学校。我们表明，更换CEO是外生的，且与潜在结果不相关。CEO质量对学生考试成绩和行为结果产生积极影响，对弱势学校的影响尤为显著。潜在机制表明，高质量的CEO能够改善学校优先事项、工作流程并减少暴力。

records.title_en: Do Conditional Cash Transfers Improve Economic Outcomes in the Next Generation? Evidence from Mexico
records.title_cn: 有条件现金转移支付能否改善下一代的经济成果？来自墨西哥的证据
records.abstract_en: Conditional cash transfer programmes have spread to over 60 countries in the past two decades, but little is known about their long-term effects. We estimate the lasting impact of childhood exposure to the Mexico’s flagship programme Progresa by leveraging the age structure of benefits and geographic variation in early programme penetration nationwide. Childhood exposure improves women’s outcomes in early adulthood with increases in educational attainment, geographic mobility, labour market performance and household living standards. For men, effects are smaller and more difficult to distinguish from spatial convergence.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去二十年中，有条件现金转移支付项目已扩展到超过60个国家，但对其长期影响知之甚少。我们利用福利的年龄结构和全国范围内早期项目渗透的地理差异，估计了儿童时期接触墨西哥旗舰项目Progresa的持久影响。儿童时期的接触改善了女性成年早期的成果，包括教育程度、地理流动性、劳动力市场表现和家庭生活水平的提高。对于男性而言，影响较小且更难与空间趋同区分开来。

records.title_en: A Behavioural Theory of Discrimination in Policing
records.title_cn: 警务歧视的行为理论
records.abstract_en: A large economic literature studies whether racial disparities in policing are explained by animus or by beliefs about group crime rates. But what if these beliefs are incorrect? We analyse a model where officers form beliefs using crime statistics, but do not properly account for the fact that they will detect more crime in more heavily policed communities. This creates a feedback loop where officers over-police groups that they (incorrectly) believe exhibit high crime rates. This inferential mistake can exacerbate discrimination even among officers with no animus and who sincerely believe that disparities are driven by real differences in crime rates.
records.abstract_cn: 大量经济学文献研究警务中的种族差异是由敌意还是对群体犯罪率的信念所解释。但如果这些信念是错误的呢？我们分析了一个模型，其中警官利用犯罪统计形成信念，但没有适当考虑他们将在警务更密集的社区发现更多犯罪这一事实。这创造了一个反馈循环，警官过度监管他们（错误地）认为犯罪率高的群体。这种推断错误即使在那些没有敌意且真诚相信差异是由犯罪率真实差异驱动的警官中，也可能加剧歧视。

records.title_en: Preheating Prosocial Behaviour
records.title_cn: 预热亲社会行为
records.abstract_en: We provide new evidence on motivations for voluntary contributions to public goods in a natural setting. Using natural language processing on users’ Twitter posts, we measure revealed sentiment changes before and after making a donation to Wikipedia. We find strong evidence that sentiment improves in the hour and minutes directly before contributing, which we call ‘preheating’. Results are robust to alternative fixed effects and approaches to inference and supported by a complementary online experiment with randomised mood inducement among Twitter users. Preheating suggests that affective states influence giving in addition to reward-seeking, utility-maximising behaviour that has been documented in other contexts.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了在自然环境中自愿贡献公共物品动机的新证据。通过对用户在Twitter上的帖子进行自然语言处理，我们测量了在向维基百科捐款前后揭示的情绪变化。我们发现强有力的证据表明，在直接贡献前的一小时和几分钟内，情绪有所改善，我们称之为“预热”。结果对于替代固定效应和推断方法具有稳健性，并得到了一项在Twitter用户中进行随机情绪诱导的补充在线实验的支持。预热表明，情感状态影响给予行为，此外还有在其他情境中记录到的寻求奖励、效用最大化的行为。

records.title_en: Regret‐Minimizing Project Choice
records.title_cn: 最小化遗憾的项目选择
records.abstract_en: An agent observes the set of available projects and proposes some, but not necessarily all, of them. A principal chooses one or none from the proposed set. We solve for a mechanism that minimizes the principal's worst‐case regret. We compare the single‐project environment in which the agent can propose only one project with the multiproject environment in which he can propose many. In both environments, if the agent proposes one project, it is chosen for sure if the principal's payoff is sufficiently high; otherwise, the probability that it is chosen decreases in the agent's payoff. In the multiproject environment, the agent's payoff from proposing multiple projects equals his maximal payoff from proposing each project alone. The multiproject environment outperforms the single‐project one by providing better fallback options than rejection and by delivering this payoff to the agent more efficiently.
records.abstract_cn: 一个代理人观察可用的项目集合，并提出其中一些，但不一定是全部。委托人从提议的集合中选择一个或一个都不选。我们求解了一个最小化委托人最坏情况遗憾的机制。我们比较了代理人只能提议一个项目的单项目环境和他可以提议多个项目的多项目环境。在两种环境中，如果代理人提议一个项目，当委托人的收益足够高时，该项目肯定会被选中；否则，该项目被选中的概率随代理人的收益增加而降低。在多项目环境中，代理人提议多个项目的收益等于他单独提议每个项目所获得的最大收益。多项目环境通过提供比拒绝更好的后备选项，并更有效地向代理人传递这一收益，从而优于单项目环境。

records.title_en: Selection Into Credit Markets: Evidence From Agriculture in Mali
records.title_cn: 信贷市场的选择：来自马里农业的证据
records.abstract_en: We use a two‐stage experiment on agricultural lending in Mali to test whether selection into lending is predictive of heterogeneous returns to capital. Understanding this heterogeneity, and the selection process which reveals it, is critical for guiding modeling of credit markets in developing countries, as well as for policy. We find such heterogeneity: returns to capital are higher for farmers who borrow than for those who do not. In our first stage, we offer loans in some villages and not others. In the second stage, we provide cash grants to a random subset of all farmers in villages where no loans were offered, and to a random subset of the farmers who do not borrow in villages where loans were offered. We estimate seasonal returns to the grant of 130% for would‐be borrowers, whereas we find returns near zero for the sample representative of non‐borrowers. We also provide evidence that there are some farmers—particularly those that are poor at baseline—that have high returns but do not receive a loan.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用马里农业贷款的两阶段实验来检验贷款选择是否能预测资本回报的异质性。理解这种异质性以及揭示它的选择过程，对于指导发展中国家信贷市场的建模以及政策制定至关重要。我们发现存在这种异质性：借款农民的资本回报高于不借款的农民。在第一阶段，我们在一些村庄提供贷款，而在其他村庄不提供。在第二阶段，我们向未提供贷款村庄的所有农民中的随机子集提供现金赠款，并向提供贷款村庄中不借款的农民中的随机子集提供现金赠款。我们估计潜在借款人的赠款季节性回报为130%，而对于非借款人代表性样本，我们发现回报接近于零。我们还提供证据表明，有些农民——特别是那些基线时贫困的农民——具有高回报但未获得贷款。

records.title_en: Infinite Debt Rollover in Stochastic Economies
records.title_cn: 随机经济中的无限债务滚动
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that there is more scope for a borrower to engage in a sustainable infinite debt rollover (a “Ponzi scheme”) when interest/growth rates are stochastic. In this context, I prove that the relevant “r vs. g” comparison uses the yield r long to an infinite‐maturity zero‐coupon bond. I show that r long is lower than the risk‐neutral expectation of the short‐term yield when it is variable, and that r long is close to the minimal realization of the short‐term yield when it is highly persistent. The paper applies these results to illustrative heterogeneous agent dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models to obtain similarly weakened sufficient conditions for the existence of public debt bubbles.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，当利率/增长率是随机的时，借款人进行可持续的无限债务滚动（“庞氏骗局”）的空间更大。在此背景下，我证明了相关的“r与g”比较使用的是长期零息债券的收益率r long。我表明，当短期收益率可变时，r long低于其风险中性预期，并且当短期收益率高度持久时，r long接近其最小实现值。本文将这些结果应用于说明性的异质主体动态随机一般均衡模型，以获得类似的放宽的公共债务泡沫存在的充分条件。

records.title_en: The Investment Effects of Market Integration: Evidence From Renewable Energy Expansion in Chile
records.title_cn: 市场一体化的投资效应：来自智利可再生能源扩张的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the investment effects of market integration on renewable energy expansion. Our theory highlights that market integration not only improves allocative efficiency by gains from trade but also incentivizes new investment in renewable power plants. To test our theoretical predictions, we examine how recent grid expansions in the Chilean electricity market changed electricity production, wholesale prices, generation costs, and renewable investments. We then build a structural model of power plant entry to quantify the impact of market integration with and without the investment effects. We find that the market integration in Chile increased solar generation by around 180%, saved generation costs by 8%, and reduced carbon emissions by 5%. A substantial amount of renewable entry would not have occurred in the absence of market integration. Our findings suggest that ignoring these investment effects would substantially understate the benefits of market integration and its important role in expanding renewable energy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了市场一体化对可再生能源扩张的投资效应。我们的理论强调，市场一体化不仅通过贸易收益提高配置效率，还激励对可再生能源发电厂的新投资。为检验我们的理论预测，我们考察了智利电力市场近期的电网扩张如何改变电力生产、批发价格、发电成本和可再生能源投资。然后，我们构建了一个发电厂进入的结构模型，以量化在有和没有投资效应的情况下市场一体化的影响。我们发现，智利的市场一体化使太阳能发电量增加了约180%，节省了8%的发电成本，并减少了5%的碳排放。如果没有市场一体化，大量可再生能源的进入将不会发生。我们的研究结果表明，忽视这些投资效应将大大低估市场一体化的收益及其在扩大可再生能源方面的重要作用。

records.title_en: What Can Time‐Series Regressions Tell Us About Policy Counterfactuals?
records.title_cn: 时间序列回归能告诉我们关于政策反事实的什么？
records.abstract_en: We show that, in a general family of linearized structural macroeconomic models, knowledge of the empirically estimable causal effects of contemporaneous and news shocks to the prevailing policy rule is sufficient to construct counterfactuals under alternative policy rules. If the researcher is willing to postulate a loss function, our results furthermore allow her to recover an optimal policy rule for that loss. Under our assumptions, the derived counterfactuals and optimal policies are robust to the Lucas critique. We then discuss strategies for applying these insights when only a limited amount of empirical causal evidence on policy shock transmission is available.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，在一族一般的线性化结构宏观经济模型中，对现行政策规则下的同期冲击和新闻冲击的可经验估计的因果效应的了解，足以构建替代政策规则下的反事实。如果研究者愿意设定一个损失函数，我们的结果还允许她恢复该损失的最优政策规则。在我们的假设下，推导出的反事实和最优政策对卢卡斯批判是稳健的。然后，我们讨论了当仅有有限的经验因果证据关于政策冲击传导时应用这些见解的策略。

records.title_en: Monitoring versus Discounting in Repeated Games
records.title_cn: 重复博弈中的监督与贴现
records.abstract_en: We study how discounting and monitoring jointly determine whether cooperation is possible in repeated games with imperfect (public or private) monitoring. Our main result provides a simple bound on the strength of players' incentives as a function of discounting, monitoring precision, and on‐path payoff variance. We show that the bound is tight in the low‐discounting/low‐monitoring double limit, by establishing a public‐monitoring folk theorem where the discount factor and the monitoring structure can vary simultaneously.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在具有不完美（公开或私人）监督的重复博弈中，贴现和监督如何共同决定合作是否可能。我们的主要结果提供了一个关于玩家激励强度的简单界限，该界限是贴现、监督精度和路径上收益方差的函数。我们通过建立一个公开监督的民间定理，其中贴现因子和监督结构可以同时变化，证明了该界限在低贴现/低监督的双重极限下是紧的。

records.title_en: Mitigating Disaster Risks in the Age of Climate Change
records.title_cn: 气候变化时代减轻灾害风险
records.abstract_en: Emissions abatement alone cannot address the consequences of global warming for weather disasters. We model how society adapts to manage disaster risks to capital stock. Optimal adaptation—a mix of firm‐level efforts and public spending—varies as society learns about the adverse consequences of global warming for disaster arrivals. Taxes on capital are needed alongside those on carbon to achieve the first best. We apply our model to country‐level control of flooding from tropical cyclones. Learning rationalizes empirical findings, including the responses of Tobin's q , equity risk premium, and risk‐free rate to disaster arrivals. Adaptation is more valuable under learning than a counterfactual no‐learning environment. Learning alters social‐cost‐of‐carbon projections due to the interaction of uncertainty resolution and endogenous adaptive response.
records.abstract_cn: 仅靠减排无法解决全球变暖对天气灾害的影响。我们模拟了社会如何适应管理资本存量的灾害风险。最优适应——企业层面努力与公共支出的组合——随着社会了解全球变暖对灾害发生的负面影响而变化。除了碳税，还需要对资本征税以实现最优。我们将模型应用于国家层面热带气旋洪水的控制。学习使实证发现合理化，包括托宾q、股权风险溢价和无风险利率对灾害发生的反应。在学习环境下，适应比反事实的无学习环境更有价值。由于不确定性解决与内生适应性反应的相互作用，学习改变了社会碳成本预测。

records.title_en: Platform Design When Sellers Use Pricing Algorithms
records.title_cn: 当卖家使用定价算法时的平台设计
records.abstract_en: We investigate the ability of a platform to design its marketplace to promote competition, improve consumer surplus, and increase its own payoff. We consider demand‐steering rules that reward firms that cut prices with additional exposure to consumers. We examine the impact of these rules both in theory and by using simulations with artificial intelligence pricing algorithms (specifically Q‐learning algorithms, which are commonly used in computer science). Our theoretical results indicate that these policies (which require little information to implement) can have strongly beneficial effects, even when sellers are infinitely patient and seek to collude. Similarly, our simulations suggest that platform design can benefit consumers and the platform, but that achieving these gains may require policies that condition on past behavior and treat sellers in a nonneutral fashion. These more sophisticated policies disrupt the ability of algorithms to rotate demand and split industry profits, leading to low prices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了平台设计其市场以促进竞争、改善消费者剩余并增加自身收益的能力。我们考虑了需求引导规则，这些规则奖励降价企业以额外的消费者曝光。我们在理论上和使用人工智能定价算法（特别是计算机科学中常用的Q学习算法）的模拟中检验了这些规则的影响。我们的理论结果表明，这些政策（实施所需信息很少）可以产生强烈的有益效果，即使卖家无限耐心并试图合谋。同样，我们的模拟表明，平台设计可以使消费者和平台受益，但实现这些收益可能需要基于过去行为并以非中立方式对待卖家的政策。这些更复杂的政策破坏了算法轮换需求和分配行业利润的能力，导致低价格。

records.title_en: The Macro Impact of Short‐Termism
records.title_cn: 短期主义的宏观影响
records.abstract_en: R&D investment reduces current profits, so short‐term pressure to hit profit targets may distort R&D. In the data, firms just meeting Wall Street forecasts have lower R&D growth and subsequent innovation, while managers just missing receive lower pay. But short‐termist distortions might not quantitatively matter if aggregation or equilibrium dampen their impact. So I build and estimate a quantitative endogenous growth model in which short‐termism arises naturally as discipline on conflicted managers and boosts firm value by about 1%. But short‐termism reduces R&D, and the social return to R&D is higher than the private return due to standard channels including knowledge spillovers and imperfect competition. So at the macro level, short‐termist distortions slow growth by 5 basis points yearly and lower social welfare by about 1%.
records.abstract_cn: 研发投资会减少当前利润，因此实现利润目标的短期压力可能会扭曲研发。在数据中，刚好达到华尔街预测的公司研发增长和后续创新较低，而刚好未达标的经理人薪酬较低。但短期主义扭曲可能不会在数量上产生重要影响，如果加总或均衡削弱了它们的影响。因此，我构建并估计了一个定量内生增长模型，其中短期主义自然产生于对冲突经理人的约束，并使企业价值提高约1%。但短期主义减少了研发，而研发的社会回报高于私人回报，原因包括知识溢出和不完全竞争等标准渠道。因此，在宏观层面，短期主义扭曲使年增长率降低5个基点，并使社会福利降低约1%。

records.title_en: The Power of Certainty: Experimental Evidence on the Effective Design of Free Tuition Programs
records.title_cn: 确定性的力量：免费学费项目有效设计的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Proposed “free college” policies vary widely in design. The simplest set tuition to zero for everyone. More targeted approaches limit free tuition to those who demonstrate need through an application process. We experimentally test the effects of these two models on the schooling decisions of low-income students. An unconditional free tuition offer from a large public university substantially increases application and enrollment rates. A free tuition offer contingent on proof of need has a much smaller effect on application and none on enrollment. These results are consistent with students placing a high value on financial certainty when making schooling decisions. (JEL H52, H75, I22, I23, I28, I32)
records.abstract_cn: 拟议中的“免费大学”政策在设计上差异很大。最简单的做法是将所有人的学费设为零。更有针对性的方法是通过申请程序，将免费学费限制在那些证明有需要的学生。我们通过实验检验了这两种模式对低收入学生求学决策的影响。一所大型公立大学提供的无条件免费学费大幅提高了申请率和入学率。而附带经济需求证明条件的免费学费对申请的影响要小得多，对入学则没有影响。这些结果与学生在做出求学决策时高度重视财务确定性是一致的。（JEL H52, H75, I22, I23, I28, I32）

records.title_en: A Characterization for Optimal Bundling of Products with Nonadditive Values
records.title_cn: 非加性价值产品最优捆绑销售的特征化描述
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the optimal bundling of products with nonadditive values. Under monotonic preferences and single-peaked profits, I show that a monopolist finds pure bundling optimal if and only if the optimal sales volume for the grand bundle is larger than the optimal sales volume for any smaller bundle. I then detail how my analysis relates to ratio monotonicity results on bundling and describe the implications for nonlinear pricing. (JEL D21, D42, L12, L25)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有非加性价值的产品的最优捆绑销售问题。在单调偏好和单峰利润条件下，我证明了垄断者认为纯捆绑销售是最优的，当且仅当大捆绑的最优销售量大于任何较小捆绑的最优销售量。随后，我详细阐述了我的分析与捆绑销售中的比率单调性结果之间的关系，并描述了其对非线性定价的启示。（JEL D21, D42, L12, L25）

records.title_en: Reducing Frictions in Health Care Access: The ActionHealthNYC Experiment for Undocumented Immigrants
records.title_cn: 减少医疗保健获取中的摩擦：针对无证移民的ActionHealthNYC实验
records.abstract_en: In 2016, New York City designed and implemented an intervention to reduce frictions in accessing safety net care: randomly making initial primary care appointments for 2,428 undocumented immigrants. We leverage a novel survey-administrative data linkage to show that the program increased self-reported access to primary care, leading to 23 percent fewer emergency department (ED) visits. High-risk individuals’ ED visits fell by 32 percent on average, driving the aggregate effect. Preventive care also increased among individuals visiting sponsored clinics. (JEL H75, I11, I12, I13, I14, I18, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 在2016年，纽约市设计并实施了一项干预措施，以减少获取安全网护理的摩擦：随机为2,428名无证移民安排初次初级保健预约。我们利用一项新颖的调查-行政数据关联表明，该计划增加了自我报告的初级保健获取，导致急诊科就诊次数减少了23%。高风险个体的急诊就诊平均减少了32%，推动了总体效应。在赞助诊所就诊的个体中，预防性护理也有所增加。（JEL H75, I11, I12, I13, I14, I18, J15）

records.title_en: A Minimalist Model for the Ruble during the Russian Invasion of Ukraine
records.title_cn: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间卢布的极简模型
records.abstract_en: This note isolates an overlooked economic force for the ruble to appreciate in response to international sanctions limiting exports to Russia. The intuition is that when Russians are unable to buy the mix of foreign goods they wish, foreign goods become less attractive, increasing demand for domestic goods. To reestablish an equilibrium, a real appreciation is needed to raise the relative price of domestic goods and incentivize imports from nonsanctioning countries. We also review well-known forces for depreciation. Our analysis emphasizes that the exchange rate is an inadequate signal of the welfare impact and of the effectiveness of sanctions. (JEL D74, E31, F14, F31, F51, P24, P33)
records.abstract_cn: 本文揭示了一个被忽视的经济力量，即国际制裁限制对俄出口时，卢布会升值。其直觉是，当俄罗斯人无法购买他们想要的外国商品组合时，外国商品的吸引力下降，从而增加了对国内商品的需求。为了重新建立均衡，需要实际升值以提高国内商品的相对价格，并激励从非制裁国家的进口。我们还回顾了众所周知的贬值力量。我们的分析强调，汇率并不能充分反映制裁的福利影响和有效性。（JEL D74, E31, F14, F31, F51, P24, P33）

records.title_en: Decision Theory and Stochastic Growth
records.title_cn: 决策理论与随机增长
records.abstract_en: This paper examines connections between stochastic growth and decision problems. We use tools from the theory of large deviations to show that wishful thinking decision problems are equivalent to utility maximization problems, both of which are equivalent to growth maximization under idiosyncratic risk. Rational inattention problems are equivalent to growth-optimal portfolio problems, both of which are equivalent to growth maximization under aggregate risk. Stochastic growth generates extreme inequality, with nearly all wealth eventually held by those who happen to have faced empirical distributions that match the solution to the wishful thinking or rational inattention problem. (JEL D31, D81, D82, D83, G51, O41)
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了随机增长与决策问题之间的联系。我们利用大偏差理论的工具来证明，一厢情愿的决策问题等价于效用最大化问题，而这两者又等价于在特质风险下的增长最大化问题。理性疏忽问题等价于增长最优投资组合问题，而这两者又等价于在总体风险下的增长最大化问题。随机增长会产生极端的不平等，最终几乎所有财富都由那些恰好面临的经验分布与一厢情愿或理性疏忽问题的解相匹配的人持有。(JEL D31, D81, D82, D83, G51, O41)

records.title_en: The Educational Consequences of Remote and Hybrid Instruction during the Pandemic
records.title_cn: 疫情期间远程与混合教学的教育后果
records.abstract_en: Using testing data from over two million students in nearly 10,000 schools in 49 states (plus the District of Columbia), we investigate the role of remote and hybrid instruction in widening gaps in achievement by race and school poverty. We find that remote instruction was a primary driver of the widening gaps. Math gaps did not widen in areas that remained in person (although reading gaps did). We estimate that high-poverty districts that went remote in 2020–2021 will need to spend nearly all of their federal aid on helping students recover from pandemic-related academic achievement losses. (JEL H75, I12, I21, I24, I32, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 利用来自49个州（外加哥伦比亚特区）近10,000所学校超过两百万名学生的测试数据，我们研究了远程和混合教学在扩大种族和学校贫困成就差距中的作用。我们发现远程教学是差距扩大的主要驱动因素。在保持线下教学的地区，数学差距并未扩大（尽管阅读差距有所扩大）。我们估计，在2020-2021年转为远程教学的高贫困学区将需要将几乎所有的联邦援助用于帮助学生从疫情相关的学业成就损失中恢复。（JEL H75, I12, I21, I24, I32, J15）

records.title_en: The Unequal Consequences of Job Loss across Countries
records.title_cn: 失业后果的跨国不平等性
records.abstract_en: We document the consequences of losing a job across countries using a harmonized research design applied to seven matched employer-employee datasets. Workers in Denmark and Sweden experience the lowest earnings declines following job displacement, while workers in Italy, Spain, and Portugal experience losses three times as high. French and Austrian workers face earnings losses somewhere in between. Key to these differences is that southern European workers are less likely to find employment following displacement. Loss of employer-specific wage premiums explains a substantial portion of wage losses in all countries. (JEL J31, J63, J64)
records.abstract_cn: 我们采用统一的研究设计，应用于七个匹配的雇主-雇员数据集，记录了各国失业的后果。丹麦和瑞典的工人在失业后经历的收入下降最低，而意大利、西班牙和葡萄牙的工人则遭受三倍高的损失。法国和奥地利的工人面临的收入损失介于两者之间。这些差异的关键在于，南欧工人在失业后找到工作的可能性较低。雇主特定工资溢价的损失解释了所有国家工资损失的很大一部分。(JEL J31, J63, J64)

records.title_en: Finance, Managerial Inputs, and Misallocation
records.title_cn: 金融、管理投入与资源错配
records.abstract_en: In standard macrofinance models, financial constraints mainly affect small or young firms but not large or old ones due to the self-financing mechanism, and the dispersion of marginal revenue product of capital (MRPK) of a firm cohort is less persistent than in the data. We extend a standard model by allowing firms to hire managers, and large firms hire disproportionately more managers, consistent with data. In our model, financial constraints and the dispersion of MRPK persist, and even large firms are likely to be constrained. The productivity loss from financial frictions is also substantially amplified. (JEL D24, D25, G32, L25, M10, O16, P31)
records.abstract_cn: 在标准宏观金融模型中，金融约束主要影响小型或年轻企业，而非大型或成熟企业，这得益于自我融资机制，且企业群体的资本边际收益产品（MRPK）离散度比数据中显示的更不持久。我们通过允许企业雇佣管理者来扩展标准模型，大型企业不成比例地雇佣更多管理者，这与数据一致。在我们的模型中，金融约束和MRPK的离散度持续存在，甚至大型企业也可能受到约束。金融摩擦带来的生产率损失也显著放大。（JEL D24, D25, G32, L25, M10, O16, P31）

records.title_en: Agricultural windfalls and the seasonality of political violence in Africa
records.title_cn: 农业意外收益与非洲政治暴力的季节性
records.abstract_en: When the prices of cereal grains rise, social unrest and conflict become likely. In rural areas, the predation motives of perpetrators can explain the positive relationship between prices and conflict. Predation happens at places and in periods where and when spoils to be appropriated are available. In predominantly agrarian societies, such opportune times align with the harvest season. Does the seasonality of agricultural income lead to the seasonality of conflict? We address this question by analyzing over 55 thousand incidents involving violence against civilians staged by paramilitary groups across Africa during the 1997–2020 period. We investigate the crop year pattern of violence in response to agricultural income shocks via changes in international cereal prices. We find that a year‐on‐year one standard deviation annual growth of the price of the major cereal grain results in a harvest‐time spike in violence by militias in areas where this cereal grain is grown. This translates to a nearly 10% increase in violence during the early postharvest season. We observe no such change in violence by state forces or rebel groups—the other two notable actors. By further investigating the mechanisms, we show that the violence by militias is amplified after plausibly rich harvest seasons when the value of spoils to be appropriated is higher. By focusing on harvest‐related seasonality of conflict, as well as actors more likely to be involved in violence against civilians, we contribute to the growing literature on the economic causes of conflict in predominantly agrarian societies.
records.abstract_cn: 当谷类粮食价格上升时，社会动荡和冲突可能发生。在农村地区，施暴者的掠夺动机可以解释价格与冲突之间的正相关关系。掠夺发生在可获得战利品的地点和时期。在主要以农业为主的社会中，这样的时机与收获季节相吻合。农业收入的季节性是否导致冲突的季节性？我们通过分析55-1997年期间非洲发生的超过2020起准军事团体针对平民的暴力事件来探讨这一问题。我们通过国际谷类价格变化来研究农业收入冲击对作物年度暴力模式的影响。我们发现，主要谷类粮食价格的一年同比一个标准差年增长率会导致该谷类种植地区收获季节民兵暴力事件激增。这转化为收获后早期季节暴力事件增加近10%。我们观察到国家军队或反叛团体——另外两个显著行为者——的暴力行为没有此类变化。通过进一步研究机制，我们表明，在可能丰收的季节，当可掠夺战利品价值更高时，民兵暴力行为会加剧。通过关注与收获相关的冲突季节性，以及更可能参与针对平民暴力的行为者，我们为关于以农业为主社会中冲突经济原因的日益增长的文献做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Effectiveness of local regulations on nonpoint source pollution: Evidence from Wisconsin dairy farms
records.title_cn: 地方法规对非点源污染的有效性：来自威斯康星州奶牛场的证据
records.abstract_en: Although the Clean Water Act's regulation of point source pollution has had a significant effect on water quality, nonpoint sources of pollution, especially animal agriculture, remain a leading unevenly regulated source of water pollution in the United States. This work studies the effectiveness of local manure management regulations on dairy farms in Wisconsin. Wisconsin represents a unique policy experiment in the delegation of nonpoint agricultural pollution policy in a state with economically important small, nonpoint, dairy farms. Using hand collected regulatory data from Wisconsin counties we estimate the effects of changes in local regulations on water quality outcomes. The results demonstrate that a few easily implemented and verifiable regulations such as nutrient management plans have significant short‐term effects on water quality, whereas other less observable and difficult to implement regulations have no discernible effects in the short term. The work points to a number of potential policy levers to improve the Management of nonpoint pollution, as well as the challenges of nonpoint source regulatory policies on slow‐moving hydrologic processes.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管《清洁水法》对点源污染的监管对水质产生了显著影响，但非点源污染，尤其是畜牧业，仍然是美国水污染的主要且监管不均的来源。本研究探讨了威斯康星州奶牛场当地粪肥管理法规的有效性。威斯康星州代表了一个独特的政策实验，即在经济上重要的小型非点源奶牛场州中下放非点源农业污染政策。利用从威斯康星州各县手工收集的监管数据，我们估计了地方法规变化对水质结果的影响。结果表明，一些易于实施和验证的法规，如营养管理计划，对水质有显著的短期影响，而其他不太可观察且难以实施的法规在短期内没有明显影响。该研究指出了改善非点源污染管理的若干潜在政策杠杆，以及非点源监管政策在缓慢水文过程中的挑战。

records.title_en: Competition and trade policy in the world cotton market: Implications for US cotton exports
records.title_cn: 世界棉花市场中的竞争与贸易政策：对美国棉花出口的影响
records.abstract_en: Cotton is a cornerstone of global fiber markets, and many importing and exporting countries play important roles in the global cotton market. The US cotton sector has long been one of the world's largest. However, Brazil's cotton production has rapidly grown, and the country has become one of the leading cotton producers, accounting for an ever‐increasing share of world cotton production and trade. This meteoric rise has put Brazil's cotton sector in frequent competition with the United States over export sales and market share. We empirically investigate how the expansion of the Brazilian cotton sector has impacted the US cotton sector's position in world markets by quantifying the extent to which rising Brazilian production has caused reallocations of US exports. We also explore how the recent US–China trade war affected these market dynamics by assessing the impacts of China's retaliatory tariffs on US cotton. Our results show that Brazil's cotton production has caused a major disruption to US cotton exports, resulting in a significant reduction in US exports to large cotton importers such as China, Vietnam, and Pakistan, and that these trends were reversed (at least temporarily) by the US–China trade dispute. By illustrating how competitive forces and trade disputes have shaped recent market dynamics for this key commodity, our work adds to the growing literature examining the interplay between competition and trade policy in the global agricultural sector.
records.abstract_cn: 棉花是全球纤维市场的基石，许多进口国和出口国在全球棉花市场中扮演着重要角色。美国棉花产业长期以来一直是世界上最大的产业之一。然而，巴西的棉花生产迅速增长，该国已成为领先的棉花生产国之一，在全球棉花生产和贸易中所占份额不断增加。这种迅速崛起使巴西棉花产业在出口销售和市场份额方面与美国频繁竞争。我们通过量化巴西棉花产量增长导致美国出口重新分配的程度，实证研究了巴西棉花产业的扩张如何影响美国棉花产业在世界市场中的地位。我们还通过评估中国对美国棉花征收报复性关税的影响，探讨了最近的中美贸易战如何影响这些市场动态。我们的结果表明，巴西的棉花生产对美国棉花出口造成了重大干扰，导致美国对中国、越南和巴基斯坦等大型棉花进口国的出口显著减少，而这些趋势因中美贸易争端而（至少暂时）逆转。通过说明竞争力量和贸易争端如何塑造了这一关键商品近期的市场动态，我们的工作为研究全球农业部门竞争与贸易政策之间相互作用的日益增长的文献做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Grassland tenure reform and grassland quality in China
records.title_cn: 草地使用权改革与中国草地质量
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of land tenure reform on grassland quality in pastoral areas of China. Using nearly 40 years of remote sensing combined with survey data in the pastoral area of China, we find that the privatization of land use rights without physical (i.e., fences) or legal (i.e., certificates) protection has little impact on improving grassland quality measured by the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI). The enhanced privatization of grassland use rights with physical or legal security significantly increases grassland quality. We show that after the privatization of land use rights with security protection, grassland quality experienced about a 3% increase. Our results suggest that switching to privatized use rights without security protection from previously cooperatively managed land may undermine the positive environmental effects of land tenure reform.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了土地使用权改革对中国牧区草地质量的影响。利用中国牧区近40年的遥感数据结合调查数据，我们发现，在没有物理（即围栏）或法律（即证书）保护的情况下，土地使用权私有化对提高以归一化植被指数（NDVI）衡量的草地质量影响甚微。具有物理或法律保障的草地使用权私有化显著提高了草地质量。我们表明，在具有安全保障的使用权私有化之后，草地质量提高了约3%。我们的结果表明，从以前的合作管理土地转向没有安全保障的私有化使用权，可能会削弱土地改革的积极环境效应。

records.title_en: Information rigidities in USDA crop production forecasts
records.title_cn: 美国农业部作物产量预测中的信息刚性
records.abstract_en: USDA invests significant public resources into developing its crop projection reports. These publications inform decisions across the supply chain. Several previous studies find that revisions to the department's production and yield forecasts for major agricultural commodities are positively correlated and conclude that they deviate from what would be observed under rational expectations, possibly due to smoothing on the part of forecasters. Yet correlated revisions may also be explained by information rigidities that cause forecasts to be infrequently or only partially updated. We apply a recently developed test to these USDA revisions for corn, soybeans, and wheat, and find no significant evidence that the forecasts are smoothed strategically. Rather, we show that information rigidities are the more likely culprit, due to production and yield information that is either too costly to obtain or too noisy. Our results demonstrate that data challenges are the main source of inefficiency in USDA projections, and that the department can improve the efficiency of its forecasts by making investments that improve its access to crop data, perhaps through crop‐monitoring satellite and remote sensing technology.
records.abstract_cn: 美国农业部投入大量公共资源用于编制作物预测报告。这些出版物为整个供应链的决策提供信息。此前多项研究发现，该部门对主要农产品产量和单产预测的修正呈正相关，并得出结论认为这些修正偏离了理性预期下应观察到的结果，可能是由于预测者的平滑行为所致。然而，相关修正也可能由信息刚性解释，即预测更新不频繁或仅部分更新。我们将一种近期开发的检验方法应用于美国农业部对玉米、大豆和小麦的修正数据，未发现显著证据表明预测存在策略性平滑。相反，我们表明信息刚性更可能是主要原因，因为获取产量和单产信息的成本过高或噪声过大。我们的结果表明，数据挑战是美国农业部预测效率低下的主要来源，该部门可通过投资改善其获取作物数据的途径（或许通过作物监测卫星和遥感技术）来提高预测效率。

records.title_en: The impacts of cash transfers on household energy choices
records.title_cn: 现金转移对家庭能源选择的影响
records.abstract_en: There are sizeable energy access deficits in the developing world. Leveraging panel data from the experimental impact evaluations of three unconditional cash transfer programs in Malawi and Zambia, we investigate how ultra‐poor households in rural areas adapt their energy portfolios when experiencing exogenous increases in income. Households make several changes to the primary fuel sources that they use on a regular basis after receiving 3 to 4 years of transfers—moving from fires to torches for lighting purposes and reducing collected firewood use for cooking purposes. In general, households are more likely to make income‐induced adjustments to lighting fuels than to cooking fuels. While facilitating some movement away from firewood (arguably the most inferior energy source), the unconditional cash transfers rarely enable households to completely abandon this fuel. This is understandable given the range of pressing needs facing the beneficiary households—such as food security, the enhancement of which is the primary purpose of the transfer programs. Although recipient households are able to meet a greater share of their energy needs with relatively improved fuels (such as charcoal/coal in Zambia) and obtain assets for generating solar power, the observed impacts are unlikely to be large enough to lead to meaningful health impacts (such as lower respiratory disease via reductions in indoor air pollution). However, the cash transfers appear to enhance well‐being in other ways through the energy use channel—for example, by reducing the time households spend foraging for fuel resources.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家存在巨大的能源获取缺口。利用马拉维和赞比亚三个无条件现金转移项目的实验性影响评估的面板数据，我们研究了农村极端贫困家庭在收入外生增加时如何调整其能源组合。在收到3至4年的转移支付后，家庭对其定期使用的主要燃料来源进行了多项调整——从柴火转向手电筒用于照明，并减少采集薪柴用于烹饪。总体而言，家庭更可能对照明燃料而非烹饪燃料进行收入引发的调整。虽然无条件现金转移促进了一定程度上的远离薪柴（可以说是最劣等的能源来源），但很少能使家庭完全放弃这种燃料。考虑到受益家庭面临的诸多紧迫需求——如粮食安全，其改善是转移项目的主要目的——这是可以理解的。尽管受助家庭能够用相对改进的燃料（如赞比亚的木炭/煤炭）满足更大份额的能源需求，并获得用于产生太阳能的资产，但观察到的效应不太可能大到足以带来有意义的健康影响（如通过减少室内空气污染降低呼吸道疾病）。然而，现金转移似乎通过能源使用渠道以其他方式增强了福祉——例如，减少家庭采集燃料资源的时间。

records.title_en: Adapting to water restrictions: Intensive versus extensive adaptation over time differentiated by water right seniority
records.title_cn: 适应水资源限制：基于水权优先性的时间维度上的集约与粗放适应
records.abstract_en: This study explores farmers' adjustments to their water use when faced with water restrictions, distinguishing between intensive and extensive adjustments and examining adaptation over time. Specifically, the study uses a difference‐in‐differences framework to explore the effect of a groundwater restriction on irrigation management strategies. In 1992, the Kansas Department of Agriculture created an Intensive Groundwater Use Control Area to improve streamflow in Walnut Creek, which feeds water to a highly important migration point on the mid‐continent flyway. The program allocates permission to extract groundwater in 5‐year allotments. The stringency of the program's restriction depends on the seniority of the water right. We find significant reductions in water use along the intensive margin for senior water rights and along both the intensive and extensive margins for junior water rights. The results indicate significant reductions in water use that imply negative welfare impacts on farmers. We also find evidence of dynamically optimal behavior within each 5‐year allotment period.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了农民在面对水资源限制时对其用水量的调整，区分了集约调整和粗放调整，并考察了随时间推移的适应情况。具体而言，研究采用双重差分框架来探讨地下水限制对灌溉管理策略的影响。1992年，堪萨斯州农业部设立了集约地下水使用控制区，以改善核桃溪的河流流量，该溪流为大陆中部迁徙路线上的一个极其重要的迁徙点提供水源。该计划以5年为一期分配地下水开采许可。该计划限制的严格程度取决于水权的优先性。我们发现，对于优先水权，用水量在集约边际上显著减少；对于次级水权，在集约边际和粗放边际上均显著减少。结果表明用水量显著减少，这对农民福利产生了负面影响。我们还发现了在每个5年分配期内存在动态最优行为的证据。

records.title_en: New insights into the structure of consumer preferences for natural and artificial sweeteners
records.title_cn: 关于天然和人工甜味剂消费者偏好结构的新见解
records.abstract_en: This study utilizes the Generalized Exact Affine Stone Index demand system to investigate the structure of demand for natural and artificial sweeteners in the United States based on uniquely disaggregate data. Our empirical framework allows for arbitrarily complex Engel curves, unobserved consumer heterogeneity and potential precommitments in sweetener consumption, while addressing price endogeneity. Results from a series of weak separability tests reveal that consumers select from among both sets of natural and artificial sweeteners. In addition, most sweeteners are empirically established to be consumed in precommitted quantities, with the shares thereof varying from 6.3% for molasses to 34.4% for granulated sugar. Based on the unconditional elasticities obtained via a two‐stage budgeting framework, we further examine the implications of hypothetical sweetener tax scenarios for consumer energy intake and bodyweight, as well as assess the consumer welfare consequences thereof.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用广义精确仿射斯通指数需求系统，基于独特的分项数据，考察美国天然和人工甜味剂的需求结构。我们的实证框架允许任意复杂的恩格尔曲线、未观测到的消费者异质性以及甜味剂消费中潜在的预先承诺，同时处理价格内生性问题。一系列弱可分性检验的结果表明，消费者在天然和人工甜味剂两组中均有选择。此外，实证发现大多数甜味剂以预先承诺的数量被消费，其份额从糖蜜的6.3%到砂糖的34.4%不等。基于通过两阶段预算框架获得的无条件弹性，我们进一步考察了假设的甜味剂税收情景对消费者能量摄入和体重的影响，并评估了由此产生的消费者福利后果。

records.title_en: Malaria and economic activity: Evidence from US agriculture
records.title_cn: 疟疾与经济活动：来自美国农业的证据
records.abstract_en: I conduct a disaggregated empirical analysis of the relationship between the reduction in malaria transmission and agricultural development in the United States. Exploiting exogenous geographic variations in malaria‐suitable weather conditions and using historical county data together with a robust quasi‐experimental approach, I show that the farm value per acre of arable land of more endemic counties increased by around eight percentage points after the eradication of the disease relative to less endemic counties. Using historical data on cropland distribution within the United States, I also find that arable land increased in high malaria‐risk areas. Finally, I shed light on the increased productivity of farmers as a potential channel. Robustness checks from geographic variations in malaria prevalence within neighboring counties and placebo treatments reinforce the positive effect of eradicating malaria on agricultural development in the United States.
records.abstract_cn: 我对美国疟疾传播减少与农业发展之间的关系进行了细粒度的实证分析。利用疟疾适宜天气条件的外生地理变异，并结合历史县级数据和稳健的准实验方法，我发现在疾病根除后，相对于疟疾流行程度较低的县，流行程度较高的县每英亩可耕地的农场价值增加了约八个百分点。利用美国境内耕地分布的历史数据，我还发现高风险疟疾地区的可耕地有所增加。最后，我揭示了农民生产力提高作为一个潜在渠道。来自邻近县疟疾患病率地理变异和安慰剂处理的稳健性检验进一步强化了根除疟疾对美国农业发展的积极影响。

records.title_en: The earned income tax credit and food insecurity
records.title_cn: 劳动所得税抵免与食品不安全
records.abstract_en: Although previous work on the earned income tax credit (EITC) has established that the program improves health outcomes of people from lower socioeconomic backgrounds, not much is known about the possible pathways through which higher EITC benefits affect health. This study contributes to the literature by evaluating the role of food insecurity as a mechanism underlying the relationship between the EITC and health. Using the 2009 federal EITC expansion, which increased benefit generosity for eligible families with three or more children, I estimate difference‐in‐differences (DD) and difference‐in‐difference‐in‐differences (DDD) models to evaluate whether the policy change is associated with improvements in food security. My analysis finds that the program expansion, which increased predicted annual EITC benefits by $496, is associated with a reduction in the likelihood of experiencing food insecurity by 8.1% for low‐educated households with three children. The observed improvements in food security are larger for non‐married households, a group that has previously been shown to be strongly affected by EITC changes. An evaluation of variations in state‐level EITC laws provides further indication that more generous benefits reduce food insecurity. The results, which are robust to estimating several alternative specifications, provide evidence that higher EITC benefits improve the well‐being of low‐income households by reducing food insecurity.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管先前关于劳动所得税抵免（EITC）的研究已确立该计划改善了社会经济背景较低人群的健康结果，但关于更高的EITC福利影响健康的可能途径知之甚少。本研究通过评估食品不安全作为EITC与健康之间关系的一个机制的作用，为文献做出贡献。利用2009年联邦EITC扩展，该扩展增加了有三个或更多子女的合格家庭的福利慷慨度，我估计了双重差分（DD）和三重差分（DDD）模型，以评估政策变化是否与食品安全的改善相关。我的分析发现，该计划扩展（预计年度EITC福利增加496美元）与有三个孩子的低教育家庭经历食品不安全的可能性降低8.1%相关。观察到的食品安全改善在非已婚家庭中更大，这一群体先前已被证明受EITC变化影响强烈。对州级EITC法律变化的评估进一步表明，更慷慨的福利减少了食品不安全。这些结果在估计多种替代规格时稳健，提供了更高EITC福利通过减少食品不安全来改善低收入家庭福祉的证据。

records.title_en: Work from Home before and after the COVID-19 Outbreak
records.title_cn: COVID-19疫情前后的居家办公
records.abstract_en: Based on novel survey data, we document a persistent rise in work from home (WFH) over the course of the COVID-19 pandemic. Using theory and direct survey evidence, we argue that three-quarters of this increase reflects the adoption of new work arrangements that will likely be permanent for many workers. A quantitative model matched to survey data predicts that twice as many workers will WFH full-time postpandemic compared to prepandemic, and that one in every five instead of seven workdays will be WFH. These model predictions are consistent with survey evidence on workers’ own expectations about WFH in the future. (JEL I12, I18, J22, M54)
records.abstract_cn: 基于新颖的调查数据，我们记录了在COVID-19疫情期间居家办公（WFH）的持续上升。利用理论和直接调查证据，我们认为这一增长的四分之三反映了新工作安排的采用，这些安排对许多工人来说可能是永久性的。与调查数据匹配的定量模型预测，疫情后全职居家办公的工人数量将是疫情前的两倍，并且每五个工作日中有一个（而非每七个工作日中有一个）将在家办公。这些模型预测与工人对未来居家办公期望的调查证据一致。（JEL I12, I18, J22, M54）

records.title_en: Product Variety, the Cost of Living, and Welfare across Countries
records.title_cn: 产品多样性、生活成本与跨国福利
records.abstract_en: We use the structure of the Melitz (2003) model to compute the cost of living and welfare across 47 countries, and compare these to conventional measures of prices and real consumption from the International Comparisons Project (ICP). The cost of living is inferred without directly using ICP prices of traded goods and instead relying on output prices, openness, domestic trade costs, and product variety measured by the counts of barcodes or firms. We find that welfare relative to the United States is lower than indicated by real consumption for most countries, but similar in China and Japan and similar or higher in some European countries. (JEL E21, E23, E31, O11)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用Melitz（2003）模型的结构来计算47个国家的生活成本和福利，并将其与国际比较项目（ICP）的传统价格和实际消费度量进行比较。生活成本的推断不直接使用ICP的贸易品价格，而是依赖于产出价格、开放度、国内贸易成本以及通过条形码或企业数量衡量的产品多样性。我们发现，相对于美国，大多数国家的福利低于实际消费所显示的水平，但在中国和日本相似，在一些欧洲国家则相似或更高。（JEL E21, E23, E31, O11）

records.title_en: Electricity and Firm Productivity: A General-Equilibrium Approach
records.title_cn: 电力与企业生产率：一种一般均衡方法
records.abstract_en: Many policymakers view power outages as a major constraint on firm productivity in developing countries. Yet empirical studies find modest short-run effects of outages on firm performance. This paper builds a dynamic macroeconomic model to study the long-run general-equilibrium effects of power outages on productivity. Outages lower productivity in the model by creating idle resources, depressing the scale of incumbent firms and reducing entry of new firms. Consistent with the empirical literature, the model predicts small short-run effects of eliminating outages. However, the long-run general-equilibrium effects are much larger, supporting the view that eliminating outages is an important development objective. (JEL D22, D24, G32, L94, O13, O14)
records.abstract_cn: 许多政策制定者认为停电是发展中国家企业生产率的主要制约因素。然而，实证研究发现停电对企业绩效的短期影响有限。本文构建了一个动态宏观经济模型，以研究停电对生产率的长期一般均衡效应。在该模型中，停电通过创造闲置资源、压低现有企业规模并减少新企业进入来降低生产率。与实证文献一致，该模型预测消除停电的短期效应较小。然而，长期一般均衡效应要大得多，这支持了消除停电是重要发展目标的观点。(JEL D22, D24, G32, L94, O13, O14)

records.title_en: Trade Policies and Fiscal Devaluations
records.title_cn: 贸易政策与财政贬值
records.abstract_en: Fiscal devaluations—an increase in import tariffs and export subsidies (IX) or an increase in value-added taxes and payroll subsidies (VP)—have been shown to provide as much stimulus under fixed exchange rates as a currency devaluation. We find that if agents expect policies to be reversed and the tax pass-through is large, VP is contractionary and IX provides a modest boost. In our medium-scale DSGE model, both features are crucial in accounting for Germany’s underperformance in response to VP in 2007. These findings cast doubt on fiscal devaluations as a cyclical stabilization tool when monetary policy is constrained. (JEL E32, E52, E62, F13, F33, H20)
records.abstract_cn: 财政贬值——提高进口关税和出口补贴（IX）或提高增值税和工资补贴（VP）——已被证明在固定汇率下能提供与货币贬值相当的刺激。我们发现，如果代理人预期政策将被逆转且税收传导效应较大，则VP具有紧缩效应，而IX仅提供适度的提振。在我们的中等规模DSGE模型中，这两个特征对于解释德国在2007年对VP反应不佳至关重要。这些发现对财政贬值作为货币政策受限时的周期性稳定工具提出了质疑。（JEL E32, E52, E62, F13, F33, H20）

records.title_en: Monetary Policy in Sudden Stop-Prone Economies
records.title_cn: 突然停止倾向经济体中的货币政策
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a parsimonious theory explaining the cyclicality of monetary policy in emerging countries in a model where access to foreign financing depends on the real exchange rate and the government lacks commitment. The discretionary monetary policy is procyclical to mitigate balance sheet effects originating from exchange rate depreciations during sudden stops. Committing to an inflation targeting regime is found to increase social welfare and reduce the frequency of financial crises despite increasing their severity. Finally, the ability to use capital controls induces a less procyclical discretionary monetary policy and delivers higher welfare gains than an inflation targeting regime. (JEL E31, E32, E44, E52, F31, F33, F38)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个简约理论，解释了新兴国家货币政策的周期性，在一个外国融资获取取决于实际汇率且政府缺乏承诺的模型中。相机抉择的货币政策是顺周期的，以减轻在突然停止期间由汇率贬值引起的资产负债表效应。研究发现，承诺通胀目标制度能增加社会福利并减少金融危机的频率，尽管增加了其严重性。最后，使用资本管制的能力导致较不顺周期的相机抉择货币政策，并比通胀目标制度带来更高的福利收益。(JEL E31, E32, E44, E52, F31, F33, F38)

records.title_en: Taxation of Consumption and Labor Income: A Quantitative Approach
records.title_cn: 消费与劳动收入征税：一种定量方法
records.abstract_en: I quantitatively characterize optimal consumption and labor income taxes in a structural life-cycle model of household consumption, saving, and employment choices that allows for irreversibility of durable goods and preference heterogeneity. I find that durables should be subsidized and nondurables should be taxed at a uniform rate. The durable subsidy is driven by the life-cycle features of the model together with durables’ irreversibility and borrowing constraints. Uniform taxation on nondurables holds under exogenous and endogenous—fully or weakly separable—labor supply and it relies on homogeneity of intertemporal preferences. Allowing for government’s equity concerns, I show that the model rationalizes the tax practice. (JEL D15, G51, H21, H23, H24, H31, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 我在一个包含家庭消费、储蓄和就业选择的结构性生命周期模型中，定量刻画了最优消费和劳动收入税，该模型允许耐用品不可逆性和偏好异质性。我发现耐用品应获得补贴，而非耐用品应按统一税率征税。耐用品补贴由模型的生命周期特征以及耐用品的不可逆性和借贷约束共同驱动。在劳动供给外生和内生（完全或弱可分）的情况下，非耐用品的统一征税均成立，并且依赖于跨期偏好的同质性。考虑到政府的公平关切，我表明该模型能够合理化税收实践。（JEL D15, G51, H21, H23, H24, H31, J22）

records.title_en: Disentangling COVID-19, Economic Mobility, and Containment Policy Shocks
records.title_cn: 解析COVID-19、经济流动性与防控政策冲击
records.abstract_en: We study the dynamic interaction between COVID-19, economic mobility, and containment policy. We use Bayesian panel structural vector autoregressions with daily data for 44 countries, identified through traditional and narrative sign restrictions. We find that incidence shocks and containment shocks have large and persistent effects on mobility, morbidity, and mortality that last for one to two months. These shocks are the main drivers of the pandemic, explaining between 20 and 60 percent of the average and historical variability in mobility, cases, and deaths worldwide. The policy trade-off associated to nonpharmaceutical interventions is 1 pp less economic mobility per day for 8 percent fewer deaths after 3 months. (JEL C43, H51, I12, I18, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了COVID-19、经济流动性与防控政策之间的动态相互作用。我们使用44个国家的日度数据，通过传统和叙事符号约束识别的贝叶斯面板结构向量自回归模型。我们发现，发病率冲击和防控冲击对流动性、发病率和死亡率具有持续一至两个月的大而持久的影响。这些冲击是大流行的主要驱动因素，解释了全球流动性、病例和死亡的平均及历史变异的20至60%。与非药物干预相关的政策权衡是，每天减少1个百分点的经济流动性，8%个月后死亡人数减少3。(JEL C43, H51, I12, I18, O15)

records.title_en: “Quick Response” Economic Stimulus: The Effect of Small-Value Digital Coupons on Spending
records.title_cn: “快速响应”经济刺激：小额数字优惠券对消费的影响
records.abstract_en: We study a new consumption stimulus program implemented by a large Chinese city that leverages mobile payment platforms to dispense massive amounts of small-value digital coupons. Exploiting a “rush” design of the dispensing process in which over 1 million program participants compete for coupons on a first-come, first-served basis through a digital portal, we estimate that winning coupons increases weekly out-of-pocket spending by US$3 for every US$1 in government subsidy. Coupon-winning consumers practice inter-temporal substitution by moving up purchases that would have been made four months in the future. Customer flow analysis suggests that coupons distort consumption toward pricier options. (JEL D15, E21, E42, H71, O18, P25, P36)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个由中国大城市实施的新型消费刺激计划，该计划利用移动支付平台发放大量小额数字优惠券。利用发放过程中的“抢购”设计，超过1百万计划参与者在数字门户上以先到先得的方式竞争优惠券，我们估计赢得优惠券会使每周自付支出增加，每获得政府补贴US$1，支出增加US$3。赢得优惠券的消费者通过将未来四个月才会进行的购买提前来实现跨期替代。客流分析表明，优惠券将消费扭曲向更昂贵的选择。(JEL D15, E21, E42, H71, O18, P25, P36)

records.title_en: Schooling, Skill Demand, and Differential Fertility in the Process of Structural Transformation
records.title_cn: 结构转型过程中的教育、技能需求与差异化生育
records.abstract_en: Demography and structural transformation are interrelated, and depend critically on education. At the turn of the twentieth century, US parents began having fewer children while increasing educational investment per child. This quantity-quality tradeoff facilitated job reallocation from the low-skilled agricultural sector to the high-skilled nonagricultural sector. This transformation is examined in a heterogeneous agent model with a nondegenerate human capital distribution, focusing on how fertility and education decisions affect structural transformation. The result shows that the quantity-quality decisions account for up to approximately one-third of the decline in the agricultural employment share. (JEL E24, I21, I26, J11, J13, J24, N31)
records.abstract_cn: 人口统计与结构转型相互关联，且关键取决于教育。在二十世纪之交，美国父母开始减少生育数量，同时增加每个孩子的教育投资。这种数量-质量权衡促进了就业从低技能的农业部门向高技能的非农业部门重新配置。本文在一个具有非退化人力资本分布的异质性主体模型中考察了这一转型，重点关注生育和教育决策如何影响结构转型。结果表明，数量-质量决策解释了农业就业份额下降的约三分之一。（JEL E24, I21, I26, J11, J13, J24, N31）

records.title_en: Overpersistence Bias in Individual Income Expectations and Its Aggregate Implications
records.title_cn: 个人收入预期中的过度持续性偏差及其总体影响
records.abstract_en: Using microlevel data, we document systematic forecast errors in household income expectations that are related to the level of income. We show that these errors can be formalized by a modest deviation from rational expectations, where agents overestimate the persistence of their income process. We then investigate the implications of these distortions on consumption and savings behavior and find two effects. First, these distortions allow an otherwise fully optimization-based quantitative model to match the joint distribution of liquid assets and income. Second, the bias alters the distribution of marginal propensities to consume which makes government stimulus policies less effective. (JEL D84, E21, D91, E62, G51)
records.abstract_cn: 利用微观层面数据，我们记录了家庭收入预期中与收入水平相关的系统性预测误差。我们表明，这些误差可以通过对理性预期的适度偏离来形式化，其中个体高估其收入过程的持续性。然后，我们研究了这些扭曲对消费和储蓄行为的影响，并发现了两个效应。第一，这些扭曲使得一个完全基于优化的定量模型能够匹配流动资产和收入的联合分布。第二，这种偏差改变了边际消费倾向的分布，使得政府刺激政策效果减弱。(JEL D84, E21, D91, E62, G51)

records.title_en: Information Dynamics and Macro Fluctuations
records.title_cn: 信息动态与宏观波动
records.abstract_en: The amount of information produced about firms’ productivities and about the quality of collateral backing their loans varies over time. These information dynamics determine the evolution of credit, output and productivity, which feeds back into incentives to produce information. We characterize this intricate dynamic relation. A credit boom happens when information about collateral depreciates. A financial crisis happens when information about collateral is suddenly generated. Information about firms’ individual productivities over credit booms can prevent or tame the crisis, acting as an endogenous macroprudential force. (JEL D24, D83, E32, E44, G01, G32)
records.abstract_cn: 关于企业生产率及其贷款抵押品质量的信息量随时间而变化。这些信息动态决定了信贷、产出和生产率的演变，进而反馈到生产信息的激励上。我们刻画了这一复杂的动态关系。当关于抵押品的信息贬值时，信贷繁荣发生。当关于抵押品的信息突然产生时，金融危机发生。在信贷繁荣期间，关于企业个体生产率的信息可以预防或缓和危机，起到内生宏观审慎力量的作用。(JEL D24, D83, E32, E44, G01, G32)

records.title_en: Optimal Policy for Macrofinancial Stability
records.title_cn: 宏观金融稳定的最优政策
records.abstract_en: There is a new and now large literature analyzing government policies for financial stability based on models with endogenous borrowing constraints. These normative analyses build upon the concept of constrained efficient allocation where the social planner is constrained by the same borrowing limit that agents face. In this paper, we show that there exists at least one set of tools implementing the constrained efficient allocation that can also be used by a Ramsey planner to replicate an unconstrained allocation, achieving higher welfare. Constrained efficiency may lead to inaccurate characterizations of welfare maximizing policies relative to Ramsey optimal policy. (JEL E32, E44, E61, G01, H21)
records.abstract_cn: 有一个新的且现在庞大的文献，基于内生借款约束的模型分析政府金融稳定政策。这些规范分析建立在约束有效配置的概念之上，其中社会计划者受到与代理人相同的借款限制。在本文中，我们表明存在至少一套工具，可以实施约束有效配置，同时拉姆齐计划者也可以使用这些工具来复制无约束配置，实现更高的福利。相对于拉姆齐最优政策，约束效率可能导致对福利最大化政策的不准确描述。(JEL E32, E44, E61, G01, H21)

records.title_en: How Do Households Respond to Job Loss? Lessons from Multiple High-Frequency Datasets
records.title_cn: 家庭如何应对失业？来自多个高频数据集的经验教训
records.abstract_en: How much and through which channels do households self-insure against job loss? Combining data from a large bank and from government sources, we quantify a broad range of responses to job loss in a unified empirical framework. Cumulated over a two-year period, households reduce spending by 30 percent of their income loss. They mainly self-insure through adjustments of liquid balances, which account for 50 percent of the income loss. Other channels—spousal labor supply, private transfers, home equity extraction, mortgage refinancing, and consumer credit—contribute less to self-insurance. Both overall self-insurance and the channels vary with household characteristics in intuitive ways. (JEL D12, G21, G51, J64, J65)
records.abstract_cn: 家庭在多大程度上以及通过哪些渠道进行自我保险以应对失业？结合一家大型银行和政府来源的数据，我们在一个统一的实证框架中量化了对失业的广泛反应。在两年期间累计，家庭将支出减少了其收入损失的30%。他们主要通过调整流动性余额来自我保险，这占收入损失的50%。其他渠道——配偶劳动供给、私人转移、房屋净值提取、抵押贷款再融资和消费信贷——对自我保险的贡献较小。总体自我保险和各个渠道都随家庭特征以直观的方式变化。（JEL D12, G21, G51, J64, J65）

records.title_en: Improving Regulatory Effectiveness through Better Targeting: Evidence from OSHA
records.title_cn: 通过更好的目标定位提高监管有效性：来自OSHA的证据
records.abstract_en: We study how a regulator can best target inspections. Our case study is a US Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) program that randomly allocated some inspections. On average, each inspection led to 2.4 (9 percent) fewer serious injuries over the next 5 years. Using new machine learning methods, we find that OSHA could have averted as much as twice as many injuries by targeting inspections to workplaces with the highest expected averted injuries and nearly as many by targeting the highest expected level of injuries. Either approach would have generated up to $850 million in social value over the decade we examine. (JEL C63, J28, J81, K32, L51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究监管机构如何最好地定位检查。我们的案例研究是美国职业安全与健康管理局（OSHA）的一个项目，该项目随机分配了一些检查。平均而言，每次检查在接下来的2.4年内减少了9%（5）起严重伤害。使用新的机器学习方法，我们发现，如果OSHA将检查针对预期可避免伤害最高的工作场所，本可以避免多达两倍的伤害，而针对预期伤害水平最高的工作场所，本可以避免几乎同样多的伤害。在我们考察的十年间，这两种方法中的任何一种本可以产生高达850亿美元的社会价值。（JEL C63, J28, J81, K32, L51）

records.title_en: Temporal Instability of Risk Preference among the Poor: Evidence from Payday Cycles
records.title_cn: 贫困群体风险偏好的时间不稳定性：来自发薪日周期的证据
records.abstract_en: The poor live paycheck to paycheck and are repeatedly exposed to strong cyclical income fluctuations. We investigate whether such income fluctuations affect their risk preference. If risk preference temporarily changes around payday, optimal decisions made before payday may no longer be optimal afterward, which could reinforce poverty. By exploiting social security payday cycles in the United States, we find that the poor relying heavily on social security become more risk tolerant before payday. More than cognitive decline before payday, the deterioration of mental health and relative deprivation are likely to play a role. We find similar evidence among the Japanese elderly. (JEL D81, D91, G51, I12, I32, J14, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 穷人依赖薪水过活，反复暴露于强烈的周期性收入波动中。我们研究这种收入波动是否影响其风险偏好。如果风险偏好在发薪日前后暂时发生变化，那么发薪日前做出的最优决策在之后可能不再最优，这可能加剧贫困。利用美国社会保障发薪日周期，我们发现严重依赖社会保障的穷人在发薪日前变得更加风险容忍。与发薪日前认知衰退相比，心理健康恶化和相对剥夺感更可能发挥作用。我们在日本老年人中也发现了类似证据。(JEL D81, D91, G51, I12, I32, J14, J31)

records.title_en: Coming Apart? Cultural Distances in the United States over Time
records.title_cn: 分道扬镳？美国文化距离的历时变化
records.abstract_en: We analyze trends in cultural distances between groups in the United States defined by income, education, gender, race, and political ideology. We measure cultural distance as the ability to infer an individual's group based on media diet, consumer behavior, time use, social attitudes, or newborn's name. Gender difference in time-use decreased between 1965 and 1995 and has remained constant since. Differences in social attitudes by political ideology, and somewhat by income, have increased over the last four decades. Whites and non-Whites have diverged in consumer behavior. For all other demographic divisions and cultural dimensions, cultural distance has been broadly constant over time. (JEL D12, D91, J15, J16, L82, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了美国按收入、教育、性别、种族和政治意识形态划分的群体之间文化距离的趋势。我们将文化距离衡量为基于媒体消费、消费者行为、时间使用、社会态度或新生儿姓名推断个人所属群体的能力。性别在时间使用上的差异在1965年至1995年间有所减少，此后保持不变。按政治意识形态划分的社会态度差异，以及在一定程度上按收入划分的差异，在过去四十年中有所增加。白人和非白人在消费者行为上出现分化。对于所有其他人口统计划分和文化维度，文化距离在时间上基本保持不变。（JEL D12, D91, J15, J16, L82, Z13）

records.title_en: Immigration, Crime, and Crime (Mis)Perceptions
records.title_cn: 移民、犯罪与犯罪（误）感知
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of immigration on crime and crime perceptions in Chile, where the foreign-born population tripled in less than ten years. We document null effects of immigration on crime but positive and significant effects on crime-related concerns and on preventive behavioral responses, such as investing in home security. We explore several channels and provide suggestive evidence related to low- versus high-education immigrants, ethnicity-related intergroup threats, and the role of local media. (JEL D83, D91, J15, K42, L82, O15, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了智利移民对犯罪和犯罪感知的影响，该国外国出生人口在不到十年内增长了两倍。我们记录了移民对犯罪的零效应，但对犯罪相关担忧和预防性行为反应（如投资家庭安全）有显著的正向效应。我们探讨了多个渠道，并提供了与低教育移民和高教育移民、与种族相关的群体间威胁以及地方媒体作用相关的提示性证据。（JEL D83, D91, J15, K42, L82, O15, O17）

records.title_en: Coordination and Bandwagon Effects: How Past Rankings Shape the Behavior of Voters and Candidates
records.title_cn: 协调与从众效应：过去的排名如何塑造选民和候选人的行为
records.abstract_en: Candidates' placements in polls and past elections can be powerful coordination devices for parties and voters. Using a regression discontinuity design in French two-round elections, we show that candidates who place first in the first round are more likely to stay in the race and win than those who placed second. These effects are even larger for ranking second versus third, and also present for third versus fourth. They stem from allied parties agreeing on which candidate should drop out, voters coordinating their choice, and the bandwagon effect of wanting to vote for the winner. We find similar results across 19 other countries. (JEL D72, D83, D91, K16)
records.abstract_cn: 候选人在民调和过往选举中的排名可以成为政党和选民的强大协调工具。利用法国两轮选举中的断点回归设计，我们表明在第一轮中排名第一的候选人比排名第二的候选人更有可能留在竞选中并获胜。这些效应对于排名第二与第三之间的比较甚至更大，并且在第三与第四之间也存在。它们源于联盟政党就哪位候选人应退出达成一致、选民协调其选择，以及希望投票给获胜者的从众效应。我们在其他19个国家发现了类似的结果。(JEL D72, D83, D91, K16)

records.title_en: Contagious Dishonesty: Corruption Scandals and Supermarket Theft
records.title_cn: 不诚实的传染性：腐败丑闻与超市盗窃
records.abstract_en: Is dishonest behavior contagious? We answer this question by studying whether corruption scandals affect the propensity of supermarket customers to steal while using a self-service checkout system. Crucially, this system allows shoppers to engage in dishonest behavior by underreporting the value of their shopping cart. Exploiting data from random audits on shoppers, we show that the probability of stealing increases by 16 percent after a local corruption scandal breaks. This effect is not driven by any change in material incentives. Suggestive evidence shows that it is driven by a reduction in the self-imposed cost of stealing. (JEL D12, D73, D91, K42, L81, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 不诚实行为是否具有传染性？我们通过研究腐败丑闻是否影响超市顾客在使用自助结账系统时偷窃的倾向来回答这个问题。关键在于，该系统允许购物者通过低报其购物车价值来从事不诚实行为。利用对购物者随机审计的数据，我们表明，在当地腐败丑闻爆发后，偷窃的概率增加了16%。这一效应并非由物质激励的任何变化所驱动。提示性证据表明，它是由偷窃自我施加成本的降低所驱动的。(JEL D12, D73, D91, K42, L81, Z13)

records.title_en: Collateralized Marriage
records.title_cn: 抵押婚姻
records.abstract_en: Marriage rates have become increasingly stratified by homeownership. We investigate this in a household model where investments in public goods reduce future earnings and, thus, divorce risk creates inefficiencies. Access to a joint savings technology, like a house, collateralizes marriage, providing insurance to the lower-earning partner and increasing specialization, public goods, and value from marriage. We use idiosyncratic variation in housing prices to show that homeownership access indeed leads to greater specialization. The model also predicts that policies that erode the marriage contract in other ways will make wealth a more important determinant of marriage, which we confirm empirically. (JEL D12, D86, G51, H41, J12, R31)
records.abstract_cn: 结婚率日益按房屋所有权分层。我们在一个家庭模型中研究这一问题，其中公共品投资会降低未来收入，因此离婚风险造成低效率。获得联合储蓄技术（如房屋）的机会将婚姻抵押化，为低收入伴侣提供保险，并增加专业化、公共品和婚姻价值。我们利用房价的异质性变化表明，获得房屋所有权确实导致更大的专业化。该模型还预测，以其他方式侵蚀婚姻契约的政策将使财富成为婚姻更重要的决定因素，我们在实证中证实了这一点。（JEL D12, D86, G51, H41, J12, R31）

records.title_en: How Cable News Reshaped Local Government
records.title_cn: 有线新闻如何重塑地方政府
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that partisan cable news broadcasts have a causal effect on the size and composition of budgets in US localities. Using exogenous channel positioning as an instrument for viewership, we show that exposure to the conservative Fox News channel reduces revenues and expenditures. Multiple mechanisms drive these results: Fox News improves election chances for local Republicans, alters politician campaign agendas, and shifts voter policy preferences on fiscal issues. Consistent with the priorities of small-government conservatism, we find evidence that private provision compensates for the reduced public services. The “Fox News effect” extends beyond vote shares to rightward policy shifts. (JEL D72, H71, H72, H75, I20, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，党派有线新闻广播对美国地方政府的预算规模和构成具有因果效应。利用外生的频道定位作为收视率的工具变量，我们表明接触保守派福克斯新闻频道会减少收入和支出。多种机制驱动这些结果：福克斯新闻提高了地方共和党人的选举机会，改变了政治家的竞选议程，并转变了选民在财政问题上的政策偏好。与小政府保守主义的优先事项一致，我们发现证据表明私人供给补偿了减少的公共服务。“福克斯新闻效应”超越了选票份额，延伸至右翼政策转变。（JEL D72, H71, H72, H75, I20, L82）

records.title_en: Hidden Income and the Perceived Returns to Migration
records.title_cn: 隐藏收入与迁移的感知回报
records.abstract_en: In many developing economies, urban workers earn substantially more than rural workers with the same level of education. Why don't more rural workers migrate to cities? I use two field experiments in Kenya to show that low migration is partly due to underestimation of urban incomes, which is sustained by income hiding by migrants. Parents at the origin underestimate their migrant children's incomes by nearly half, and underestimation is greater when a migrant's remittance obligations are high. Providing information about urban earnings increases migration to the capital city by about 40 percent over two years. (JEL C93, J31, J61, J82, O15, O18, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中经济体，城市工人比同等教育水平的农村工人收入高得多。为什么没有更多农村工人迁移到城市？我在肯尼亚进行了两项实地实验，表明低迁移率部分是由于对城市收入的低估，而这种低估是由迁移者隐藏收入所维持的。原籍地的父母低估其迁移子女的收入近一半，当迁移者的汇款义务较高时，低估程度更大。提供关于城市收入的信息使前往首都城市的迁移在两年内增加了约40%。(JEL C93, J31, J61, J82, O15, O18, R23)

records.title_en: Returns to International Migration: Evidence from a Bangladesh-Malaysia Visa Lottery
records.title_cn: 国际移民的回报：来自孟加拉国-马来西亚签证抽签的证据
records.abstract_en: South Asians traveling to richer Asian nations is the world's largest migration corridor. We track down applicants to a government lottery that randomly allocated visas to Bangladeshis for temporary labor contracts in Malaysia, five years later. Most lottery winners migrate, and migrants' earnings triple. Their remittance raises their family's standard of living in Bangladesh. The migrant's absence pauses marriage and childbirth and shifts decision-making power toward females. Migration removes enterprising individuals, lowering household entrepreneurship, but does not crowd out other family members' labor supply. A deferred migration offer never materialized for a subgroup. Their premigration investments in skills generate no returns in the domestic market. (JEL F22, F24, I31, J24, J31, J82, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 南亚人前往较富裕的亚洲国家是世界上最大的移民走廊。我们追踪了一项政府抽签的申请人，该抽签随机分配签证给孟加拉国人，以便他们在马来西亚获得临时劳动合同，五年后进行调查。大多数中签者移民，移民的收入增加了两倍。他们的汇款提高了家人在孟加拉国的生活水平。移民的缺席推迟了婚姻和生育，并将决策权转向女性。移民带走了有创业精神的个体，降低了家庭创业，但并未挤出其他家庭成员的家庭劳动力供给。一个推迟的移民提议对某个亚组从未实现。他们在移民前对技能的投资在国内市场没有产生回报。(JEL F22, F24, I31, J24, J31, J82, O15)

records.title_en: Civil Liberties in Times of Crisis
records.title_cn: 危机时期的公民自由
records.abstract_en: We study people's willingness to trade off civil liberties for increased health security in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic by deploying representative surveys involving around 550,000 responses across 15 countries. We document significant heterogeneity across groups in willingness to sacrifice rights: citizens disadvantaged by income, education, or race are less willing to sacrifice rights than their more advantaged peers in every country. Leveraging naturally occurring variation and experimental approaches, we estimate a one standard deviation increase in health insecurity increases willingness to sacrifice civil liberties by 68–83 percent of the difference between the average Chinese and US citizen. (JEL D12, D91, I12, I18, K38, O17, P36)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过部署涉及约19万份回复、覆盖550000个国家的代表性调查，研究在COVID-15大流行背景下人们愿意以公民自由换取更高健康安全的程度。我们记录了不同群体在牺牲权利意愿上的显著异质性：在每个国家，收入、教育或种族方面处于不利地位的公民比其更有利的同伴更不愿意牺牲权利。利用自然发生的变异和实验方法，我们估计健康不安全感增加一个标准差会使牺牲公民自由的意愿增加平均中国公民与美国公民差异的68-83%。（JEL D12, D91, I12, I18, K38, O17, P36）

records.title_en: Discrimination in Times of Crises and the Role of the Media
records.title_cn: 危机时期的歧视与媒体的作用
records.abstract_en: Can the extent of ethnic discrimination change quickly, and what circumstances and mechanisms make such changes possible? I address these questions by using scraped data to study the daily evolution of customer discrimination against Arab doctors in Israel from January 2020 to June 2021. Results show that: (1) the outbreak of the coronavirus crisis in March 2020 led to a dramatic decline in discrimination; (2) the eruption of a wave of ethnic riots in May 2021 had the opposite effect; (3) media coverage of the contribution of Arab doctors to the fight against the pandemic helped bring about the first change. (JEL D91, I12, J15, J44, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 种族歧视的程度能否迅速变化，哪些环境和机制使这种变化成为可能？我通过使用抓取的数据研究以色列阿拉伯医生在2020年一月至2021年六月期间顾客歧视的日常演变来回答这些问题。结果表明：（1）2020年三月冠状病毒危机的爆发导致歧视急剧下降；（2）2021年五月种族骚乱的爆发产生了相反的效果；（3）媒体对阿拉伯医生抗击疫情的贡献的报道有助于促成第一个变化。（JEL D91, I12, J15, J44, L82）

records.title_en: Physical Disability and Labor Market Discrimination: Evidence from a Video Résumé Field Experiment
records.title_cn: 身体残疾与劳动力市场歧视：来自视频简历实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We sent fictitious applications to firms advertising job openings. We find that revealing a disability decreases callback rates by 25 percentage points. This result is not explained by accessibility constraints or lower productivity due to disability. We find that including a video résumé of a well-spoken applicant significantly increases callbacks by 10 percentage points for persons with and without disabilities, suggesting that discrimination is unaffected by quality signals in our context. Analysis of viewing activity suggests that employers seek less information when the applicant is disabled. Disclosing the disability later in the video increases employers' viewing time but leaves callback rates unchanged. (JEL C93, J14, J23, J24, J71, K31, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们向发布招聘广告的公司发送了虚构的求职申请。我们发现，披露残疾会使回电率降低25个百分点。这一结果并非由无障碍限制或残疾导致的生产率下降所解释。我们发现，包含一位口齿清晰的申请人的视频简历会显著提高有残疾和无残疾申请人的回电率10个百分点，这表明在我们的情境中，歧视不受质量信号的影响。对观看活动的分析表明，当申请人为残疾人时，雇主会寻求更少的信息。在视频中较晚披露残疾会增加雇主的观看时间，但回电率保持不变。(JEL C93, J14, J23, J24, J71, K31, M51)

records.title_en: The Effect of Hospital Postpartum Care Regulations on Breastfeeding and Maternal Time Allocation
records.title_cn: 医院产后护理法规对母乳喂养和母亲时间分配的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of state hospital regulations intended to increase breastfeeding by requiring certain standards of care during the immediate postpartum hospital stay. We find that these regulations significantly increased breastfeeding initiation by 3.8 percentage points (5.1 percent) and the probability of breastfeeding at 3 and 6 months postpartum by approximately 7 percent. We also provide evidence that these breastfeeding-promoting policies significantly increased maternal time spent on child care, crowding out time spent on formal work. Observed reductions in employment are concentrated among mothers with infants between zero and three months of age. (JEL H75, I11, I18, J13, J16, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了旨在通过要求产后住院期间特定护理标准来增加母乳喂养的州医院法规的影响。我们发现这些法规显著提高了母乳喂养的启动率，增加了3.8个百分点（5.1%），并使得产后3个月和6个月时母乳喂养的概率大约提高了7%。我们还提供了证据表明，这些促进母乳喂养的政策显著增加了母亲用于儿童护理的时间，挤占了用于正式工作的时间。观察到的就业减少主要集中在婴儿年龄在零到三个月之间的母亲中。（JEL H75, I11, I18, J13, J16, J22）

records.title_en: Presidential Address: Demand‐Side Constraints in Development. The Role of Market Size, Trade, and (In)Equality
records.title_cn: 主席演讲：发展中的需求侧约束——市场规模、贸易与（不）平等的作用
records.abstract_en: What is the pathway to development in a world marked by rising economic nationalism and less international integration? This paper answers this question within a framework that emphasizes the role of demand‐side constraints on national development, which is identified with sustained poverty reduction. In this framework, development is linked to the adoption of an increasing returns to scale technology by imperfectly competitive firms that need to pay the fixed setup cost of switching to that technology. Sustained poverty reduction is measured as a continuous decline in the share of the population living below $1.90/day purchasing power parity in 2011 U.S. dollars over a five‐year period. This outcome is affected in a statistically significant and economically meaningful way by domestic market size, which is measured as a function of the income distribution, and international market size, which is measured as a function of legally‐binding provisions to international trade agreements, including the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, the World Trade Organization, and 279 preferential trade agreements. Counterfactual estimates suggest that, in the absence of international integration, the average resident of a low‐ or lower‐middle‐income country does not live in a market large enough to experience sustained poverty reduction. Domestic redistribution targeted towards generating a larger middle class can partially compensate for the lack of an international market.
records.abstract_cn: 在一个经济民族主义抬头、国际一体化程度降低的世界中，发展的路径是什么？本文在一个强调需求侧约束对国家发展作用的框架内回答这一问题，该发展被定义为持续减贫。在此框架下，发展与非完全竞争企业采用规模报酬递增技术相关联，这些企业需要支付转向该技术的固定设立成本。持续减贫以五年期内生活在按购买力平价计算的每日1.90美元（2011年美元）贫困线以下人口比例的持续下降来衡量。这一结果受到国内市场规模和国际市场规模的统计显著且经济意义重大的影响，其中国内市场规模以收入分配的函数衡量，国际市场规模以国际贸易协定（包括关税与贸易总协定、世界贸易组织以及279项特惠贸易协定）中具有法律约束力条款的函数衡量。反事实估计表明，在没有国际一体化的情况下，低收入或中低收入国家的普通居民所生活的市场不足以实现持续减贫。针对扩大中产阶级的国内再分配政策可以部分弥补国际市场的缺失。

records.title_en: A Comment on: “Presidential Address: Demand‐Side Constraints in Development. The Role of Market Size, Trade, and (In)Equality” by Pinelopi Koujianou Goldberg and Tristan Reed
records.title_cn: 对皮内洛皮·库吉亚努·戈德堡和特里斯坦·里德《主席致辞：发展中的需求侧约束——市场规模、贸易与（不）平等的作用》的评论

records.title_en: A Comment on: “Presidential Address: Demand‐Side Constraints in Development: The Role of Market Size, Trade, and (In)Equality,” by Pinelopi Koujianou Goldberg and Tristan Reed
records.title_cn: 对皮内洛皮·库吉亚努·戈德堡和特里斯坦·里德《主席致辞：发展中的需求侧约束：市场规模、贸易与（不）平等的作用》的评论

records.title_en: Reply to: Comments on “Presidential Address: Demand‐Side Constraints in Development. The Role of Market Size, Trade, and (In)Equality”
records.title_cn: 回复：对“主席演讲：发展中的需求侧约束。市场规模、贸易与（不）平等的作用”的评论

records.title_en: Algorithmic Mechanism Design With Investment
records.title_cn: 带投资的算法机制设计
records.abstract_en: We study the investment incentives created by truthful mechanisms that allocate resources using approximation algorithms. Some approximation algorithms guarantee nearly 100% of the optimal welfare in the allocation problem but guarantee nothing when accounting for investment incentives. An algorithm's allocative and investment guarantees coincide if and only if its confirming negative externalities are sufficiently small. We introduce fast approximation algorithms for the knapsack problem that have no confirming negative externalities and guarantees close to 100% for both allocation and investment.
