Results demonstrate that market-based environmental regulation has significantly promoted all types of industrial firms' emission reduction, except collective enterprises. EPLI, as a market-based environmental regulation, owns more flexible mechanisms to stimulate firms to reduce emissions, including reducing the usage of coal and oil and increasing the quantity of emission treatment facilities and investment. This paper provides empirical evidence to support the usage of EPLI in improving environmental performance, which not only comprehensively evaluates China's market-based tool but also provides treasures experience for the environmental management of developing countries on a firm level.
records.abstract_cn: 以中国2008年实施的环境污染责任保险（EPLI）作为准自然实验，利用中国工业企业污染数据库（1998-2014）和中国工业企业数据库（1998-2013）的广泛面板数据，本文采用时变双重差分法识别了EPLI对减排的实施效果。结果表明，市场型环境规制显著促进了除集体企业外的所有类型工业企业的减排。EPLI作为一种市场型环境规制，具有更灵活的机制来激励企业减少排放，包括减少煤炭和石油的使用，以及增加废水处理设施和投资的数量。本文为支持EPLI在改善环境绩效方面的作用提供了经验证据，不仅全面评估了中国市场型工具，也为发展中国家在企业层面的环境管理提供了宝贵经验。

records.title_en: COVID-19 and the quantile connectedness between energy and metal markets
records.title_cn: COVID-19与能源和金属市场之间的分位数连通性
records.abstract_en: This study analyzes the relationship between clean and dirty energy sources and energy metals during the COVID-19 pandemic. We document a sharp increase in connectedness after the COVID-19 pandemic, that is asymmetric at the lower and upper quantiles, with stronger dependence among the variables at the upper quantiles. Among the energy metals, cobalt is the least connected to the energy markets. Finally, our empirical results show a switch in the net connectedness indexes of energy metals and clean energy after January 2021. Our results have implication for investors and policy makers for energy and metal under various market conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了COVID-19大流行期间清洁能源、肮脏能源与能源金属之间的关系。我们记录了COVID-19大流行后连通性的急剧上升，这种上升在较低和较高分位数上是不对称的，变量之间在较高分位数上表现出更强的依赖性。在能源金属中，钴与能源市场的连通性最低。最后，我们的实证结果显示，能源金属和清洁能源的净连通性指数在2021年一月发生了转变。我们的研究结果对投资者和政策制定者在不同市场条件下的能源和金属问题具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Urban environmental legislation and corporate environmental performance: End governance or process control?
records.title_cn: 城市环境立法与企业环境绩效：末端治理还是过程控制？
records.abstract_en: Urban environmental legislation is an important institutional arrangement to ensure the orderly progress of ecological civilization construction. It will also affect corporate environmental performance (CEP) due to more binding environmental regulation measures. Firstly, this paper clarifies the theoretical logic and mechanism of the impact of urban environmental legislation on CEP. Secondly, we matched the data of 3642 listed firms from 2010 to 2019 with the panel data of 277 prefecture-level cities, conducted a quasi-natural experiment based on urban environmental legislation, and used the differential-in-difference model (DID) to test the above mechanism. The results show that urban environmental legislation can significantly improve CEP. Our heterogeneity analyses show that urban environmental legislation more significantly impacts firms with strong debt financing ability, perfect internal governance structure, and low equity concentration. The mechanism test demonstrates that urban environmental legislation improves CEP directly by increasing environmental investment and indirectly by increasing media and public attention. According to a quantitative analysis of 714 urban environmental legislation texts, urban environmental legislation has a significant positive impact on corporate environmental operation performance focusing on terminal governance but no significant impact on corporate environmental management performance focusing on process control.
records.abstract_cn: 城市环境立法是确保生态文明建设有序推进的重要制度安排。由于更具约束力的环境监管措施，它也将影响企业环境绩效（CEP）。首先，本文阐明了城市环境立法对CEP影响的理论逻辑和机制。其次，我们将2010年至2019年间3642家上市公司的数据与277个地级市的面板数据进行匹配，基于城市环境立法进行了准自然实验，并使用双重差分模型（DID）检验了上述机制。结果表明，城市环境立法能够显著提升CEP。我们的异质性分析表明，城市环境立法对债务融资能力强、内部治理结构完善、股权集中度低的企业影响更为显著。机制检验表明，城市环境立法通过增加环境投资直接提升CEP，并通过增加媒体和公众关注间接提升CEP。根据对714项城市环境立法文本的定量分析，城市环境立法对以末端治理为重点的企业环境运营绩效有显著正向影响，但对以过程控制为重点的企业环境管理绩效无显著影响。

records.title_en: A stochastic time-series model for solar irradiation
records.title_cn: 太阳辐照度的随机时间序列模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel stochastic time series model able to explain the stylized features of daily irradiation level data in 5 cities in Germany. The model is suitable for applications to risk management of photovoltaic power production in renewable energy markets. The suggested dynamics is a low-order autoregressive time series with seasonal level given by an atmospheric clear-sky model. Moreover, we detect a skewness property in the residuals which we explain by a winter–summer regime switch. The stochastic variance is modeled by a seasonally varying GARCH-dynamics. The winter and summer standardized residuals are proposed to be a Gaussian mixture model to capture the bimodal distributions. We estimate the model on the observed data, and perform a validation study. An application to energy markets studying the production at risk for a PV-producer is presented.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的随机时间序列模型，能够解释德国5个城市每日辐照水平数据的典型特征。该模型适用于可再生能源市场中光伏发电风险管理的应用。所提出的动态过程是一个低阶自回归时间序列，其季节性水平由大气晴空模型给出。此外，我们检测到残差中的偏度特性，并通过冬夏季节制度转换来解释。随机方差由季节性变化的GARCH动态建模。冬季和夏季的标准化残差被提议为高斯混合模型，以捕捉双峰分布。我们在观测数据上估计模型，并进行验证研究。最后，展示了一个针对光伏生产商的生产风险在能源市场中的应用。

records.title_en: Intersecting near-optimal spaces: European power systems with more resilience to weather variability
records.title_cn: 交叉近最优空间：对天气变率更具韧性的欧洲电力系统
records.abstract_en: We suggest a new methodology for designing robust energy systems. For this, we investigate so-called near-optimal solutions to energy system optimisation models; solutions whose objective values deviate only marginally from the optimum. Using a refined method for obtaining explicit geometric descriptions of these near-optimal feasible spaces, we find designs that are as robust as possible to perturbations. This contributes to the ongoing debate on how to define and work with robustness in energy systems modelling.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种设计稳健能源系统的新方法。为此，我们研究了能源系统优化模型中所谓的近最优解；这些解的目标值仅与最优值有微小偏差。利用一种精细的方法来获得这些近最优可行空间的显式几何描述，我们找到了对扰动尽可能稳健的设计。这有助于当前关于如何在能源系统建模中定义和处理稳健性的讨论。

records.title_en: Trade policy uncertainty and financial investment: Evidence from Chinese energy firms
records.title_cn: 贸易政策不确定性与金融投资：来自中国能源企业的证据
records.abstract_en: This study investigates whether trade policy uncertainty impacts energy firms' financial investments. We find that trade policy uncertainty is negatively related to energy firm's financial investment, thus suggesting that energy firms prefer to reduce financial investment during periods of higher trade policy uncertainty. After adopting several robustness tests, our results remain robust. The negative correlation between trade policy uncertainty and financial investment is more significant in energy firms with less sales revenues, and lower sales growth rates. Meanwhile, energy firms with less serious competition and in areas with higher marketization are more likely to reduce financial investment when trade policy uncertainty increases. Further evidence shows that energy firms are more likely to hold more cash and increase research and development activities when trade policy uncertainty increases.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨贸易政策不确定性是否影响能源企业的金融投资。我们发现贸易政策不确定性与能源企业的金融投资呈负相关，从而表明能源企业在贸易政策不确定性较高时期倾向于减少金融投资。在采用多项稳健性检验后，我们的结果依然稳健。贸易政策不确定性与金融投资之间的负相关关系在销售收入较少、销售增长率较低的能源企业中更为显著。同时，竞争不激烈以及位于市场化程度较高地区的能源企业，在贸易政策不确定性增加时更可能减少金融投资。进一步证据表明，当贸易政策不确定性增加时，能源企业更可能持有更多现金并增加研发活动。

records.title_en: Impact of off-farm employment on cooking fuel choices: Implications for rural-urban transformation in advancing sustainable energy transformation
records.title_cn: 非农就业对炊事燃料选择的影响：农村-城市转型对推进可持续能源转型的启示
records.abstract_en: Off-farm employment is a prominent manifestation of rural-urban transformation in developing countries, and it theoretically plays a critical role in rural sustainable energy transformation. Exploiting the nationally representative household-level panel data from the China Labor-force Dynamics Survey (CLDS), this study employs a multi-dimensional fixed-effects (MDFE) model, an inverse probability weighted regression adjustment (IPWRA) technique and a propensity score matching (PSM) approach to investigate the impact of off-farm employment on cooking fuel choices. The results show that off-farm employment exerts a positive and significant impact on the probability of adopting clean fuels for cooking, with specific reductions in biomass and coal and increases in electricity and gas. Furthermore, this effect is mainly realized by reducing the amount of available labor, the number of family meals, and increasing kitchen equipment purchases. However, the relationship between off-farm employment and cooking fuel choices varies considerably across the region, village and household groups. Off-farm employment mainly benefits the eastern, central and western regions of China, villages in plain areas, with brick-concrete houses and ethnic Han Chinese, households with children or the elderly, with poor health and more females, while it is less beneficial for others. The study highlights the important policy implications of rural-urban transition for sustainable energy transition through the creation of off-farm jobs.
records.abstract_cn: 非农就业是发展中国家农村-城市转型的显著表现，理论上在农村可持续能源转型中发挥着关键作用。利用中国劳动力动态调查（CLDS）中具有全国代表性的家庭层面面板数据，本研究采用多维固定效应（MDFE）模型、逆概率加权回归调整（IPWRA）技术和倾向得分匹配（PSM）方法，考察非农就业对炊事燃料选择的影响。结果表明，非农就业对采用清洁炊事燃料的概率产生显著正向影响，具体表现为生物质和煤炭使用减少，电力和天然气使用增加。此外，这一效应主要通过减少可用劳动力数量、家庭用餐次数以及增加厨房设备购买来实现。然而，非农就业与炊事燃料选择之间的关系在不同地区、村庄和家庭群体之间存在显著差异。非农就业主要惠及中国东部、中部和西部地区，平原地区、砖混结构房屋和汉族家庭，有儿童或老人、健康状况较差和女性较多的家庭，而对其他群体的益处较小。本研究强调了通过创造非农就业机会，农村-城市转型对可持续能源转型的重要政策启示。

records.title_en: Oil price assumptions for macroeconomic policy
records.title_cn: 宏观经济政策中的油价假设
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the economic usefulness of oil price forecasts by means of conditional forecasting of five US macroeconomic indicators. First, we forecast oil prices using a mixed sampling frequency framework, where oil prices are driven by information available at high-frequency; and subsequently we proceed with our macroeconomic conditional forecasts. Overall, there is diminishing importance of oil price forecasts for inflation projections, whereas the reverse holds true for inflation expectations, industrial production and producers price index. An array of arguments is presented as to why this might be the case. Our findings remain robust to alternative forecasting frameworks and model specifications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过五个美国宏观经济指标的条件预测来评估油价预测的经济有用性。首先，我们使用混合采样频率框架预测油价，其中油价由高频信息驱动；随后我们进行宏观经济条件预测。总体而言，油价预测对通胀预测的重要性递减，而对通胀预期、工业生产和生产者价格指数则相反。我们提出了一系列论据来解释为何会出现这种情况。我们的发现在替代预测框架和模型设定下依然稳健。

records.title_en: Financial technology stocks, green financial assets, and energy markets: A quantile causality and dependence analysis
records.title_cn: 金融科技股票、绿色金融资产与能源市场：分位数因果关系与依赖性分析
records.abstract_en: With the development of Industry 4.0 and the urgency of transitioning to a low-carbon economy, fintech and environmentally friendly financial instruments have been widely employed because they have played a crucial role in restoring investor confidence in the financial services sector since the global financial crisis in 2008. They not only help investors diversify their portfolios to hedge against risks and enhance returns, but they also help to reduce the negative impacts of climate change. In this study, we analyze the connections among financial technology stocks, green financial assets, and energy markets using nonparametric causality-in-quantile and cross-quantilogram approaches based on the financial contagion theory. We explore whether the performance of fintech prices across booms and busts affects the prices of eco-friendly assets and energy market prices. Our results indicate that in the short run, fintech is highly directionally predictable in all markets except that of green bonds in the lower quantile. Additionally, in the bullish state, the predictability of all lag lengths is negative. Thus, price movements in fintech markets contribute to the vulnerability of the price levels of renewable and non-renewable energy stocks, green bonds, green equities, and sustainable development. Because financial contagion is closely related to asset pricing, portfolio allocation, risk measurement, and monetary policy, the findings of this paper will be informative to investors, portfolio managers, and policy makers.
records.abstract_cn: 随着工业4.0的发展以及向低碳经济转型的紧迫性，金融科技和环境友好型金融工具已被广泛采用，因为它们自2008年全球金融危机以来，在恢复投资者对金融服务业的信心方面发挥了关键作用。它们不仅帮助投资者分散投资组合以对冲风险并提高回报，还有助于减少气候变化的负面影响。在本研究中，我们基于金融传染理论，使用非参数分位数因果关系和交叉分位数图方法，分析了金融科技股票、绿色金融资产与能源市场之间的联系。我们探讨了金融科技价格在繁荣和萧条期间的表现是否影响环保资产价格和能源市场价格。我们的结果表明，在短期内，金融科技在所有市场中具有高度的方向可预测性，除了绿色债券在下分位数的情况。此外，在牛市状态下，所有滞后长度的可预测性均为负。因此，金融科技市场的价格波动加剧了可再生能源和不可再生能源股票、绿色债券、绿色股票以及可持续发展的价格水平的脆弱性。由于金融传染与资产定价、投资组合配置、风险度量和货币政策密切相关，本文的研究结果将对投资者、投资组合管理者和政策制定者具有参考价值。

records.title_en: How G-7 countries are paving the way for net-zero emissions through energy efficient ecosystem?
records.title_cn: G-7国家如何通过节能生态系统为净零排放铺平道路？
records.abstract_en: Given the relevance of the most burning issues across the globe, it is time to take action regarding the recovery of environmental issues such as global warming and climate change. Concerning inconsistencies and gaps in the prevailing literature, this study aims to investigate the role energy efficiency played in the energy related greenhouse gas emissions. With the advancement in the technological innovation, the importance of digitalization and environmental related technological innovation. Based on the economic importance of the Group of Seven (G7) economies, this study examined the connection of these variables in the mentioned group economies throughout 1990–2020. Employing advanced panel econometric approaches, the study found that prevalence of slope heterogeneity, cross-section dependence, and the existence of long-run equilibrium relationship. Due to non-linear data properties, the study uses non-parametric (method of moment quantile regression) technique. The results suggest the progressive role of energy efficiency, digitalization, and environmental related innovations on the environmental sustainability. These are substantial factors of sustainability as they significantly reduce the energy-related greenhouse gas emissions. On the contrary, economic growth is a significant driver of energy related greenhouse gas emissions. The results are robust and their causal linkage is also explored. This study suggests the increased investment and encouragement of energy efficiency, digitalization, and environmental related technological innovation in the G7 economies to pave the way for net zero emissions.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于全球最紧迫问题的相关性，现在是采取行动解决全球变暖和气候变化等环境问题的时候了。鉴于现有文献中的不一致和差距，本研究旨在调查能源效率在能源相关温室气体排放中所发挥的作用。随着技术创新的进步，数字化和环境相关技术创新的重要性。基于七国集团（G7）经济体的经济重要性，本研究考察了1990-2020期间上述集团经济体中这些变量的联系。该研究采用先进的面板计量经济学方法，发现普遍存在坡度异质性、横截面依赖性以及长期均衡关系的存在。由于非线性数据特性，本研究采用非参数（矩分位数回归方法）技术。结果表明，能源效率、数字化和环境相关创新对环境可持续性发挥着渐进作用。这些都是可持续发展的重要因素，因为它们显着减少了与能源相关的温室气体排放。相反，经济增长是能源相关温室气体排放的重要驱动力。结果是稳健的，并且还探讨了它们的因果关系。本研究建议G7经济体增加投资并鼓励能源效率、数字化和环境相关技术创新，为净零排放铺平道路。

records.title_en: Do oil shocks affect the green bond market?
records.title_cn: 石油冲击是否影响绿色债券市场？
records.abstract_en: This study examines the predictive power of oil shocks for the green bond markets. In line with this aim, we investigated the extent to which oil shocks could be used to accurately make in- and out-of-sample forecasts for green bond returns. Three striking findings emanated from our results: First, the three types of oil shock are reliable predictors for green bond indices. Second, the performances of the predictive models were consistent across the different forecasting horizons (i.e. H = 1 to H = 24). Third, our findings were sensitive to classifying the dataset into pre-COVID and COVID eras. For instance, the results confirmed that the predictive power of oil shocks declined during the crisis period. We also discuss some policy implications of this study's findings.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了石油冲击对绿色债券市场的预测能力。基于此目的，我们调查了石油冲击在多大程度上能够用于准确进行绿色债券收益的样本内和样本外预测。我们的结果得出了三个显著发现：第一，三种类型的石油冲击是绿色债券指数的可靠预测因子。第二，预测模型的表现跨不同预测期限（即H=1至H=24）保持一致。第三，我们的发现对将数据集划分为COVID前和COVID时期敏感。例如，结果证实，在危机期间石油冲击的预测能力有所下降。我们还讨论了本研究结果的一些政策含义。

records.title_en: Blessing or curse? Market-driven environmental regulation and enterprises' total factor productivity: Evidence from China's carbon market pilots
records.title_cn: 祝福还是诅咒？市场型环境规制与企业全要素生产率：来自中国碳市场试点的证据
records.abstract_en: This study explores the question of whether building a unified carbon market is a blessing or a curse for enterprises in China under the background of global carbon emission reduction goals. Using data on China's A-share listed enterprises and city panel data from 2008 to 2019, we evaluate the effect of China's carbon market pilots, a market-driven environmental regulation policy, on enterprises' total factor productivity (TFP). The findings indicate that the pilot policy promoted enterprises' TFP in the pilot areas by approximately 0.05 on average during the sample period. In particular, the TFP of enterprises in high‑carbon emission industries increased by an average of 0.11. This positive effect is confirmed in the robustness tests. Meanwhile, the effect also is heterogeneous for different regions and enterprises. It depends on enterprise scale, property rights, governance level, financing constraints and registration address. Additionally, the promotion effect works through three channels, including government environmental protection efforts, enterprise resource allocation optimization, and increased investment in R&D. Therefore, building a carbon market is proven to be positive for the development of enterprises. This study enriches the research on pollution control and economic growth and provides policy references for achieving carbon reduction goals.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究在全球碳减排目标背景下，探讨建立统一碳市场对中国企业而言是祝福还是诅咒。利用2008年至2019年中国A股上市公司数据和城市面板数据，我们评估了中国碳市场试点这一市场型环境规制政策对企业全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。研究结果表明，在样本期内，试点政策平均促进了试点地区企业全要素生产率约0.05。特别是，高碳排放行业企业的全要素生产率平均提高了0.11。这一积极效应在稳健性检验中得到证实。同时，该效应在不同地区和不同企业间存在异质性，取决于企业规模、产权性质、治理水平、融资约束和注册地址。此外，促进作用通过三个渠道发挥作用，包括政府环保努力、企业资源配置优化和研发投入增加。因此，建立碳市场被证明对企业发展具有积极意义。本研究丰富了污染控制与经济增长的研究，并为实现碳减排目标提供了政策参考。

records.title_en: Buy coal and gas? Interfuel carbon leakage on deposit markets with market power
records.title_cn: 购买煤炭和天然气？具有市场势力的存款市场上的燃料间碳泄漏
records.abstract_en: Unilateral climate policies can lead to carbon leakage between countries. Deposit markets, where participants trade the right to keep fossil fuels unexploited in-situ, are a promising policy proposal to prevent leakage. For a single fossil fuel, deposit markets can only restore efficiency if there is no market power on the deposit market. With multiple fuels, however, multiple (interdependent) deposit markets could give rise to additional market power. We thus study deposit markets with market power and multiple fuels, and focus on comparing second-best policies. In contrast to a setting with a single fuel, more complex carbon leakage channels between both, countries and fuels, arise. Such effects can even hinder deposit markets covering all fuels from being implemented. At the same time, we identify conditions where deposit markets induce countries without emission reduction incentives to supply a cleaner fuel mix. Regarding the political economy, deposit markets covering all fuels can improve each country’s welfare compared to those covering only one fuel. Deposit markets which cover only a single fuel or multiple fuels rank differently in terms of consumer and producer rents. These welfare rankings can have highly relevant implications for policy-making. Even with market power, deposit markets covering multiple fuels can Pareto-dominate a situation with unilateral, domestic policies.
records.abstract_cn: 单边气候政策可能导致国家间的碳泄漏。存款市场，即参与者交易将化石燃料保留在地下不开采的权利的市场，是防止泄漏的一个有前景的政策提议。对于单一化石燃料，如果存款市场上没有市场势力，存款市场只能恢复效率。然而，对于多种燃料，多个（相互依存的）存款市场可能产生额外的市场势力。因此，我们研究具有市场势力和多种燃料的存款市场，并侧重于比较次优政策。与单一燃料的情况相比，国家和燃料之间出现了更复杂的碳泄漏渠道。这些效应甚至可能阻碍覆盖所有燃料的存款市场的实施。同时，我们确定了存款市场促使没有减排激励的国家提供更清洁燃料组合的条件。关于政治经济学，与仅覆盖一种燃料的存款市场相比，覆盖所有燃料的存款市场可以改善每个国家的福利。仅覆盖单一燃料或多种燃料的存款市场在消费者和生产者租金方面的排名不同。这些福利排名可能对政策制定产生高度相关的影响。即使存在市场势力，覆盖多种燃料的存款市场也可以帕累托优于单边国内政策的情况。

records.title_en: Assessing the effectiveness of energy efficiency measures in the residential sector gas consumption through dynamic treatment effects: Evidence from England and Wales
records.title_cn: 评估住宅部门燃气消费能效措施有效性的动态处理效应：来自英格兰和威尔士的证据
records.abstract_en: Improving energy efficiency (EE) is vital to ensure a sustainable, affordable, and secure energy system. The residential sector represents, on average, 18.6% of the total final energy consumption in the OECD countries in 2018, reaching 29.5% in the UK (IEA, 2020a). Using a staggered differences-in-differences approach with dynamic treatment effects, we analyse changes in residential gas consumption five years before and after the adoption of energy efficiency measures. The analysis includes energy efficiency interventions involving the installation of new heating-related insulation equipment—i.e., of loft insulation and cavity walls, supported by energy efficiency programmes in England and Wales between 2005 and 2017—using a panel of 55,154 households from the National Energy Efficiency Data-Framework (NEED). We control for, among other factors, energy prices and the extent to which gas consumption changes are dependent on household characteristics and variations in weather conditions. Our results indicate that the adoption of EE measures is associated with significant reductions in household residential gas consumption one year after their implementation. However, the effect does not last in the long run and energy savings disappear four years after the retrofitting of cavity wall insulation measures and after two years following the installation of loft insulation. The disappearance of energy savings in the longer run could be explained by the energy performance gap, the rebound effect and/or by concurrent residential construction projects and renovations associated with increases in energy consumption. Notably, for households in deprived areas, the installation of these efficiency measures does not deliver energy savings. These results confirm the existence of effects that reduce the energy savings from the adoption of these efficiency technologies over time and indicates that, for some groups, these net savings do not seem to materialize.
records.abstract_cn: 提高能效对于确保可持续、可负担且安全的能源系统至关重要。在经合组织国家中，住宅部门平均占最终能源消费总量的18.6%（2018年），在英国这一比例达到29.5%（IEA, 2020a）。采用具有动态处理效应的交错双重差分方法，我们分析了在采用能效措施前后五年内住宅燃气消费的变化。分析包括涉及安装新型供暖相关保温设备（即阁楼保温和空腔墙保温）的能效干预措施，这些措施在2005年至2017年间由英格兰和威尔士的能效计划支持，使用了来自国家能效数据框架（NEED）的55,154户家庭面板数据。我们控制了能源价格、燃气消费变化对家庭特征的依赖程度以及天气条件变化等因素。我们的结果表明，能效措施的采用与实施一年后家庭住宅燃气消费的显著减少相关。然而，这种效应在长期内并未持续，能源节约在空腔墙保温措施改造四年后消失，在阁楼保温安装两年后消失。长期内能源节约的消失可能由能源绩效差距、反弹效应和/或与能源消费增加相关的同期住宅建设项目和翻新所解释。值得注意的是，对于贫困地区的家庭，这些效率措施的安装并未带来能源节约。这些结果证实了存在降低这些效率技术采用所带来的能源节约随时间推移而减少的效应，并表明对于某些群体，这些净节约似乎并未实现。

records.title_en: City centrality, population density and energy efficiency
records.title_cn: 城市中心性、人口密度与能源效率
records.abstract_en: We use continuous night light data and LandScan population data to construct a monocentric index to measure whether a city tends to be a monocentric or polycentric spatial structure, and estimate the impact of such structure on energy efficiency by using a two-way fixed effects model. In order to solve the endogeneity of urban structure, the historical census data and topographic relief data at the city level are used to construct the instrumental variables. We find that an increase in the urban monocentricity index would significantly reduce the level of the urban energy intensity. Meanwhile, the relationship between monocentricity and urban energy intensity is U-shaped. When the degree of monocentricity is at relatively low level, its impact on energy efficiency is positive, implying the dominance of agglomeration effect. When economic agglomeration is greater than a certain degree, the impact of monocentricity becomes negative which results from the dominance of congestion effect. Moreover, impact of urban structure on energy intensity varies with urban population density. An increase in population density would weaken the negative impact of monocentricity on energy intensity, that is, in sparsely populated cities, the monocentricity is more conducive to energy saving. In terms of city form, monocentric structure may improve energy efficiency in the cities with poor transportation infrastructure more than in the cities with good transportation infrastructure. Monocentricity facilitates energy efficiency primarily by increasing corporate innovation and saving commuting time and distance. We perform a series of robustness tests and the findings are basically consistent with the baseline result. Our findings suggest that the cities at this stage should continue to strengthen the development of monocentricity, pay attention to compactness of urban spatial structure, and develop the polycentric structure cautiously. Meanwhile, in the development process, the local population density and the carrying capacity of the transportation infrastructure should be taken into consideration to avoid the negative effects caused by the congestion in main center.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用连续夜间灯光数据和LandScan人口数据构建单中心指数，以衡量城市倾向于单中心还是多中心空间结构，并通过双向固定效应模型估计这种结构对能源效率的影响。为解决城市结构的内生性问题，我们使用城市层面的历史人口普查数据和地形起伏度数据构建工具变量。我们发现，城市单中心指数的提高会显著降低城市能源强度水平。同时，单中心性与城市能源强度之间存在U型关系。当单中心程度处于相对较低水平时，其对能源效率的影响为正，表明集聚效应占主导。当经济集聚超过一定程度时，单中心性的影响变为负，这是由于拥堵效应占主导。此外，城市结构对能源强度的影响随城市人口密度而变化。人口密度的增加会削弱单中心性对能源强度的负面影响，即在人口稀疏的城市，单中心性更有利于节能。就城市形态而言，在交通基础设施较差的城市，单中心结构可能比在交通基础设施良好的城市更能提高能源效率。单中心性主要通过增加企业创新和节省通勤时间与距离来促进能源效率。我们进行了一系列稳健性检验，结果与基准结果基本一致。我们的研究结果表明，现阶段城市应继续加强单中心性发展，注重城市空间结构的紧凑性，并谨慎发展多中心结构。同时，在发展过程中，应考虑当地人口密度和交通基础设施的承载能力，以避免主中心拥堵带来的负面影响。

records.title_en: Elusive effects of export embargoes for fossil energy resources
records.title_cn: 化石能源出口禁运的难以捉摸的影响
records.abstract_en: Unlike produced commodities, the extraction and sale of fossil energy resources such as oil or natural gas is an “asset swap”: assets stored in the ground are converted into financial assets. The value of assets in the ground is reduced by the amount taken out and sold. This is important for assessing the coercive power of the threat of implementing an export embargo. Even if the country affected by the embargo is ruled by an autocratic kleptocrat, who appropriates all the revenues from resource sales, the sanctioning effect is close to zero in a functioning financial market environment. However, if the autocrat considers her future government power to be at risk and, at the same time, can bunker the extraction proceeds in a financial safe-haven, then the embargo leads to expected wealth losses for the autocrat. The expected wealth losses increase in the difference between the likelihood of retaining power and the wealth security of the financial assets in a safe haven. We also analyze variants of the model such as an oligopolistic resource market, where the non-sanctioned resource exporters benefit at the expense of the sanctioned country.
records.abstract_cn: 与生产出来的商品不同，化石能源资源（如石油或天然气）的开采和销售是一种“资产互换”：地下的资产被转化为金融资产。地下资产的价值因开采和销售而减少。这对于评估实施出口禁运威胁的强制力至关重要。即使受禁运影响的国家由专制的盗贼统治者统治，该统治者侵占了资源销售的所有收入，在运作良好的金融市场环境中，制裁效果也接近于零。然而，如果独裁者认为她未来的政府权力面临风险，同时又能将开采收益存放在金融避风港，那么禁运会导致独裁者预期的财富损失。预期财富损失随着保持权力可能性与避风港金融资产财富安全性之间差异的增加而增加。我们还分析了模型的变体，如寡头垄断的资源市场，其中未受制裁的资源出口国以受制裁国家的利益为代价而获益。

records.title_en: Optimal real-time pricing and electricity package by retail electric providers based on social learning
records.title_cn: 基于社会学习的售电公司最优实时定价与电力套餐设计
records.abstract_en: As the global retail electricity market liberalizes, retail electric providers (REPs) are optimizing pricing schemes and electricity packages (EPs) to meet consumers' individual and diverse electricity plans while reducing volatility risk and ensuring profitability. However, consumer social learning (SL) helps frequently adjust electricity plans as social media evolves, preventing REPs from accurately understanding consumer electricity demand. Therefore, this paper constructs a dynamic game model of the retail electricity market considering social learning. REPs announce price and electricity package information to consumers based on market information and historical experience, and consumers first shared electricity usage plans based on their willingness to learn and share information among themselves, and then respond to REPs based on current information and experience. The main findings of this paper are as follows: (i) social learning increases consumer utility, promotes competition, depresses REPs prices, shrinks price differentials, and induces concessions by REPs, but raises volatility risk. (ii) electricity packages combined with social learning can save electricity consumption and significantly reduce volatility risk. Finally, this paper uses Smart Meter Energy Consumption data in London households to demonstrate the impact of social learning and to provide decision support for REP's electricity sales strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 随着全球零售电力市场放开，售电公司（REPs）正在优化定价方案和电力套餐（EPs），以满足消费者个性化、多样化的用电计划，同时降低波动风险并确保盈利能力。然而，消费者社会学习（SL）随着社交媒体发展而频繁调整用电计划，阻碍了售电公司准确理解消费者用电需求。因此，本文构建了考虑社会学习的零售电力市场动态博弈模型。售电公司基于市场信息和历史经验向消费者公布价格和电力套餐信息，消费者首先根据自身学习意愿和相互间信息分享来共享用电计划，然后基于当前信息和经验对售电公司做出响应。本文的主要发现如下：（i）社会学习提高了消费者效用，促进了竞争，压低了售电公司价格，缩小了价格差异，并诱导售电公司做出让步，但增加了波动风险。（ii）电力套餐与社会学习相结合可以节约用电量并显著降低波动风险。最后，本文利用伦敦家庭智能电表能耗数据来论证社会学习的影响，并为售电公司的售电策略提供决策支持。

records.title_en: Can increasing economic complexity improve China's green development efficiency?
records.title_cn: 提高经济复杂度能否改善中国的绿色发展效率？
records.abstract_en: In the context of China's efforts to promote green development, how to improve the green development efficiency (GDE) has become an increasingly important research topic. Promoting the transformation towards a knowledge- and technology-intensive economic structure may be an important way to improve the GDE. Therefore, this study examines the impact of economic structural transformation represented by economic complexity on China's GDE. This study first measures the economic complexity index (ECI) and GDE of China's provinces using the method of reflections and data envelopment analysis window model, then examines the impact of the ECI on China's GDE based on a panel data model. It further analyses the contribution of ECI to regional differences in GDE and the mechanism of the effect of ECI on GDE using the regression-based Shapley decomposition analysis approach and a mediating effect model, respectively. Five conclusions are obtained as follows. Firstly, the ECI in China decreased from the east to the west, while the GDE shows the characteristics of ‘a higher GDE in the east and south and a lower GDE in the west and north’. Secondly, the empirical results show that the ECI has a significant positive impact on the GDE, and the results of the robustness tests support this finding. This indicates that increasing economic complexity plays an important role in promoting the green development of China's provinces. Thirdly, significant regional differences exist in the impact of economic complexity on the GDE. Fourthly, the decomposition results of regional differences in the GDE suggest that economic complexity is a primary factor that causes the differences in the GDE among China's provinces. Fifthly, the estimation results of the mediating effect model indicate that increasing economic complexity can improve the GDE by enhancing innovation and human capital levels. These findings suggest that China can promote regional green development by developing policies related to enhancing economic complexity and fully releasing the effects of economic complexity on innovation and human capital.
records.abstract_cn: 在中国推动绿色发展的背景下，如何提高绿色发展效率（GDE）已成为一个日益重要的研究课题。促进向知识和技术密集型经济结构转型可能是提高GDE的重要途径。因此，本研究考察了以经济复杂度为代表的经济结构转型对中国GDE的影响。本研究首先使用反射方法和数据包络分析窗口模型测度了中国各省的经济复杂度指数（ECI）和GDE，然后基于面板数据模型考察了ECI对中国GDE的影响。进一步，分别使用基于回归的沙普利分解分析方法和中介效应模型分析了ECI对GDE区域差异的贡献以及ECI影响GDE的机制。得到了五个结论。第一，中国的ECI从东向西递减，而GDE呈现出“东部和南部较高，西部和北部较低”的特征。第二，实证结果表明，ECI对GDE有显著的正向影响，稳健性检验结果支持了这一发现。这表明提高经济复杂度在促进中国各省绿色发展方面发挥着重要作用。第三，经济复杂度对GDE的影响存在显著的区域差异。第四，GDE区域差异的分解结果表明，经济复杂度是导致中国各省GDE差异的主要因素。第五，中介效应模型的估计结果表明，提高经济复杂度可以通过增强创新和人力资本水平来改善GDE。这些发现表明，中国可以通过制定与提高经济复杂度相关的政策，并充分释放经济复杂度对创新和人力资本的影响，来促进区域绿色发展。

records.title_en: The nexus between oil and airline stock returns: Does time frequency matter?
records.title_cn: 石油与航空股票收益之间的关系：时间频率是否重要？
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between oil and airline stock returns under different time frequencies. First, we propose an Autoregressive moving average model with mixed frequency exogenous variable to analyse the different impacts of oil on airline stock returns on daily, weekly, and monthly basis. We consistently find a negative oil-airline stock return nexus on a daily basis, but a positive relationship on a weekly basis. While the former supports the economic-based channel, the latter is in line with the market inertia channel. Our findings help explain mixed results reported in the literature. Further, our time frequency connectedness analysis shows that the economic-based channel dominates the market inertia channel since the connectedness is more pronounced in the short-run compared to the medium- and long-run. Our block connectedness results highlight that business models of airline firms can play a significant role in affecting the connectedness, in which the low-cost airlines are more sensitive to the oil price changes. It is worth noting that there are distinguished drivers of the oil-airline stock return nexus in different time frequencies. The drivers also vary between the Global Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. Our results are consistent under a battery of robustness checks and deliver important implications to investors, portfolio managers, and executives of airline firms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了不同时间频率下石油与航空股票收益之间的关系。首先，我们提出了一个带有混合频率外生变量的自回归移动平均模型，以分析石油对航空股票收益在日度、周度和月度基础上的不同影响。我们一致发现，在日度基础上石油与航空股票收益之间存在负相关关系，而在周度基础上则存在正相关关系。前者支持基于经济的渠道，而后者则与市场惯性渠道一致。我们的发现有助于解释文献中报道的混合结果。此外，我们的时间频率连通性分析表明，基于经济的渠道主导了市场惯性渠道，因为连通性在短期内比中期和长期更为显著。我们的块连通性结果强调，航空公司的商业模式在影响连通性方面可以发挥重要作用，其中低成本航空公司对油价变化更为敏感。值得注意的是，在不同时间频率下，石油与航空股票收益关系的驱动因素有所不同。这些驱动因素在全球金融危机和COVID-19大流行之间也有所不同。我们的结果在一系列稳健性检验下保持一致，并为投资者、投资组合经理和航空公司高管提供了重要启示。

records.title_en: Fossil resource market power and capital markets
records.title_cn: 化石资源市场势力与资本市场
records.abstract_en: Supplying a crucial exhaustible resource to the world market induces profound repercussions in the capital markets. Employing a two-country model with international trade, we examine how a resource-rich country with monopolistic market power accounts for this interplay with the capital market in its extraction decision over time. We investigate new supply motives resulting from the general-equilibrium feedbacks and from capital asset holdings of the resource-rich country. Recognizing the influence of resource supply on capital returns can lead the resource monopolist to accelerate or postpone extraction while the influence on capital accumulation poses an incentive to accelerate extraction and to exploit the importers’ increased future resource dependence. Overall, in the reference calibration, the conventional conservationist bias of resource market power is reversed. The general-equilibrium supply motives substantially alter the resource monopolist’s reaction to more competitive capital-intensive resource substitutes, demonstrating the relevance of our observations for future technological change. Similarly, these supply motives may reverse the effects of a future tax on the exporting countries’ asset holdings.
records.abstract_cn: 向世界市场供应一种关键的耗竭性资源会在资本市场引发深远影响。通过采用一个包含国际贸易的两国模型，我们考察了具有垄断市场势力的资源丰富国家如何在其跨期开采决策中考虑与资本市场的这种相互作用。我们研究了由一般均衡反馈以及资源丰富国家的资本资产持有所产生的新供给动机。认识到资源供给对资本回报的影响可能导致资源垄断者加速或推迟开采，而对资本积累的影响则构成加速开采并利用进口国未来资源依赖性增强的激励。总体而言，在参考校准中，资源市场势力的传统保护主义偏向被逆转。一般均衡供给动机显著改变了资源垄断者对更具竞争性的资本密集型资源替代品的反应，这表明我们的观察对未来技术变革具有相关性。同样，这些供给动机可能逆转未来税收对出口国资产持有的影响。

records.title_en: Stochastic ordering of systemic risk in commodity markets
records.title_cn: 商品市场系统性风险的随机排序
records.abstract_en: The contribution of commodity risks to the systemic risk is assessed in this paper through a novel approach that relies on the stochastic property of concordance ordering of CoVaR. Considering the period that spans from 2005 to 2022 and the VIX as the proxy for the stability of the financial system, we build the stochastic ordering of systemic risk for 35 commodities belonging to four sectors: Agriculture, Energy, Industrial Metals, and Precious Metals. The estimates of the ΔCoVaR signal that contagion effects from commodity markets to the financial system have been stronger during the years 2017–2019. Backtests validate CoVaR as a more resilient risk measure than the VaR, especially during periods of market turmoils. The stochastic ordering of CoVaR shows that severe losses (downside risk) in commodity markets tend to exacerbate systemic financial distress more than gains (upside risk). Commodity risks arising from WTI and EUA are threatening triggers for systemic risk. In contrast, the financial system is less vulnerable to a broader range of scenarios arising from fluctuations in Gold prices. As top contributors to the systemic risk, among the sectors we find Energy and Precious Metals with respect to upside risk and downside risk. The Covid-19 crisis has deeply amplified the systemic influence arising from the downside risk of WTI, Gasoline, and Natural Gas UK and has confirmed the safe-haven role of Gold.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过一种依赖于CoVaR一致性排序的随机性质的新方法，评估了商品风险对系统性风险的贡献。考虑到从2005年到2022年的时期，并以VIX作为金融体系稳定性的代理指标，我们构建了属于四个部门（农业、能源、工业金属和贵金属）的35种商品的系统性风险随机排序。ΔCoVaR的估计表明，在2017-2019年期间，商品市场对金融体系的传染效应更为强烈。回测验证了CoVaR比VaR更具弹性的风险度量，尤其是在市场动荡时期。CoVaR的随机排序表明，商品市场的严重损失（下行风险）往往比收益（上行风险）更能加剧系统性金融困境。来自WTI和EUA的商品风险是系统性风险的威胁性触发因素。相比之下，金融体系对黄金价格波动引起的更广泛情景的脆弱性较低。作为系统性风险的主要贡献者，我们在部门中发现能源和贵金属分别对上行风险和下行风险贡献最大。Covid-19危机深刻放大了WTI、汽油和英国天然气下行风险带来的系统性影响，并确认了黄金的避险作用。

records.title_en: Trading, storage, or penalty? Uncovering firms' decision-making behavior in the Shanghai emissions trading scheme: Insights from agent-based modeling
records.title_cn: 交易、储存还是惩罚？揭示企业在上海碳排放交易体系中的决策行为：基于主体建模的见解
records.abstract_en: The emissions trading scheme (ETS) has become a flagship climatic initiative for regulating greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Under an ETS, the emitting firm must simultaneously deal with changing carbon prices and the number of permits and the trade-off between permit trading (if one should buy, sell, or reserve) and permit-consuming production. This study characterizes the different compliance strategies' trade-offs, logic, and options among regulated emitting firms under an ETS. Consequently, this study provides firm-level evidence of regulated firms' strategic responses under the Shanghai ETS, considering detailed firm information, heterogeneous industry characteristics, and ETS architects. The proposed model simulated the trading interactions among diversified firms to portray the firms' decision-making process, and the emergent effects on the ETS market were identified. The results indicate that: 1) the carbon price experiences a non-monotonic “L-shaped” trend, which maintains an initial low level and increases sharply after crossing a threshold; 2) with increasing carbon prices, the trading in ETS becomes more active, especially among the low-emission firms; 3) the current ETS penalty is too limited and generic, which inadequately induces technological development and carbon reduction among firms. Finally, policy suggestions are provided for future optimization of the ETS mechanism. Overall, this study contributes to operation management literature by evaluating decision-making behaviors in a dynamic environment. Our findings have global implications for policymakers and managers in the private sector.
records.abstract_cn: 碳排放交易体系（ETS）已成为调节温室气体（GHG）排放的旗舰气候倡议。在ETS下，排放企业必须同时应对变化的碳价格、配额数量以及配额交易（是否应购买、出售或储备）与消耗配额的生产之间的权衡。本研究刻画了ETS下受监管排放企业不同合规策略的权衡、逻辑和选择。因此，本研究提供了上海ETS下受监管企业战略响应的企业层面证据，考虑了详细的企业信息、异质性行业特征和ETS设计者。所提出的模型模拟了多元化企业之间的交易互动，以描绘企业的决策过程，并识别了对ETS市场的涌现效应。结果表明：1）碳价格经历非单调的“L形”趋势，初始保持较低水平，在超过阈值后急剧上升；2）随着碳价格上升，ETS中的交易变得更加活跃，尤其是在低排放企业中；3）当前ETS的惩罚过于有限和笼统，不足以诱导企业的技术发展和碳减排。最后，为未来ETS机制的优化提供了政策建议。总体而言，本研究通过评估动态环境中的决策行为，为运营管理文献做出了贡献。我们的发现对政策制定者和私营部门管理者具有全球意义。

records.title_en: Human capital and energy consumption: Six centuries of evidence from the United Kingdom
records.title_cn: 人力资本与能源消费：来自英国六个世纪的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between human capital and energy consumption in the United Kingdom employing time series data dating back to the beginning of the sixteenth century. We first employ traditional parametric methods to examine the long-run effects. We find a negative relationship between total human capital and energy consumption in the long run, with an additional year of schooling reducing energy consumption in the range 4–9%, depending on the identification method. Given that such a long time series contains non-linearities and structural shifts in the data, we investigate the non-linear properties and find a long-run relationship between human capital and energy consumption. We also relax the functional form assumptions and utilise local linear non-parametric regression. The results show a time-varying non-parametric link between human capital and energy consumption, although, consistent with the linear long-run estimates, the relationship is negative.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用可追溯至十六世纪初的时间序列数据，考察了英国人力资本与能源消费之间的关系。我们首先采用传统参数方法检验长期效应。我们发现，在长期中，总人力资本与能源消费之间存在负向关系，每增加一年的 schooling 会使能源消费减少 4-9%，具体取决于识别方法。鉴于如此长的时间序列包含非线性和结构性变化，我们研究了非线性性质，并发现人力资本与能源消费之间存在长期关系。我们还放宽了函数形式假设，并利用局部线性非参数回归。结果显示，人力资本与能源消费之间存在时变的非参数联系，尽管与线性长期估计一致，该关系为负向。

records.title_en: Co-volatility and asymmetric transmission of risks between the global oil and China's futures markets
records.title_cn: 全球石油与中国期货市场之间的共同波动性与风险的非对称传导
records.abstract_en: We construct a multivariate heterogeneous autoregressive model specified with common stochastic volatility and the student-t distribution, the MHAR-CSV-t model, to investigate co-movements and high-frequency volatility transmissions between the WTI futures market and China's stock and commodity futures markets. Additionally, we analyse the time-varying volatility connectedness between these markets. We find that between these markets, the WTI futures market features the most episodes of volatility spikes, particularly since 2014. We find several structural breaks in realised volatility and its decomposition in positive and negative volatility. The results of the time-varying volatility connectedness identify corn, gold, and equity futures as persistent transmitters; the copper futures market as a net receiver; and oil futures as assuming both roles in the spillovers of volatility shocks across markets. We also find significant asymmetries in their volatility decomposition and their spillovers across these markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个多元异质自回归模型，该模型设定为具有共同随机波动性和学生t分布，即MHAR-CSV-t模型，以研究WTI期货市场与中国股票和商品期货市场之间的共同运动和高频波动性传导。此外，我们分析了这些市场之间的时变波动性关联。我们发现，在这些市场之间，WTI期货市场具有最多的波动性尖峰事件，特别是自2014年以来。我们发现了已实现波动性及其正负波动性分解中的多个结构性断点。时变波动性关联的结果表明，玉米、黄金和股票期货是持续的传导者；铜期货市场是净接收者；而石油期货在跨市场的波动性冲击溢出中扮演了两种角色。我们还发现它们的波动性分解及其在这些市场间的溢出存在显著的非对称性。

records.title_en: An integrated model for crude oil forecasting: Causality assessment and technical efficiency
records.title_cn: 原油预测的综合模型：因果关系评估与技术效率
records.abstract_en: In light of the central role of crude oil in the economy and the complex mechanisms involved in forecasting crude oil prices, this study proposes a two-stage model that optimally selects driving predictors for crude oil price forecasting by integrating Granger causality test (GCT) and stochastic frontier analysis (SFA). In the first stage, GCT is used to perform causality assessments for 92 predictors across eight categories of factors (demand, supply, inventory, financial market, macroeconomy, economic policy uncertainty, geopolitical risk, and technical indicator). In the second stage, SFA is employed to assess the forecasting power of the preliminarily selected predictors in terms of technical efficiency by using multiple evaluation measures. By collecting a data sample which spans a 21-year period from January 1, 2000 to December 31, 2020, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study by employing rolling time window technique. The empirical results demonstrate that the two-stage model significantly outperforms eight competing models in terms of four forecasting techniques (linear regression, artificial neural network, support vector regression, and random forest). The proposed model's outperformance is robust to different time windows, different forecast horizons, alternative proxies of crude oil prices, and different business conditions. We also explore the time-varying characteristics of predictors for crude oil price forecasting and confirm that financial factors remain vital determinants affecting oil prices.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于原油在经济中的核心作用以及原油价格预测所涉及的复杂机制，本研究提出一个两阶段模型，通过整合格兰杰因果关系检验（GCT）和随机前沿分析（SFA）来最优选择原油价格预测的驱动预测因子。在第一阶段，使用GCT对八类因素（需求、供给、库存、金融市场、宏观经济、经济政策不确定性、地缘政治风险和技术指标）中的92个预测因子进行因果关系评估。在第二阶段，采用SFA，通过多种评估指标，从技术效率角度评估初步选定预测因子的预测能力。通过收集从2000年一月1日至2020年十二月31日跨越21年的数据样本，我们采用滚动时间窗口技术进行了全面的实证研究。实证结果表明，在四种预测技术（线性回归、人工神经网络、支持向量回归和随机森林）方面，两阶段模型显著优于八个竞争模型。所提出模型的优越性在不同时间窗口、不同预测期限、原油价格的替代指标以及不同商业条件下均具有稳健性。我们还探讨了原油价格预测因子的时变特征，并确认金融因素仍然是影响油价的重要决定因素。

records.title_en: Multivariable short-term electricity price forecasting using artificial intelligence and multi-input multi-output scheme
records.title_cn: 基于人工智能和多输入多输出结构的多元短期电价预测
records.abstract_en: In deregulated power markets, electricity price forecasting is the most valuable tool. However, with inherent electricity price characteristics, such as high frequency and volatility, constructing an electricity price forecasting model remains a difficult task for decision-makers and scholars. Accurate electricity price point forecasting (PF) can guide market participants in maximizing benefits. Moreover, appropriate interval forecasting (IF) can provide further information based on PF. Accordingly, a novel electricity price multi-bi-forecasting system using multivariable and multi-input multi-output structures is formulated. The system has three stages: data preprocessing, combination forecasting, and performance evaluation. The data preprocessing stage removes and smooths the high-frequency electricity price and load data. Because the load series has a more regular cycle and smoother fluctuation than the electricity price series, two variables, electricity price and load, are employed for forecasting using a multivariable data arrangement rolling forecast mechanism. In addition, a multi-input multi-output structure is utilized by three member models (back propagation, bidirectional long short-term memory, and gated recurrent unit) to derive PF and IF results concurrently. The final results are obtained using a combined strategy based on the multi-objective salp swarm algorithm. Finally, three experiments are conducted in the Australian electricity market to evaluate the proposed system quantitatively. Results show that the designed system has superior ability in forecasting electricity price and practical application in real situations.
records.abstract_cn: 在放松管制的电力市场中，电价预测是最有价值的工具。然而，由于电价固有的高频性和波动性等特点，构建电价预测模型对决策者和学者来说仍然是一项艰巨的任务。准确的电价点预测（PF）可以指导市场参与者实现收益最大化。此外，适当的区间预测（IF）可以在点预测的基础上提供进一步的信息。据此，提出了一种新的电价多双预测系统，采用多元和多输入多输出结构。该系统包括三个阶段：数据预处理、组合预测和性能评估。数据预处理阶段去除和平滑高频电价和负荷数据。由于负荷序列比电价序列具有更规则的周期和更平滑的波动，因此采用多元数据排列滚动预测机制，使用电价和负荷两个变量进行预测。此外，利用三个成员模型（反向传播、双向长短期记忆和门控循环单元）采用多输入多输出结构，同时得出点预测和区间预测结果。最终结果通过基于多目标樽海鞘群算法的组合策略获得。最后，在澳大利亚电力市场进行了三个实验，以定量评估所提出的系统。结果表明，所设计的系统在电价预测和实际应用方面具有优越的能力。

records.title_en: Do institutional investors facilitate corporate environmental innovation?
records.title_cn: 机构投资者是否促进企业环境创新？
records.abstract_en: This paper addresses whether institutional investors drive firms’ innovation direction toward environmentally friendly technologies. The data pertain to comprehensive environmental patents filed by Chinese publicly-listed firms in the manufacturing and public utility sectors during the 2003–2015 period. We find that institutional investors are associated with higher ratios of environmental patents in total patents for firms in the pollution-intensive sectors than those in the non-pollution-intensive sectors. Institutional investors exert the roles of financial support and corporate governance in pursuit of monitoring firms’ long-term sustainable innovation. They further facilitate the information disclosure on corporate social responsibility.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨机构投资者是否引导企业创新方向朝向环境友好型技术。数据涉及2003-2015年间中国制造业和公用事业部门上市公司申请的全面环境专利。我们发现，在污染密集型行业中，机构投资者与企业环境专利占总专利比例的提高相关，而在非污染密集型行业中则不然。机构投资者通过财务支持和公司治理的作用，追求监督企业的长期可持续创新。它们还进一步促进了企业社会责任的披露。

records.title_en: Screening for partial collusion in retail electricity markets
records.title_cn: 零售电力市场中的部分合谋筛查
records.abstract_en: Starting from a theoretical model of coalition formation, we analyse which price markers are more adequate to identify clues of partial cartels. Based on the theoretical model, we argue that measures of the shape of a distribution (such as kurtosis and skewness) can complement centrality measures (such as the mean and the dispersion of the distribution of prices) to screen for potential partial cartels. We apply these price markers to price data from the Norwegian retail electricity market.
records.abstract_cn: 从联盟形成的理论模型出发，我们分析了哪些价格标记更适合识别部分卡特尔线索。基于理论模型，我们认为分布形状的度量（如峰度和偏度）可以补充中心性度量（如价格分布的均值和离散度），以筛查潜在的部分卡特尔。我们将这些价格标记应用于挪威零售电力市场的价格数据。

records.title_en: Economic policy uncertainty and dynamic correlations in energy markets: Assessment and solutions
records.title_cn: 经济政策不确定性与能源市场的动态相关性：评估与解决方案
records.abstract_en: The objective of this study is twofold. On the one hand, we investigate the dynamic correlations among the energy, clean energy, crude oil, and carbon markets using a DCC-MIDAS specification. On the other hand, we check whether the Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) has had an impact on the cross-asset correlations under different market conditions using the Quantile-on-Quantile (QQ) technique. Further, we comparatively compare the hedging potential and diversification performance of these energy sources in a context of uncertainty. Accordingly, we, first, show that the connections among the four markets have time-varying characteristics with positive and negative alternating changes in most periods. Random events might cause ephemeral structural changes in correlations. Second, we identify different ways of hedging specific to the energy assets under consideration that provides an efficient risk management framework. Third, we find that the EPU has an asymmetrical and often a positive impact on energy cross-market linkages. Particularly, when macroeconomy facing high uncertainty, then markets become more inseparable.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究的目标有两个方面。一方面，我们使用DCC-MIDAS模型研究能源、清洁能源、原油和碳市场之间的动态相关性。另一方面，我们使用分位数对分位数（QQ）技术检验经济政策不确定性（EPU）在不同市场条件下是否对跨资产相关性产生影响。此外，我们在不确定性背景下比较了这些能源来源的对冲潜力和多元化表现。因此，我们首先表明，四个市场之间的联系具有时变特征，在大多数时期呈现正负交替变化。随机事件可能导致相关性的短暂结构性变化。其次，我们识别了针对所考虑的能源资产的不同对冲方式，这提供了有效的风险管理框架。第三，我们发现EPU对能源跨市场联动具有不对称且通常是正向的影响。特别是，当宏观经济面临高度不确定性时，市场变得更加不可分割。

records.title_en: Does digital finance matter for corporate green investment? Evidence from heavily polluting industries in China
records.title_cn: 数字金融对企业绿色投资有影响吗？来自中国重污染行业的证据
records.abstract_en: Green investment is an important way to strengthen pollution control and improve environmental quality. In the context of the rapid development of the digital economy, digital finance may be an important engine for corporate green investment. This study investigates the effect of digital finance development on corporate green investment based on data from heavily polluting industries in China from 2011 to 2020. The result suggests that digital finance greatly increases corporate green investment, and this finding still holds after a series of robustness tests. This is demonstrated by the fact that the coverage breadth and digitalization of digital finance significantly promote green investment. Digital finance mainly promotes green investment by stimulating intra-firm capital flows and intensifying market competition. The driving effects of digital finance on green investment are stronger in state-owned enterprises and in regions where environmental and financial regulations are more stringent. Our findings provide empirical inspiration for understanding how firms carry out environmental governance under the development of emerging financial market services.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色投资是加强污染控制、改善环境质量的重要途径。在数字经济快速发展的背景下，数字金融可能成为企业绿色投资的重要引擎。本研究基于2011年至2020年中国重污染行业的数据，考察了数字金融发展对企业绿色投资的影响。结果表明，数字金融显著增加了企业绿色投资，这一发现在一系列稳健性检验后仍然成立。这体现在数字金融的覆盖广度和数字化程度显著促进了绿色投资。数字金融主要通过刺激企业内部资本流动和加剧市场竞争来促进绿色投资。数字金融对绿色投资的驱动效应在国有企业以及环境规制和金融规制更为严格的地区更为显著。我们的研究结果为理解企业在新兴金融服务市场发展背景下如何进行环境治理提供了实证启示。

records.title_en: Resource development and governance declines: The case of the Chad–Cameroon petroleum pipeline
records.title_cn: 资源开发与治理衰退：乍得-喀麦隆石油管道案例
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the effects of the Chad–Cameroon Petroleum Development and Pipeline Project that allowed Chad to begin producing and exporting oil. The project was financed under heavy restrictions by the World Bank in an attempt to avert the resource curse. The majority of revenue from the resource was to be directed back into development programs with minimal government discretion. Using synthetic control matching and synthetic difference in differences, we find that oil production had immediate and persistent negative impacts on the quality of governance, increased GDP per capita, but had little lasting effects on measured development outcomes such as infant mortality and health spending. Our findings offer new empirical evidence for the political resource curse and suggest that the World Bank’s experiment to impose rules over management of resource rents was not sufficient to ensure widespread benefits from natural-resource wealth.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了乍得-喀麦隆石油开发与管道项目的影响，该项目使乍得得以开始生产和出口石油。该项目在世界银行的严格限制下融资，旨在避免资源诅咒。资源收入的大部分被指定用于发展项目，且政府自由裁量权极小。使用合成控制匹配和合成双重差分法，我们发现石油生产对治理质量产生了即时且持续的负面影响，提高了人均GDP，但对婴儿死亡率和卫生支出等可衡量的发展成果几乎没有持久影响。我们的发现为政治资源诅咒提供了新的经验证据，并表明世界银行对资源租金管理施加规则的实验不足以确保自然资源财富带来广泛利益。

records.title_en: Asymmetric effects of heterogeneous environmental standards on green technology innovation: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 异质性环境标准对绿色技术创新的不对称效应：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Exploring the asymmetric effects of heterogeneous environmental standards on green technology innovation can enrich the Porter hypothesis and play a vital role in transforming industrial production modes and promoting sustainable development. Based on the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development Technology Concordance, this study transforms the International Patent Classification (IPC)-based green patent data into provincial-industrial level green patent data during 2006–2015. Treating the implementation of cleaner production standards and pollution emission standards as a quasi-natural experiment, we employ the difference-in-differences (DID) and propensity score matching DID (PSM-DID) models to investigate the asymmetric effects of heterogeneous environmental standards on green technology innovation and examine the heterogeneous effects between different regions and industries. In addition, we use an interaction regression model to identify three influence mechanisms: market competition, foreign direct investment (FDI), and research and development (R&D) inputs. The results show that the green technology innovation effects of heterogeneous environmental standards are asymmetric. Cleaner production standards can significantly promote green technology innovation. However, pollution emission standards produce a significant inhibition effect on green technology innovation. After a series of robustness checks, such asymmetric effects are still evident. Moreover, the green technology innovation effects of cleaner production standards exhibit no heterogeneity at the regional and industrial levels. Nevertheless, the inhibitory effect of pollution emission standards on green technology innovation is confirmed in non-energy-intensive industries rather than in energy-intensive industries, indicating a significant heterogeneity at the industrial level. Concerning the influence mechanism, increasing market competition has advantages and disadvantages for the green technology innovation effects of cleaner production standards in eastern China and midwestern China, respectively. The pollution halo effect of FDI triggered by cleaner production standards exists in eastern China and non-energy-intensive industries. Cleaner production standards can stimulate green technology innovation by increasing R&D inputs. However, under the regulation of pollution emission standards in non-energy-intensive industries, R&D inputs are not conducive to green technology innovation.
records.abstract_cn: 探索异质性环境标准对绿色技术创新的不对称效应，可以丰富波特假说，并在转变工业生产模式和促进可持续发展方面发挥重要作用。基于经济合作与发展组织技术关联度，本研究将基于国际专利分类（IPC）的绿色专利数据转化为2006-2015年省级-产业层面的绿色专利数据。将清洁生产标准和污染排放标准的实施视为准自然实验，采用双重差分（DID）和倾向得分匹配双重差分（PSM-DID）模型，研究异质性环境标准对绿色技术创新的不对称效应，并检验不同地区和产业之间的异质性效应。此外，使用交互回归模型识别三种影响机制：市场竞争、外商直接投资（FDI）和研发（R&D）投入。结果表明，异质性环境标准的绿色技术创新效应是不对称的。清洁生产标准能显著促进绿色技术创新。然而，污染排放标准对绿色技术创新产生显著的抑制作用。经过一系列稳健性检验，这种不对称效应仍然明显。此外，清洁生产标准的绿色技术创新效应在地区和产业层面均未表现出异质性。然而，污染排放标准对绿色技术创新的抑制作用在非能源密集型产业中得到证实，而在能源密集型产业中不显著，表明在产业层面存在显著的异质性。关于影响机制，市场竞争的加剧对清洁生产标准的绿色技术创新效应在中国东部和中部西部地区分别具有利弊。清洁生产标准引发的FDI污染光环效应存在于东部地区和非能源密集型产业。清洁生产标准可以通过增加研发投入来刺激绿色技术创新。然而，在非能源密集型产业的污染排放标准规制下，研发投入不利于绿色技术创新。

records.title_en: Financial roles in green investment based on the quantile connectedness
records.title_cn: 基于分位数连通性的绿色投资中的金融角色
records.abstract_en: Green finance is critical to promoting carbon neutralisation and is an essential part of the carbon emission reduction policy framework. This paper applies quantile connectedness to analyze the overall situation and dynamic evolution of information spillover in the green and grey financial markets system and the financial roles in coordinating clean and traditional fossil fuels. The results show that fossil fuel is the primary source of risk in the information network, and their fluctuations have intensified the risk spillover effects in the system. The spillover level is more prominent in extreme cases, which means the information linkage in the system is integrated. The spillover effects of each variable fluctuate with time. In addition, green assets can be treated as a risk diversifier against fossil fuel investment shocks due to the weak connectedness in the average market. The risk infection path can provide a reference for governments to prevent the risk of infection in financial markets and guide the sustainability of the green investment.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色金融对于促进碳中和至关重要，并且是碳减排政策框架的重要组成部分。本文应用分位数连通性来分析绿色和灰色金融市场系统中信息溢出的总体情况和动态演变，以及协调清洁能源和传统化石燃料的金融角色。结果表明，化石燃料是信息网络中风险的主要来源，其波动加剧了系统中的风险溢出效应。在极端情况下，溢出水平更为显著，这意味着系统中的信息联系是整合的。各变量的溢出效应随时间波动。此外，由于平均市场中的弱连通性，绿色资产可以被视为对抗化石燃料投资冲击的风险分散工具。风险感染路径可以为政府提供参考，以防止金融市场中的风险感染，并引导绿色投资的可持续性。

records.title_en: Forecasting the real prices of crude oil: What is the role of parameter instability?
records.title_cn: 预测原油实际价格：参数不稳定性的作用是什么？
records.abstract_en: Parameter instability due to potential structural breaks is an important problem affecting out-of-sample forecasting performance of econometric models. This paper uses four types of methods addressing parameter instability, including rolling window, regime switching model, time-varying parameter model, and the time-dependent weighted least squares. The hyperparameters in each method which control the degree of parameter variation are determined via a simple machine learning approach of cross-validation and forecast combination. Our results show significant improvement in predictability of oil prices using these methods accounting for parameter instability except the rolling window method. Forecast combination for models with different hyperparameters produces more robust results than the cross-validation selecting the ex-ante optimal hyperparameters.
records.abstract_cn: 由潜在结构突变导致的参数不稳定性是影响计量经济模型样本外预测性能的一个重要问题。本文使用四类处理参数不稳定性的方法，包括滚动窗口、机制转换模型、时变参数模型以及时间依赖加权最小二乘法。每种方法中控制参数变化程度的超参数通过简单的机器学习方法——交叉验证和预测组合——来确定。我们的结果显示，除了滚动窗口方法外，使用这些考虑参数不稳定性的方法显著提高了油价的预测能力。对不同超参数的模型进行预测组合比通过交叉验证选择事前最优超参数产生更稳健的结果。

records.title_en: Nudging energy efficiency behavior: The effect of message framing on implicit discount rate
records.title_cn: 助推能源效率行为：信息框架对隐性贴现率的影响
records.abstract_en: We experimentally and empirically analyzed how gain-framing and loss-framing information regarding the economic benefits of purchasing a high-efficiency appliance affects consumers' implicit discount rate (IDR). For the empirical analysis, we focused on the South Korean air purifier market, and we used the contingent valuation method to estimate the IDR. The results suggest differences in consumer groups that respond more sensitively to message framing. In the loss frame, the respondents' cognition level showed an influence on the IDR. The median IDR was 10.15% and 6.59% in the gain and loss frames, respectively. These figures were higher than the general market discount rate, regardless of how the given information was framed, thus confirming an energy efficiency gap. We deduced that there are more consumers with a very low IDR in the loss frame than in the gain frame. Hence, it will be possible to reduce the energy efficiency investment gap and encourage consumers to voluntarily invest in energy efficiency through message framing nudging via consumption efficiency appliance labels.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验和实证分析，研究了关于购买高效电器经济收益的增益框架和损失框架信息如何影响消费者的隐性贴现率（IDR）。在实证分析中，我们聚焦于韩国空气净化器市场，并使用条件价值评估法来估计IDR。结果表明，对信息框架反应更敏感的消费者群体存在差异。在损失框架下，受访者的认知水平对IDR有影响。增益框架和损失框架下的中位数IDR分别为10.15%和6.59%。无论信息如何呈现，这些数值均高于一般市场贴现率，从而证实了能源效率差距的存在。我们推断，在损失框架下，IDR极低的消费者数量多于增益框架。因此，通过消费效率电器标签进行信息框架助推，有可能缩小能源效率投资差距，并鼓励消费者自愿投资于能源效率。

records.title_en: Temperature and corporate tax avoidance: Evidence from Chinese manufacturing firms
records.title_cn: 温度与企业避税：来自中国制造业企业的证据
records.abstract_en: This study estimates the effects of temperature on corporate tax avoidance in the context of climate change, using data from Chinese manufacturing firms. The firms exhibit increases in tax avoidance activities in response to high temperatures. We find that an additional day with temperature above 90 °F results in a 0.097 percentage-points decrease in effective tax rate (ETR), or 0.67% evaluated at the mean level, with effects concentrated on labor-intensive firms. We also find evidence that higher tax compliance can be a cover for tax avoidance activities in the previous year. This provides a possible way for tax authorities to detect tax noncompliance. In addition, we offer a comparatively new perspective to understand the undesirable impacts of climate change, that is, high temperatures can lead to opportunistic behaviors of firms. Using temperature, which is exogenous to the firms' policies, we also draw a more reliable causal inference regarding the effect of negative shocks on corporate tax avoidance.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国制造业企业的数据，估计了气候变化背景下温度对企业避税的影响。企业表现出在高温下避税活动增加的现象。我们发现，温度高于90华氏度的额外一天会导致有效税率（ETR）下降0.097个百分点，或在平均水平上评估为0.67%，且这种效应集中在劳动密集型企业。我们还发现证据表明，较高的税收合规性可能是对前一年避税活动的掩盖。这为税务机关检测税收不合规提供了一种可能的方法。此外，我们提供了一个相对较新的视角来理解气候变化的不利影响，即高温可能导致企业的机会主义行为。利用对企业政策外生的温度，我们也对负面冲击对企业避税的影响得出了更可靠的因果推断。

records.title_en: Green technology choices under the cap-and-trade mechanism with insurer green finance in a dragon-king environment
records.title_cn: 龙 King 环境下限额与交易机制与保险公司绿色金融下的绿色技术选择
records.abstract_en: The article investigates an insurer's green finance toward sustainability by explicitly capping borrowing-firm credit risk. The borrowing firms participate in the cap-and-trade mechanism and conduct green technology choices in a dragon-king environment due to confluent climate changes. The policy surrender incurs in the insurer's asset-liability matching management. The model can explore the effects of the borrowing-firm green trades and green technology choices on the insurer's performance. We show that the dragon-king impact and the policy surrender reduce the optimal guaranteed rate of the life insurance policies and policyholder protection. The stringent regulatory cap of the cap-and-trade mechanism decreases the insurer's profits and hurts policyholders. Green technology employed by the high‑carbon-emission borrowing firm reduces the insurer's profits; however, it helps protect policyholders, contributing to insurance stability. One implication is that the government might improve environmental sustainability directly through the borrowing-firm production rather than from the fund-providing perspective.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过明确限制借款企业信用风险，研究了保险公司对可持续发展的绿色金融支持。借款企业参与限额与交易机制，并在气候变化的汇聚影响下，在龙 King 环境中进行绿色技术选择。保单退保发生在保险公司的资产负债匹配管理中。该模型可以探讨借款企业绿色交易和绿色技术选择对保险公司绩效的影响。我们表明，龙 King 影响和保单退保降低了人寿保险单的最优保证利率和保单持有人保护。限额与交易机制的严格监管上限降低了保险公司的利润并损害了保单持有人。高碳排放借款企业采用的绿色技术降低了保险公司的利润；然而，它有助于保护保单持有人，促进保险稳定。一个启示是，政府可能直接通过借款企业的生产而非从资金提供角度来改善环境可持续性。

records.title_en: Energy market reforms in China and the time-varying connectedness of domestic and international markets
records.title_cn: 中国能源市场改革与国内外市场的时变关联性
records.abstract_en: China is the world's largest energy consumer and a considerable force in international energy markets. Continuous market reforms in the country together with the ongoing energy transition due to the commitment to carbon neutrality have brought fundamental changes to Chinese energy markets and have resulted in new sources of uncertainty in international energy markets. It is therefore important to investigate market linkages between China and the world from a dynamic perspective. This paper adopts the time-varying parameter VAR (TVP-VAR) model and the network spillover approach to explore the time-varying linkages between China and the international energy markets. The results show that the marketization process in China has led to significant changes in spillover patterns between international energy markets and Chinese domestic markets. Dynamics in the Chinese energy markets have played an increasingly important role in affecting international energy price movements. There is also clear evidence that the energy transition process in China has driven risk spillovers from the country to the international energy markets.
records.abstract_cn: 中国是全球最大的能源消费国，也是国际能源市场的重要力量。该国持续的市场改革以及因承诺碳中和而进行的能源转型，给中国能源市场带来了根本性变化，并在国际能源市场中产生了新的不确定性来源。因此，从动态角度研究中国与世界之间的市场联系十分重要。本文采用时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型和网络溢出方法，探讨中国与国际能源市场之间的时变联系。结果表明，中国的市场化进程导致了国际能源市场与中国国内市场之间溢出模式的显著变化。中国能源市场的动态在影响国际能源价格变动方面发挥了越来越重要的作用。也有明确证据表明，中国的能源转型过程推动了风险从该国向国际能源市场的溢出。

records.title_en: Carbon leakage in a small open economy: The importance of international climate policies
records.title_cn: 小型开放经济体中的碳泄漏：国际气候政策的重要性
records.abstract_en: A substantial literature investigates carbon leakage effects for large countries and climate coalitions. However, little is known about leakage effects for a small open economy within a climate coalition. To fill this gap in the literature, we incorporate international climate policies relevant for a small open EU economy into the general equilibrium model GTAP-E. We focus our analysis on Denmark, but we show that our framework can be applied to any EU economy. We find substantial leakage associated with an economy-wide CO2e tax. This result is strongly affected by EU climate policies. We also present sector-specific leakage rates and find large sectoral differences.
records.abstract_cn: 大量文献研究了大型国家和气候联盟的碳泄漏效应。然而，对于气候联盟内的小型开放经济体的泄漏效应知之甚少。为填补这一文献空白，我们将与小型开放欧盟经济体相关的国际气候政策纳入一般均衡模型GTAP-E。我们的分析聚焦于丹麦，但表明我们的框架可适用于任何欧盟经济体。我们发现，与全经济范围的CO2e税相关的泄漏显著。这一结果受到欧盟气候政策的强烈影响。我们还提供了部门特定的泄漏率，并发现部门间存在较大差异。

records.title_en: Race and energy poverty: The moderating role of subsidies in South Africa
records.title_cn: 种族与能源贫困：南非补贴的调节作用
records.abstract_en: Although energy poverty has recently gained wider attention, fewer efforts have been made to understand the race-energy poverty nexus, especially for developing economies. To contribute to the literature, our study analyzes the effect of race on multidimensional energy poverty while accounting for the moderating role of subsidies by utilizing the South African General Household Survey. The estimates show that Non-Whites, predominately Blacks are susceptible to energy poverty and experience about 11.5% energy poverty prevalence than their White counterparts. The result is consistent when other robust methods are applied. This difference is attributed to the level of discrimination Non-Whites face, as confirmed by the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition analysis. The decomposition analysis further showed that compensating Non-Whites would reduce their energy poverty prevalence by 17%. More so, the moderation analysis shows that the free basic electricity and social housing subsidies received by Non-Whites are generally ineffective in reducing their energy deprivation. Therefore, we urge policymakers to put measures in place to end the discrimination that comes with the allocation of subsidies, to facilitate the adoption of clean energy services among Non-Whites and eradicate energy poverty.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管能源贫困近来受到更广泛的关注，但关于种族与能源贫困之间关系的研究仍较少，尤其是在发展中经济体。为对文献做出贡献，本研究利用南非综合住户调查数据，分析了种族对多维能源贫困的影响，并考虑了补贴的调节作用。估计结果显示，非白人群体，主要是黑人，更容易遭受能源贫困，其能源贫困发生率比白人群体高出约11.5%。当采用其他稳健方法时，这一结果依然一致。这种差异归因于非白人群体面临的歧视程度，这一点已通过Oaxaca-Blinder分解分析得到证实。分解分析进一步表明，对非白人群体进行补偿将使其能源贫困发生率降低17%。此外，调节分析显示，非白人群体获得的免费基础电力和社会住房补贴在减少其能源匮乏方面总体无效。因此，我们敦促政策制定者采取措施，消除补贴分配中的歧视，促进非白人群体采用清洁能源服务，并消除能源贫困。

records.title_en: On the volatility of WTI crude oil prices: A time-varying approach with stochastic volatility
records.title_cn: WTI原油价格波动性研究：基于随机波动率的时变方法
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the impacts of crude oil-market-specific fundamental factors and financial indicators on the realized volatility of West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil price. A time-varying parameter vector autoregression model with stochastic volatility (TVP-VAR-SV) is applied to weekly data series spanning January 2008 to October 2021. It is found that the WTI oil price volatility responds positively to a shock in oil production, oil inventories, the US dollar index, and VIX but negatively to a shock in the US economic activity. The response to the EPU index was initially positive and then turned slightly negative before fading away. The VIX index has the most significant effect. Furthermore, the time-varying nature of the response of the WTI realized oil price volatility is evident. Extreme effects materialize during economic recessions and crises, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic. The findings can improve our understanding of the time-varying nature and determinants of WTI oil price volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了原油市场特定基本面因素和金融指标对西德克萨斯中质原油（WTI）价格已实现波动率的影响。采用具有随机波动率的时变参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VAR-SV），应用于2008年一月至2021年十月的周度数据序列。研究发现，WTI原油价格波动率对石油产量、石油库存、美元指数和VIX指数的冲击呈正向响应，而对美国经济活动的冲击呈负向响应。对EPU指数的响应最初为正，随后转为轻微负值，最终逐渐消失。VIX指数的影响最为显著。此外，WTI已实现原油价格波动率响应的时变特性明显。极端效应在经济衰退和危机期间显现，尤其是在COVID-19大流行期间。这些发现有助于加深我们对WTI原油价格波动率的时变特性及其决定因素的理解。

records.title_en: The hidden benefit: Emission trading scheme and business performance of downstream enterprises
records.title_cn: 隐藏的益处：排放交易计划与下游企业绩效
records.abstract_en: There seems to be no empirical study on the impact of emission trading scheme (ETS) on downstream industries. However, carbon trading may affect the performance of downstream firms via cost effect or spillover effect through the industrial chain. Based on the data of listed companies, this paper innovatively constructs three-dimensional data of “upstream firm - downstream firm - time”, with a total of 40,437,001 valid observations, simulates the upstream and downstream relationship between enterprises, and estimates the impact of carbon trading on the downstream performance using the Pair Weighted Difference in Difference in Difference (PW-DDD) model. The results show that the effects of carbon trading on downstream performance is negative in the short run, but it has positive significance in the long run. Heterogeneity is also found: the downstream firms with significant industrial chain relationships are more positively affected, such as chemical, petrochemical, and cement. In addition, carbon trading may improve productivity in different sectors in the same region or the same industry in other areas, thus improving the performance of non-ETS-covered enterprises.
records.abstract_cn: 目前似乎没有关于排放交易计划（ETS）对下游行业影响的实证研究。然而，碳交易可能通过成本效应或产业链的溢出效应影响下游企业的绩效。基于上市公司数据，本文创新性地构建了“上游企业-下游企业-时间”的三维数据，共包含40,437,001个有效观测值，模拟了企业间的上下游关系，并使用配对加权三重差分（PW-DDD）模型估计了碳交易对下游绩效的影响。结果表明，碳交易对下游绩效的影响在短期内为负，但在长期内具有正向显著性。研究还发现了异质性：具有显著产业链关系的下游企业受到更积极的影响，如化工、石化和水泥行业。此外，碳交易可能提高同一地区不同部门或其他地区同一行业的生产率，从而改善未纳入ETS企业的绩效。

records.title_en: Macroeconomic consequences of stay-at-home policies during the COVID-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: COVID-19疫情期间居家政策对宏观经济的影响
records.abstract_en: Risks related to the coronavirus infection differ significantly across the age and the health status of individuals which suggest lockdowns targeting the unhealthy could reduce the fatalities due to the pandemic. In addition, labor productivities differ significantly across these groups, which suggest the economic consequences of targeted lockdowns could be quite different. Using an overlapping generations model with rich heterogeneity, we show that a targeted lockdown policy based on preexisting health status would have reduced the economic severity of the pandemic by 43% compared to a random lockdown. A simple system where government transfers are paid to those who stay home, financed by lump-sum taxes, could have achieved results similar to this health based lockdown.
records.abstract_cn: 与冠状病毒感染相关的风险因个体的年龄和健康状况而有显著差异，这表明针对不健康人群的封锁可以减少疫情造成的死亡。此外，这些群体之间的劳动生产率也存在显著差异，这表明针对性封锁的经济后果可能大不相同。使用一个具有丰富异质性的重叠世代模型，我们表明，基于既有健康状况的针对性封锁政策相比随机封锁，可以将疫情的经济严重程度降低43%。一个简单的系统，即政府向留在家中的人支付转移支付，并通过一次性税收融资，可以实现与基于健康的封锁类似的结果。

records.title_en: The long-run effects of risk: an equilibrium approach
records.title_cn: 风险的长期效应：一种均衡方法
records.abstract_en: Advanced economies tend to have large financial sectors which can be vulnerable to crises. We employ a DSGE model with banks featuring limited liability to investigate how risk shocks in the financial sector affect long-run macroeconomic outcomes. With full deposit insurance, banks expand balance sheets when risk increases, leading to higher investment and output. With no deposit insurance, we observe substantial drops in long-run credit provision, investment, and output. Reducing moral hazard by lowering the fraction of reimbursed deposits in case of bank default increases the probability of bank default in equilibrium. The long-run probability of bank default under a regime with no deposit insurance is more than 50% higher than under a regime with full deposit insurance for high levels of risk. These differences provide a novel argument in favor of deposit insurance. Our welfare analysis finds that increased risk always reduces welfare, except when there is full deposit insurance and deadweight costs from default are small.
records.abstract_cn: 发达经济体往往拥有庞大的金融部门，这些部门可能容易受到危机的影响。我们采用一个具有银行有限责任的DSGE模型，研究金融部门的风险冲击如何影响长期宏观经济结果。在完全存款保险下，当风险增加时，银行扩张资产负债表，导致投资和产出增加。在没有存款保险的情况下，我们观察到长期信贷供给、投资和产出大幅下降。通过降低银行违约时存款报销比例来减少道德风险，会增加均衡中银行违约的概率。在没有存款保险的制度下，对于高风险水平，银行违约的长期概率比完全存款保险制度下高出超过50%。这些差异为存款保险提供了新的论据。我们的福利分析发现，增加风险总是降低福利，除非存在完全存款保险且违约的沉没成本较小。

records.title_en: Bank capital requirement shocks: A narrative perspective
records.title_cn: 银行资本要求冲击：叙事视角
records.abstract_en: We provide new estimates of the impact of shocks to bank capital requirements on lending supply and macroeconomic activity based on a Bayesian VAR estimated on Italian data and identified combining sign and narrative restrictions. Narrative restrictions are based on the EBA 2011 Stress Test (ST) and the ECB 2014 Comprehensive Assessment (CA) and are corroborated by evidence from the Euro Area Bank Lending Survey. IRFs show that shocks to required capital persistently reduce R.W.A. and loan supply and lead to a temporary decline in GDP. Based on historical decomposition, the ST and the CA increased banks’ Tier 1 ratio by 40 bps and determined a contraction in loan supply and GDP after two years of up to 1.5% and 0.5%, respectively. Results are robust to using alternative narrative restrictions and hold also when controlling for market pressure during the sovereign debt crisis and for global shocks to bank capitalization.
records.abstract_cn: 我们根据对意大利数据进行的贝叶斯 VAR 估计，并结合符号和叙述限制，对银行资本要求冲击对贷款供应和宏观经济活动的影响提供了新的估计。叙述限制基于 EBA 2011 压力测试 (ST) 和欧洲央行 2014 综合评估 (CA)，并得到欧元区银行贷款调查证据的证实。 IRF 显示，对所需资本的冲击会持续降低 R.W.A.和贷款供应，导致 GDP 暂时下降。根据历史分解，ST和CA将银行的Tier 1比率提高了40个基点，并确定贷款供应和GDP在两年后分别收缩至1.5%和0.5%。使用替代叙述限制的结果是稳健的，并且在控制主权债务危机期间的市场压力和银行资本化的全球冲击时也成立。

records.title_en: Optimal regional labor market policies
records.title_cn: 最优区域劳动力市场政策
records.abstract_en: We document large and persistent spatial dispersion in unemployment rates, vacancies, labor market tightness, labor market flows, and wages for Germany on a granular regional level. We find that both differences in inflows into and in outflows from unemployment are important for accounting for the regional dispersion in unemployment rates. Within a search- and matching model with risk-averse agents, moral hazard, endogenous separations and free mobility we show that an optimal policy response to labor market dispersion requires a place-based tax and unemployment insurance system together with place-based policies conditioning on labor market flows. We allow regions to differ along multiple dimensions and characterize the trade-offs between insurance, regional redistribution and efficiency quantitatively. We find that for Germany a move towards an optimal place-based tax system that explicitly conditions on regional characteristics could lead to sizeable welfare and employment gains.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了德国在细粒度区域层面上失业率、职位空缺、劳动力市场紧张程度、劳动力市场流动和工资的巨大且持续的空间分散性。我们发现，失业流入和流出的差异对于解释失业率的区域分散性都很重要。在一个包含风险厌恶代理人、道德风险、内生分离和自由流动的搜索与匹配模型中，我们表明，对劳动力市场分散性的最优政策响应需要基于地方的税收和失业保险体系，以及基于劳动力市场流动的地方性政策。我们允许区域在多个维度上存在差异，并在数量上刻画保险、区域再分配和效率之间的权衡。我们发现，对于德国而言，转向一个明确基于区域特征的最优地方税收体系可能带来可观的福利和就业收益。

records.title_en: Who should bear the burden of COVID-19 related fiscal pressure? An optimal income taxation perspective
records.title_cn: 谁应承担COVID-19相关财政压力的负担？最优所得税视角
records.abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to an increase in public debt in most countries, and the Ukraine war is likely to have similar effects. This will increase fiscal pressure in the future. We study how the shape of the optimal nonlinear income tax schedule is affected by this increase. We calibrate the workhorse optimal income tax model to five European countries: France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the UK. Applying an inverse-optimum approach to the pre COVID-19 economies we obtain the Pareto weights implicitly applied by the different countries. We then ask how the schedule of marginal and average tax rates should be optimally adjusted to the increase in fiscal pressure. For all countries, we find that the increase in fiscal pressure leads to a less progressive optimal tax schedule both in terms of marginal and average tax rates.
