records.abstract_cn: COVID-19大流行导致大多数国家公共债务增加，乌克兰战争可能产生类似影响。这将增加未来的财政压力。我们研究最优非线性所得税表形状如何受到这种增加的影响。我们将标准最优所得税模型校准到五个欧洲国家：法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国。对COVID-19前经济体应用逆最优方法，我们获得了各国隐含应用的帕累托权重。然后我们询问边际税率和平均税率表应如何最优调整以应对财政压力的增加。对所有国家，我们发现财政压力的增加导致最优税收表在边际税率和平均税率方面都变得不那么累进。

records.title_en: Communicating Monetary Policy Rules
records.title_cn: 沟通货币政策规则
records.abstract_en: Despite the ubiquity of inflation targeting, central banks communicate their frameworks in a variety of ways. No central bank explicitly expresses their conduct via a policy rule, which contrasts with models of policy. Central banks often connect theory with practice by publishing inflation forecasts that can, in principle, implicitly convey their reaction function. We return to this central idea to show how a central bank can achieve the gains of a rule-based policy without publicly stating a specific rule. The approach requires central banks to specify an inflation target, inflation tolerance bands, and provide economic projections. When inflation moves outside the band, inflation forecasts provide a time frame over which inflation will return to within the band. We show how this communication replicates and provides the same information as a rule-based policy. The communication strategy produces a natural benchmark for assessing central bank performance. We illustrate these features in a counterfactual monetary policy history of the United States.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管通胀目标制无处不在，中央银行以各种方式沟通其框架。没有中央银行明确地通过政策规则来表达其行为，这与政策模型形成对比。中央银行通常通过发布通胀预测来连接理论与实践，这些预测原则上可以隐含地传达其反应函数。我们回到这一核心思想，展示中央银行如何在不公开陈述具体规则的情况下实现基于规则的政策的收益。该方法要求中央银行明确通胀目标、通胀容忍区间，并提供经济预测。当通胀偏离区间时，通胀预测提供了通胀回归区间内的时间框架。我们展示了这种沟通如何复制并提供与基于规则的政策相同的信息。该沟通策略为评估中央银行绩效提供了一个自然基准。我们在美国的一个反事实货币政策历史中说明了这些特征。

records.title_en: Uncertain policy regimes and government spending effects
records.title_cn: 不确定的政策体制与政府支出效应
records.abstract_en: Money financing returns to policy debate as governments around the world adopted massive fiscal measures during the pandemic. Using a fully nonlinear New Keynesian model with endogenous policy regime switching, we show that a moderate inflation-driven switching probability to a debt-financing regime reduces money-financed spending multipliers. When interacted with high government debt, money-financed spending multipliers fall below one, similar to the size of debt-financed spending multipliers. This result holds at the zero lower bound, with long-term government debt, and under a wide range of key parameter values. Policy regime uncertainty, on the other hand, has little effect on debt-financed spending multipliers.
records.abstract_cn: 随着世界各国在疫情期间采取大规模财政措施，货币融资重新回到政策辩论中。使用一个具有内生政策体制转换的完全非线性新凯恩斯模型，我们表明，适度的通胀驱动的向债务融资体制转换的概率会降低货币融资的支出乘数。当与高政府债务相互作用时，货币融资的支出乘数降至一以下，与债务融资的支出乘数规模相似。这一结果在零下限、长期政府债务以及广泛的关键参数值下均成立。另一方面，政策体制不确定性对债务融资的支出乘数影响甚微。

records.title_en: Giving to the children or the taxman?
records.title_cn: 给子女还是给税务局？
records.abstract_en: Wealth transfer tax systems based on inheritances and inter vivos gifts, rather than estates, allow donors to shift wealth among potential recipients with the goal of minimizing tax burdens. However, tax minimization often requires the donor to give up control over wealth if the transfers are made as inter vivos. Usually, such behavior is difficult to analyze as many potential heirs and many different tax schedules are involved. In this article, we study a simple setting that allows us to obtain transparent and credible evidence of inheritance tax responses. Swedish heirs could easily lower their inheritance tax bills to zero by giving part of the inheritance to their children. Using detailed administrative data, we show that many heirs tax minimized in a precise fashion. Still, among those inheriting just above the exemption, only about a half avoided the tax. Preferences for holding wealth and information seem to play major roles. Our findings have general policy relevance, because similar (but more complex) tax avoidance strategies can be used to avoid any inheritance tax.
records.abstract_cn: 基于继承和生前赠与而非遗产的财富转移税制度，允许捐赠者在潜在受赠者之间转移财富，以最小化税收负担。然而，税收最小化通常要求捐赠者在进行生前转移时放弃对财富的控制。通常，由于涉及许多潜在继承人和不同的税率表，这种行为难以分析。在本文中，我们研究了一个简单的设定，使我们能够获得关于遗产税反应的透明且可信的证据。瑞典继承人可以通过将部分遗产赠予子女，轻松将遗产税降至零。利用详细的行政数据，我们表明许多继承人精确地进行了税收最小化。尽管如此，在继承额略高于免税额的人群中，只有约一半避免了税收。持有财富的偏好和信息似乎起着重要作用。我们的发现具有普遍的政策相关性，因为类似的（但更复杂的）避税策略可用于规避任何遗产税。

records.title_en: Economic forecasting with an agent-based model
records.title_cn: 基于主体模型的经济预测
records.abstract_en: We develop the first agent-based model (ABM) that can compete with benchmark VAR and DSGE models in out-of-sample forecasting of macro variables. Our ABM for a small open economy uses micro and macro data from national accounts, sector accounts, input–output tables, government statistics, and census and business demography data. The model incorporates all economic activities as classified by the European System of Accounts (ESA 2010) and includes all economic sectors populated with millions of heterogeneous agents. In addition to being a competitive model framework for forecasts of aggregate variables, the detailed structure of the ABM allows for a breakdown into sector-level forecasts. Using this detailed structure, we demonstrate the ABM by forecasting the medium-run macroeconomic effects of lockdown measures taken in Austria to combat the COVID-19 pandemic. Potential applications of the model include stress-testing and predicting the effects of monetary or fiscal macroeconomic policies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了第一个能够在宏观变量的样本外预测中与基准VAR和DSGE模型竞争的主体模型（ABM）。我们的ABM针对一个小型开放经济体，使用来自国民账户、部门账户、投入产出表、政府统计以及人口普查和商业人口统计数据中的微观和宏观数据。该模型包含了欧洲账户体系（ESA 2010）分类的所有经济活动，并包括所有经济部门，其中填充了数百万个异质主体。除了作为聚合变量预测的竞争性模型框架外，ABM的详细结构还允许分解为部门级预测。利用这一详细结构，我们通过预测奥地利为应对COVID-19大流行而采取的封锁措施的中期宏观经济影响来展示ABM。该模型的潜在应用包括压力测试和预测货币或财政宏观经济政策的影响。

records.title_en: How communication makes the difference between a cartel and tacit collusion: A machine learning approach
records.title_cn: 沟通如何区分卡特尔与默契合谋：一种机器学习方法
records.abstract_en: This paper sheds new light on the role of communication for cartel formation. Using machine learning to evaluate free-form chat communication among firms in a laboratory experiment, we identify typical communication patterns for both explicit cartel formation and indirect attempts to collude tacitly. We document that firms are less likely to communicate explicitly about price fixing and more likely to use indirect messages when sanctioning institutions are present. This effect of sanctions on communication reinforces the direct cartel-deterring effect of sanctions as collusion is more difficult to reach and sustain without an explicit agreement. Indirect messages have no, or even a negative, effect on prices.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为沟通在卡特尔形成中的作用提供了新的视角。通过使用机器学习评估实验室实验中企业间的自由格式聊天沟通，我们识别了明确卡特尔形成和间接尝试默契合谋的典型沟通模式。我们记录到，当存在制裁机构时，企业更不可能明确沟通价格固定，而更可能使用间接信息。制裁对沟通的这种影响强化了制裁的直接威慑卡特尔效应，因为在没有明确协议的情况下，合谋更难达成和维持。间接信息对价格没有影响，甚至可能产生负面影响。

records.title_en: Measuring macroeconomic uncertainty: A cross-country analysis
records.title_cn: 衡量宏观经济不确定性：一项跨国分析
records.abstract_en: This paper constructs internationally consistent measures of macroeconomic uncertainty. Our econometric framework extracts uncertainty from revisions in data obtained from standardized national accounts. Applying our model to post-WWII real-time data, we estimate macroeconomic uncertainty for 39 countries. The cross-country dimension of our uncertainty data allows us to study the impact of uncertainty shocks under varying degrees of employment protection legislation. Our empirical findings suggest that the effects of uncertainty shocks are stronger and more persistent in countries with low employment protection compared to countries with high employment protection. These empirical findings are in line with a theoretical model under varying firing cost.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了国际一致的宏观经济不确定性度量。我们的计量经济学框架从标准化国民账户数据的修订中提取不确定性。将我们的模型应用于二战后实时数据，我们估算了39个国家的宏观经济不确定性。我们不确定性数据的跨国维度使我们能够研究在不同程度的就业保护立法下不确定性冲击的影响。我们的实证发现表明，与高就业保护国家相比，低就业保护国家的不确定性冲击效应更强且更持久。这些实证发现与不同解雇成本下的理论模型一致。

records.title_en: Taxation and the transfer of patents: Evidence from Europe
records.title_cn: 税收与专利转让：来自欧洲的证据
records.abstract_en: I study how taxes affect firms’ incentives to shift the location of intangible assets. Using firm-level data on patent reassignments, I exploit variations in statutory tax rates and the introduction of “patent box” policies as shocks modifying incentives to transfer patents across countries. The results suggest a large impact of taxes on asset shifting between affiliates, increasing with expected patent income, and driven by very large firms. Patent boxes are persistently associated with more incoming and less outgoing patent relocations between affiliates. These findings suggest that taxes provide firms with incentives to shift income via patent relocation, and advocate for considering patent transfer strategies in tax policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了税收如何影响企业转移无形资产位置的激励。利用企业层面的专利重新转让数据，我利用法定税率的变化和“专利盒”政策的引入作为冲击，这些冲击改变了跨国转移专利的激励。结果表明，税收对关联企业之间的资产转移有显著影响，这种影响随着预期专利收入的增加而增大，并且由非常大的企业驱动。专利盒政策持续地与关联企业之间更多的专利流入和更少的专利流出相关。这些发现表明，税收为企业通过专利转移来转移收入提供了激励，并主张在税收政策中考虑专利转移策略。

records.title_en: FDI and onshore job stability: Upgrades, downgrades, and separations in multinationals
records.title_cn: 外商直接投资与国内就业稳定性：跨国公司的职位升级、降级与离职
records.abstract_en: We use linked employer–employee data to estimate the impact of firms’ foreign direct investment (FDI) into a low-wage country on workers’ job stability in a high-wage country. We are the first to consider internal (i.e., within-firm) job transitions. Specifically, we examine the impact of German firms’ FDI into the Czech Republic on the likelihood of onshore employees up- or downgrading to occupations that are more or less intensive in analytical and interactive tasks. To do so, we match firms with similar investing probabilities. We use this sample to estimate proportional hazards models to retrieve the dynamic effects on workers. We find that FDI increases the average likelihood of upgrades and downgrades by 17% and 19%, respectively. These effects are the strongest for jobs with low shares of nonroutine and interactive tasks, and they increase over time. They become substantial two years after the investment and reach 32%–46% and 35%–48%, respectively. FDI does not increase the hazard of worker–firm separations. Our results highlight the importance of internal firm restructuring, which enables firms to satisfy their altered domestic labor needs after FDI.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用关联的雇主-雇员数据来估计企业对低工资国家进行外商直接投资（FDI）对高工资国家工人就业稳定性的影响。我们是首个考虑内部（即企业内）职位转换的研究。具体而言，我们考察了德国企业对捷克共和国的FDI对国内员工晋升或降级至分析性和互动性任务强度更高或更低职业的可能性的影响。为此，我们将具有相似投资概率的企业进行匹配。我们使用该样本估计比例风险模型以获取对工人的动态效应。我们发现，FDI使职位升级和降级的平均可能性分别增加了17%和19%。这些效应在非日常性和互动性任务占比较低的工作中最为显著，并随时间推移而增强。在投资两年后，这些效应变得显著，分别达到32%–46%和35%–48%。FDI并未增加工人-企业离职的风险。我们的结果凸显了企业内部重组的重要性，这使得企业能够在FDI后满足其改变后的国内劳动力需求。

records.title_en: Estimating the euro area output gap using multivariate information and addressing the COVID-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: 利用多元信息估计欧元区产出缺口并应对COVID-19疫情
records.abstract_en: We estimate the euro area output gap by applying the Beveridge–Nelson decomposition based on a large Bayesian vector autoregression. Our approach incorporates multivariate information through the inclusion of a wide range of variables in the analysis and addresses data issues associated with the COVID-19 pandemic. The estimated output gap lines up well with the CEPR chronology of the business cycle for the euro area and we find that hours worked, more than the unemployment rate, provides the key source of information about labor utilization in the economy, especially in pinning down the depth of the output gap during the COVID-19 recession when the unemployment rate rose only moderately. Our findings confirm that labor market adjustments to the business cycle in the euro area occur more through the intensive, rather than extensive, margin.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过应用基于大型贝叶斯向量自回归的贝弗里奇-纳尔逊分解来估计欧元区产出缺口。我们的方法通过将广泛变量纳入分析来整合多元信息，并处理与COVID-19疫情相关的数据问题。估计的产出缺口与欧元区商业周期的CEPR年表吻合良好，我们发现工作时间而非失业率提供了经济中劳动力利用的关键信息来源，尤其是在COVID-19衰退期间，当时失业率仅温和上升，工作时间在确定产出缺口深度方面尤为重要。我们的研究结果证实，欧元区劳动力市场对商业周期的调整更多通过集约边际而非广延边际发生。

records.title_en: The value of sick pay
records.title_cn: 病假工资的价值
records.abstract_en: Not all countries provide universal access to publicly funded paid sick pay. Amongst countries that do, compensation rates can be low and coverage incomplete. This leaves a significant role for employer-provided paid sick pay in many countries. In this paper, we study who has access to employer-provided sick pay and how much it is valued by workers for themselves and others. We find that workers in jobs with high contact to others are particularly unlikely to have employer provided sick pay, as are economically insecure workers who are least able to afford unpaid time off work. We find that workers without sick pay are more likely to say that they will work when experiencing cold-like symptoms and are less willing to expose themselves to health risks at work during the pandemic. Using vignettes, we reveal that large shares of workers have a very high, but even more have a very low willingness to sacrifice earnings for access to sick pay. Together our findings highlight the unequal distribution of access to sick pay and the potentially strong negative externalities of not providing it publicly. The pandemic may have made these issues more salient as perceived probabilities of having to self-isolate are positively related to support for publicly provided sick pay. Finally, we find that providing information on the health externality of paid sick leave increases support for the public provision of sick pay, suggesting that there might be a public under-provision because individuals do not factor in the externalities.
records.abstract_cn: 并非所有国家都提供普遍享有的公共资助带薪病假。在提供此类津贴的国家中，补偿率可能较低且覆盖范围不完整。这使得在许多国家，雇主提供的带薪病假扮演着重要角色。在本文中，我们研究了谁能够获得雇主提供的病假工资，以及工人对自己和他人的重视程度。我们发现，与他人接触较多的工作岗位上的工人特别不可能获得雇主提供的病假工资，经济上不安全的工人也是如此，他们最无力承担无薪休假。我们发现，没有病假工资的工人更有可能表示在出现感冒症状时会继续工作，并且在疫情期间更不愿意在工作中暴露于健康风险。通过情景实验，我们揭示出很大比例的工人对牺牲收入换取病假工资的意愿非常高，但更多的人意愿非常低。我们的发现共同凸显了病假工资获取的不平等分配，以及不公开提供病假工资可能带来的强烈负面外部性。疫情可能使这些问题更加突出，因为感知到的自我隔离概率与对公共提供病假工资的支持呈正相关。最后，我们发现提供关于带薪病假健康外部性的信息会增加对公共提供病假工资的支持，这表明可能存在公共供给不足，因为个人没有将外部性考虑在内。

records.title_en: Optimal monetary policy with the risk-taking channel
records.title_cn: 考虑风险承担渠道的最优货币政策
records.abstract_en: Empirical research suggests that lower interest rates induce banks to take higher risks. We assess analytically what this risk-taking channel implies for optimal monetary policy in a tractable New Keynesian model. We show that this channel creates a motive for the planner to stabilize the real rate. This objective conflicts with the standard inflation stabilization objective. Optimal policy thus tolerates more inflation volatility. An inertial Taylor-type reaction function becomes optimal. We then quantify the significance of the risk-taking channel for monetary policy in an estimated medium-scale extension of the model. Ignoring the channel when designing policy entails non-negligible welfare costs (0.7% lifetime consumption equivalent).
records.abstract_cn: 实证研究表明，较低的利率会促使银行承担更高的风险。我们在一个易于处理的New Keynesian模型中，从分析上评估了这一风险承担渠道对最优货币政策的影响。我们证明，该渠道为政策制定者创造了稳定实际利率的动机。这一目标与标准的通胀稳定目标相冲突。因此，最优政策容忍更高的通胀波动性。惯性泰勒型反应函数成为最优选择。然后，我们在模型的估计中等规模扩展中量化了风险承担渠道对货币政策的重要性。在设计政策时忽略该渠道会带来不可忽视的福利成本（相当于终身消费的0.7%）。

records.title_en: Discrimination and sorting in the real estate market: Evidence from terrorist attacks and mosques
records.title_cn: 房地产市场中的歧视与分类：来自恐怖袭击和清真寺的证据
records.abstract_en: I evaluate the impact of Islamist terrorist attacks, taken as exogenous shocks which may change individual perceptions towards Middle Easterners and Muslims, on the real-estate market. Using detailed property-level transactions data, I find that US property prices immediately near mosques fell by 5% in the two years following 9/11. I find little evidence of changes in the number of transactions, but an increase of up to 30% in the fraction of Middle Eastern and North African households locating near mosques, indicating increased ethnic and religious sorting from 9/11. Additional evidence suggests that price decreases across areas are in line with increased prejudice.
records.abstract_cn: 我评估了伊斯兰恐怖袭击（被视为可能改变个人对中东人和穆斯林看法的外生冲击）对房地产市场的影响。利用详细的房产层面交易数据，我发现9/11事件后的两年内，紧邻清真寺的美国房产价格下跌了5%。我几乎没有发现交易数量变化的证据，但发现靠近清真寺的中东和北非家庭比例增加了高达30%，这表明9/11事件后种族和宗教分类加剧。额外证据表明，各地区的价格下降与偏见增加相一致。

records.title_en: The state of hiring discrimination: A meta-analysis of (almost) all recent correspondence experiments
records.title_cn: 招聘歧视的现状：对（几乎）所有近期通信实验的元分析
records.abstract_en: Notwithstanding the improved integration of various minority groups in the workforce, unequal treatment in hiring still hinders many individuals’ access to the labour market. To tackle this inaccessibility, it is essential to know which and to what extent minority groups face hiring discrimination. This meta-analysis synthesises a quasi-exhaustive register of correspondence experiments on hiring discrimination published between 2005 and 2020. Using a random-effects model, we computed pooled discrimination ratios concerning ten discrimination grounds upon which unequal treatment in hiring is forbidden by law. Our meta-analysis shows that hiring discrimination against candidates with disabilities, older candidates, and less physically attractive candidates seems equally severe as the unequal treatment of candidates with salient racial or ethnic characteristics. Moreover, hiring discrimination against older applicants is more prominent in Europe than in the United States. Last, while we initially find a significant decrease in ethnic hiring discrimination in (Western) Europe, we find no structural evidence of recent temporal changes in hiring discrimination when controlling for the minority groups considered, at the country level, or based on the various other grounds within the scope of this review.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管各少数群体在劳动力市场中的融入有所改善，但招聘中的不平等对待仍阻碍许多个人进入劳动力市场。为解决这一不可及性问题，了解哪些少数群体面临招聘歧视及其程度至关重要。本元分析综合了2005年至2020年间发表的关于招聘歧视的通信实验的准详尽登记。使用随机效应模型，我们计算了关于法律禁止招聘中不平等对待的十种歧视理由的合并歧视比率。我们的元分析表明，针对残疾候选人、年长候选人和外貌吸引力较低的候选人的招聘歧视，似乎与对具有显著种族或民族特征的候选人的不平等对待同样严重。此外，对年长申请人的招聘歧视在欧洲比在美国更为突出。最后，虽然我们最初发现（西欧）种族招聘歧视显著下降，但在控制所考虑的少数群体、国家层面或本综述范围内的其他各种理由时，我们未发现近期招聘歧视时间变化的结构性证据。

records.title_en: The macroeconomic effects of funding U.S. infrastructure
records.title_cn: 资助美国基础设施的宏观经济影响
records.abstract_en: This paper quantitatively assesses the macroeconomic effects of the recently agreed U.S. bipartisan infrastructure spending bill in a general equilibrium model with a mix of neoclassical and new-Keynesian features. We add to the relevant literature by allowing for a more detailed tax structure, different types of infrastructure spending and linkages between the final and intermediate goods sectors. We find long-run output multipliers above unity if the rising public debt, triggered by the increase in infrastructure spending, is stabilised by rises in consumption, dividend and labour income taxes and less than unity for corporate taxes. We also find that self-financing rates associated with infrastructure spending are not generally above 50% despite underprovided private and particularly public capital. Finally, a sensitivity analysis reveals that intersectoral linkages and zero-interest rate policy are critical determinants of multiplier size.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在混合了新古典主义和新凯恩斯主义特征的一般均衡模型中定量评估了最近商定的美国两党基础设施支出法案的宏观经济影响。我们通过允许更详细的税收结构、不同类型的基础设施支出以及最终产品和中间产品部门之间的联系来补充相关文献。我们发现，如果基础设施支出增加引发的公共债务上升，通过消费税、股息税和劳动所得税的上升而稳定，并且企业税低于统一，那么长期产出乘数就会高于统一。我们还发现，尽管私人资本、尤其是公共资本供应不足，但与基础设施支出相关的自筹资金率普遍不高于50%。最后，敏感性分析表明，部门间联系和零利率政策是乘数规模的关键决定因素。

records.title_en: The problem of financing global public goods
records.title_cn: 全球公共品融资问题
records.abstract_en: A longstanding result from decades of research on the provision of global public goods, is that stable coalitions of cooperating countries are small when the benefits to cooperating are large. This “paradox” of cooperation is seemingly overcome in a recent paper “The Strategic Dimension of Financing Global Public Goods”, by Kornek and Edenhofer (2020). The authors propose a global-public goods game in which countries finance a compensation fund that can balance abatement costs among members. The fund is based on financial transfers, and in the often-explored case of linear benefits and quadratic costs, the proposed institution is credited as being able to support a stable grand coalition. However, when looking carefully at the model, the promising result relies on assumptions and features of an international institution that are not credible because they restrict members’ rights to opt out. The institution’s success relies on countries being required to transfer funds in response to below-average abatement levels. In this short paper we show that when countries have the outside option to renege on the terms of the agreement, no money would be transferred and the institution proposed by Kornek and Edenhofer (2020) reverts to the non-cooperative outcome.
records.abstract_cn: 关于全球公共品供给的几十年研究得出的一个长期结论是，当合作收益较大时，合作国家的稳定联盟规模较小。这一合作的“悖论”似乎在Kornek和Edenhofer（2020）最近发表的论文《全球公共品融资的战略维度》中得到了克服。作者提出了一个全球公共品博弈，其中各国为一个补偿基金提供资金，该基金可以平衡成员国之间的减排成本。该基金基于金融转移，在线性收益和二次成本的常见情形下，所提出的制度被认为能够支持一个稳定的“大联盟”。然而，仔细审视该模型时，这一有前景的结果依赖于一个国际机构的假设和特征，而这些假设和特征并不可信，因为它们限制了成员退出（opt out）的权利。该制度的成功依赖于各国被要求对低于平均减排水平的情况进行资金转移。在本文中，我们表明，当国家拥有违约（renege）协议条款的外部选择时，不会有资金转移，Kornek和Edenhofer（2020）提出的制度将退回到非合作结果。

records.title_en: The demographic transition and the asset supply channel
records.title_cn: 人口转变与资产供给渠道
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the macroeconomic consequences of a demographic transition in an environment where a producer’s capital structure is relevant, thereby introducing an asset supply channel. Producers are heterogeneous with respect to how productive they are in different states of the world, and may pursue different combinations of safe and/or risky securities issuance when financing projects. I simulate a demographic transition calibrated to replicate the US experience starting in 1880. This transition results in modest increases in output, larger increases in saving as a whole and, particularly, in a relative increase in saving in the form of safe assets. Lower capital costs lead to producer entry (and more issuance) and to a tilt towards safe issuance. I show that omitting this asset supply channel, as standard representative firm models do, results in a quantitatively important overestimation of the transmission effects of the demographic transition, with larger output gains despite smaller interest rate reductions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在生产者资本结构具有相关性的环境中，人口转变的宏观经济后果，从而引入了资产供给渠道。生产者在不同世界状态下的生产率存在异质性，并且在为项目融资时可能采用安全证券和/或风险证券的不同组合。我模拟了一个以复制美国自1880年开始的经验为校准目标的人口转变。这一转变导致产出适度增加，储蓄整体更大幅度增加，尤其是以安全资产形式储蓄的相对增加。较低的资本成本导致生产者进入（并增加发行），并倾向于安全发行。我表明，忽略这一资产供给渠道（如标准代表性企业模型所做的那样）会导致对人口转变传导效应的定量重要高估，尽管利率下降幅度较小，但产出增长更大。

records.title_en: Optimal quantitative easing in a monetary union
records.title_cn: 货币联盟中的最优量化宽松
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the optimal allocation of government bond purchases within a monetary union, using a two-region DSGE model, where regions are asymmetric with respect to portfolio characteristics: the extent of substitutability between assets of different maturity and origin, asset home bias, and levels of government debt. An optimal QE policy under commitment does not only reflect different region sizes, but is also a function of these portfolio characteristics. By calibrating the model to the euro area, we show that optimal QE favors purchases from the smaller region (Periphery instead of Core), given that the former faces stronger portfolio frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用一个两区域DSGE模型，探讨了货币联盟内政府债券购买的最优配置，其中区域在投资组合特征方面具有不对称性：不同期限和来源资产之间的可替代程度、资产本土偏好以及政府债务水平。承诺下的最优量化宽松政策不仅反映不同区域的规模，还取决于这些投资组合特征。通过将模型校准至欧元区，我们表明，鉴于外围区域面临更强的投资组合摩擦，最优量化宽松倾向于从较小区域（外围而非核心）购买。

records.title_en: Inflation tolerance ranges in the New Keynesian model
records.title_cn: 新凯恩斯模型中的通胀容忍区间
records.abstract_en: A number of central banks in advanced countries use ranges, or bands, around their inflation target to formulate their monetary policy strategy. The adoption of such ranges has been proposed by some policymakers in the context of the Fed and the ECB reviews of their strategies. Using a standard New Keynesian macroeconomic model, we analyze the consequences of tolerance range policies, characterized by a stronger reaction of the central bank to inflation when inflation lies outside the range, than when it is close to the target, i.e. the central value of the band. We show that (i) a tolerance band should not be a zone of inaction: the lack of reaction may trigger substantial unwarranted volatility and lead to multiple equilibria; (ii) the trade-off between the reaction needed outside the range versus inside appears unfavorable: a very strong reaction, when inflation is far from the target, is required to compensate for a moderately lower reaction within tolerance band; (iii) these results, obtained within the framework of a stylized model, are robust to many alterations, in particular allowing for the zero lower bound.
records.abstract_cn: 许多发达国家的中央银行使用围绕其通胀目标的区间或波段来制定货币政策策略。在美联储和欧洲央行对其策略进行审查的背景下，一些政策制定者提出了采用此类区间的建议。我们使用一个标准的新凯恩斯宏观经济模型，分析了容忍区间政策的影响，其特征是当通胀位于区间之外时，中央银行对通胀的反应比通胀接近目标（即波段的中心值）时更为强烈。我们表明：（i）容忍区间不应是一个不作为的区域：缺乏反应可能引发大量不必要的波动并导致多重均衡；（ii）区间外所需反应与区间内反应之间的权衡似乎不利：当通胀远离目标时，需要非常强烈的反应来补偿容忍区间内适度较低的反应；（iii）这些在简化模型框架内获得的结果对许多改动具有稳健性，特别是允许零利率下限的情况。

records.title_en: Understanding cognitive decline in older ages: The role of health shocks
records.title_cn: 理解老年认知衰退：健康冲击的作用
records.abstract_en: Individual cognitive functioning declines over time. We seek to understand how adverse physical health shocks in older ages contribute to this development. By use of event-study methods and data from the USA, England, and several countries in Continental Europe, we find evidence that health shocks lead to an immediate and persistent decline in cognitive functioning. This robust finding holds in all regions representing different health insurance systems and seems to be independent of underlying individual demographic characteristics such as sex and age. We also ask whether variables that are susceptible to policy action can reduce the negative consequences of a health shock. Our results suggest that neither compulsory education nor retirement regulations moderate the effects, thus emphasizing the importance for cognitive functioning of maintaining good physical health in old age.
records.abstract_cn: 个体认知功能随时间下降。我们试图理解老年期不良身体健康冲击如何促成这一发展。通过使用事件研究方法和来自美国、英格兰以及欧洲大陆多个国家的数据，我们发现证据表明健康冲击导致认知功能立即且持续下降。这一稳健发现在代表不同医疗保险体系的所有地区均成立，并且似乎独立于性别和年龄等潜在个体人口特征。我们还询问那些易受政策影响的变量是否能减少健康冲击的负面后果。我们的结果表明，义务教育或退休规定均不能调节这些影响，从而强调了在老年期保持良好身体健康对认知功能的重要性。

records.title_en: Promise keeping and reliance damage
records.title_cn: 信守承诺与信赖损害
records.abstract_en: This paper experimentally investigates the hypothesis that promise-keeping behavior is affected by the “reliance damage” that a counterpart would suffer as a result of a breach. Reliance damage is defined as the difference between the counterfactual benefit that the counterpart would have obtained had they not relied on the promise and that which they would obtain following a breach. We discuss two motivational mechanisms that could drive such an effect. One is that people intrinsically dislike causing reliance damage per se. The other is that people dislike causing regret in another person. We experimentally test these ideas in the context of an experimental trust game. Our evidence is consistent with the hypothesis that promise keeping is affected by reliance damage, and that the underlying mechanism involves a desire not to cause regret in others.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过实验研究了信守承诺行为是否受到对方因违约而遭受的“信赖损害”影响的假设。信赖损害被定义为对方若未依赖承诺本可获得的反事实收益与违约后其将获得的收益之间的差额。我们讨论了可能驱动这种效应的两种动机机制。一种是人们本质上不喜欢造成信赖损害本身。另一种是人们不喜欢在他人身上引发后悔情绪。我们在实验性信任博弈的背景下对这些想法进行了实验检验。我们的证据与信守承诺受信赖损害影响，且其潜在机制涉及不希望给他人带来后悔的愿望这一假设相一致。

records.title_en: Macroeconomic effects of tax rate and base changes: Evidence from fiscal consolidations
records.title_cn: 税率与税基变动的宏观经济效应：来自财政整顿的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the macroeconomic effects of tax changes during fiscal consolidations. We build a new narrative dataset of tax changes during fiscal consolidation years, containing detailed information on the expected yield, motivation, and announcement and implementation dates of more than 2000 tax measures across 10 OECD countries. Using this data, we then analyze the macroeconomic impact of tax changes, distinguishing between tax rate and tax base changes, and further differentiating between changes in personal income, corporate income, and value added taxes. Our results suggest that base broadening during fiscal consolidations leads to smaller output and employment declines compared to rate hikes, even when distinguishing between tax types.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了财政整顿期间税收变动的宏观经济效应。我们构建了一个新的财政整顿年份税收变动的叙事数据集，包含超过2000项税收措施的预期收益、动机以及公告和实施日期的详细信息，覆盖10个OECD国家。利用这些数据，我们分析了税收变动的宏观经济影响，区分了税率变动和税基变动，并进一步区分了个人所得税、公司所得税和增值税的变动。我们的结果表明，与提高税率相比，财政整顿期间扩大税基导致的产出和就业下降幅度更小，即使在区分税种的情况下也是如此。

records.title_en: Asylum policies and international tensions
records.title_cn: 庇护政策与国际紧张关系
records.abstract_en: This article examines how international relation dynamics shape asylum policies. Using data on asylum applications in the European Union (EU) and international events from 1999 to 2017, we document that EU Member States admit relatively more refugees when diplomatic relations with the country of origin deteriorate. This result holds after controlling for push and pull factors as well as bilateral determinants of refugee migration. Our results highlight the importance of non-humanitarian factors in the grant of political asylum.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了国际关系动态如何影响庇护政策。利用1999年至2017年欧盟（EU）的庇护申请数据和国际事件数据，我们记录了当与来源国的外交关系恶化时，欧盟成员国接纳的难民相对更多。在控制了推动和拉动因素以及难民迁移的双边决定因素后，这一结果依然成立。我们的结果强调了非人道主义因素在授予政治庇护中的重要性。

records.title_en: Do monetary condition news at the zero lower bound influence households’ expectations and readiness to spend?
records.title_cn: 零利率下限时的货币政策消息是否影响家庭预期和消费意愿？
records.abstract_en: We investigate how households update their interest rate and inflation expectations upon hearing monetary condition news, and to what extent this changes their readiness to spend. Using data from the Michigan Survey of Consumers from December 2008 to December 2015, we find (1) the likelihood of higher expected interest rates significantly increases upon hearing news of tighter monetary condition; (2) monetary condition news is irrelevant for both short- and medium-run inflation expectations; (3) the main information content of this perceived news is most likely from forward guidance and professional forecasts; and (4) households update their readiness to spend on houses, cars and durable goods upon perceiving monetary condition news. Our evidence points towards interest rate expectations as the most likely mediator through which monetary condition news drives households’ readiness to spend.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了家庭在听到货币政策消息后如何更新其利率和通胀预期，以及这在多大程度上改变了他们的消费意愿。利用密歇根消费者调查从2008年十二月至2015年十二月的数据，我们发现（1）在听到货币政策收紧的消息后，预期利率上升的可能性显著增加；（2）货币政策消息对短期和中期通胀预期均无影响；（3）这种感知消息的主要信息内容很可能来自前瞻性指引和专业预测；（4）家庭在感知到货币政策消息后会更新其对住房、汽车和耐用品的消费意愿。我们的证据表明，利率预期是货币政策消息驱动家庭消费意愿的最可能中介因素。

records.title_en: The heterogeneous welfare effects of business cycles
records.title_cn: 经济周期波动的异质性福利效应
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the welfare effects of business cycle fluctuations from a distributional perspective. To this end, we develop a quantitative heterogeneous-agent model which incorporates market incompleteness and non-convexity into the mapping from the time devoted to work to labor services. In this setup, households can insure against aggregate uncertainty using labor and savings and have substantially different labor supply elasticities. We find that the welfare effects are heterogeneous across households, with wealth-rich households benefiting most from business cycles. Wealth-rich households enjoy business cycles more than wealth-poor households, because they experience less volatile consumption and can enjoy higher average income through reallocating savings intertemporally.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究从分配视角探讨经济周期波动的福利效应。为此，我们构建了一个定量异质性主体模型，该模型将市场不完全性和非凸性纳入从工作时间到劳动服务的映射中。在此设定下，家庭可以通过劳动和储蓄来对冲总体不确定性，并且具有显著不同的劳动供给弹性。我们发现，福利效应在家庭间是异质的，其中富裕家庭从经济周期中获益最多。富裕家庭比贫穷家庭更能享受经济周期，因为它们经历的消费波动较小，并且可以通过跨期重新配置储蓄来享受更高的平均收入。

records.title_en: Does working from home work? A natural experiment from lockdowns
records.title_cn: 居家办公有效吗？来自封锁政策的自然实验
records.abstract_en: Using tracked changes from a large open-source software platform, this paper studies how working from home affected the output of individuals working in tech. The basis of the natural experiment comes from idiosyncratic and state-imposed workplace closures during the COVID-19 pandemic. I find a negative but almost-negligible change in individual-level output of 0.5 percent (standard error of 0.091 percent). Overall, and based on descriptive analyses of the time-stamped data, tracked changes in software development cadences approximate regular work activity and provide a useful avenue for future studies of work.
records.abstract_cn: 利用大型开源软件平台上的追踪变更，本文研究了居家办公如何影响科技行业从业者的产出。该自然实验的基础源于COVID-19疫情期间各州实施的、具有特异性的工作场所关闭政策。我发现个体层面的产出出现了负向但几乎可忽略的变化，为0.5%（标准误为0.091%）。总体而言，基于对带时间戳数据的描述性分析，软件开发节奏中的追踪变更近似于常规工作活动，并为未来的工作研究提供了有用的途径。

records.title_en: Human-algorithm interaction: Algorithmic pricing in hybrid laboratory markets
records.title_cn: 人机交互：混合实验室市场中的算法定价
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates pricing in laboratory markets when human players interact with an algorithm. We compare the degree of competition when exclusively humans interact to the case of one firm delegating its decisions to an algorithm, an n-player generalization of tit-for-tat. We further vary whether participants know about the presence of the algorithm. When one of three firms in a market is an algorithm, we observe significantly higher prices compared to human-only markets. Firms employing an algorithm earn significantly less profit than their rivals. (Un)certainty about the actual presence of an algorithm does not significantly affect collusion, although humans do seem to perceive algorithms as more disruptive.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当人类玩家与算法互动时实验室市场中的定价问题。我们比较了仅由人类互动时的竞争程度与一家公司将其决策委托给算法（一种n人版的以牙还牙策略）的情况。我们还进一步变化了参与者是否知道算法的存在。当市场中的三家公司之一为算法时，我们观察到价格显著高于仅有人类的市场。采用算法的公司所获利润显著低于其竞争对手。关于算法实际存在的不确定性并未显著影响合谋，尽管人类似乎确实认为算法更具破坏性。

records.title_en: Backward versus forward integration of firms in global value chains
records.title_cn: 全球价值链中企业的后向与前向整合
records.abstract_en: This paper seeks to understand the forces determining the pattern of asset ownership in global value chains. We augment a standard model of vertical integration rooted in the property-rights theory to account for fixed integration costs and derive four channels of influence for the cross-country and cross-sector pattern of asset ownership: the relative investment intensity of sectors and countries; the relative density of markets; the relative reliance on and importance of supplying and producing country-sectors; and the relative importance of fixed integration costs. We confirm the relevance of these determinants for the observed pattern of asset ownership in a large panel of worldwide directed ownership linkages.
records.abstract_cn: 本文旨在理解决定全球价值链中资产所有权模式的力量。我们在产权理论的基础上，对标准的纵向整合模型进行扩展，以考虑固定整合成本，并推导出影响资产所有权跨国和跨部门模式的四个渠道：部门和国家的相对投资强度；市场的相对密度；对供应和生产国部门的相对依赖及其重要性；以及固定整合成本的相对重要性。我们通过一个包含全球定向所有权联系的大型面板数据，证实了这些决定因素与观察到的资产所有权模式的相关性。

records.title_en: Fiscal stimulus in liquidity traps: Conventional or unconventional policies?
records.title_cn: 流动性陷阱中的财政刺激：常规还是非常规政策？
records.abstract_en: Recent influential work argue that a gradual increase in the sales tax stimulates economic activity in a liquidity trap by boosting inflation expectations. Higher public infrastructure investment should also be more expansive in a liquidity trap than in normal times by raising the potential interest rate and increasing aggregate demand. We analyze the relative merits of these policies in New Keynesian models with and without endogenous private capital formation and heterogeneity when monetary policy does not respond by raising policy rates. Our key finding is that the effectiveness of sales tax hikes differs notably across various model specifications, whereas the benefits of higher public infrastructure investment are more robust in alternative model environments. We therefore conclude that fiscal policymakers in liquidity traps should consider spending opportunities and not merely rely on tax policies to stimulate growth.
records.abstract_cn: 近期有影响力的研究认为，在流动性陷阱中，逐步提高销售税通过提升通胀预期来刺激经济活动。更高的公共基础设施投资也应通过提高潜在利率和增加总需求，在流动性陷阱中比正常时期更具扩张性。我们在有和没有内生私人资本形成及异质性的新凯恩斯模型中，分析这些政策的相对优劣，此时货币政策不通过提高政策利率来回应。我们的关键发现是，销售税上调的有效性在不同模型设定下差异显著，而更高公共基础设施投资的益处在替代模型环境中更为稳健。因此，我们得出结论，流动性陷阱中的财政政策制定者应考虑支出机会，而不仅仅依赖税收政策来刺激增长。

records.title_en: Corporate debt maturity and investment over the business cycle
records.title_cn: 企业债务期限与商业周期中的投资
records.abstract_en: The business cycle dynamics of firms’ debt maturity vary across the firm size distribution. Small and medium-sized firms have a more pro-cyclical debt maturity than large firms. This paper explores the determinants of firms’ debt maturity, and the importance of firms’ debt maturity for their investment and leverage dynamics. To do so, it embeds a maturity choice in a model of firm investment and financing. Firms shorten debt maturity during times when default risk premiums are high and their internal funds are scarce. This behavior is consistent with both the life cycle and business cycle dynamics of firms’ debt maturity. Endogenous debt maturity helps firms to deleverage faster in response to negative shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 企业债务期限的商业周期动态在企业规模分布中有所不同。中小型企业的债务期限比大型企业更具顺周期性。本文探讨了企业债务期限的决定因素，以及企业债务期限对其投资和杠杆动态的重要性。为此，本文将期限选择嵌入企业投资和融资模型中。企业在违约风险溢价高且内部资金稀缺时缩短债务期限。这种行为与企业债务期限的生命周期和商业周期动态一致。内生债务期限有助于企业在应对负面冲击时更快地去杠杆化。

records.title_en: Euro area sovereign bond risk premia before and during the Covid-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: Covid-19大流行之前和期间的欧元区主权债券风险溢价
records.abstract_en: We provide a novel modeling framework to decompose euro area sovereign bond yields into five distinct components: (i) expected future short-term risk-free rates and a term premium, (ii) a default risk premium, (iii) redenomination risk premium, (iv) liquidity risk premium, and (v) segmentation (convenience) premium. Identification is achieved by considering sovereign yields jointly with other rates, including sovereign credit default swap spreads with and without redenomination as a credit event trigger. We illustrate our model by studying yield components embedded in German, French, Italian, and Spanish sovereign bonds, before and after the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020, and by examining the impact of European Central Bank (ECB) monetary policy and European Union (EU) fiscal policy announcements in response to the pandemic. We find that all five risk premia became sizable following the onset of the pandemic, and that both monetary and fiscal policy announcements had a pronounced effect on yields, mostly through default, redenomination, and segmentation (convenience) premia.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个新颖的模型框架，将欧元区主权债券收益率分解为五个不同的组成部分：(i) 预期未来短期无风险利率和期限溢价，(ii) 违约风险溢价，(iii) 重新计价风险溢价，(iv) 流动性风险溢价，以及 (v) 分割（便利）溢价。识别是通过结合考虑主权收益率和其他利率来实现的，包括在有或没有重新计价作为信用事件触发因素的情况下的主权信用违约掉期利差。我们通过研究2020新冠病毒19大流行爆发前后德国、法国、意大利和西班牙主权债券中嵌入的收益率组成部分，并研究欧洲央行 (ECB) 货币政策和欧盟 (EU) 财政政策公告针对这一流行病的影响来说明我们的模型。我们发现，大流行爆发后，所有五种风险溢价都变得相当大，而且货币和财政政策公告都对收益率产生了显着影响，主要是通过违约、重新计价和分割（便利）溢价。

records.title_en: Consumer mobility and expenditure during the COVID-19 containments: Evidence from French transaction data
records.title_cn: COVID-19封锁期间的消费者流动与支出：来自法国交易数据的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of the pandemic containment periods in France on individuals’ movements, expenditure and adaptation to the shock, using billions of French bank card transactions measured before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. We measure not only the effect on consumer expenditure, but also on quantities directly related to the containment restrictions, such as consumer mobility, number of retailers visited, and inter-regional purchases. The results show large effects on these measures of consumers’ movements, as well as on both online and offline measures of expenditure, particularly in the first containment period. We also find evidence that consumers adjusted rapidly during the first containment period, mitigating the effects of mobility restrictions via an increasing shift toward online purchasing, and that the nature of the adaptation differed for different types of purchase.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用法国数十亿笔银行卡交易数据（涵盖COVID-19疫情前后），研究了法国疫情封锁期对个人流动、支出及对冲击适应性的影响。我们不仅衡量了对消费者支出的影响，还衡量了与封锁限制直接相关的数量指标，如消费者流动性、访问的零售商数量以及跨区域购买。结果显示，这些消费者流动指标以及线上和线下支出指标均受到显著影响，尤其是在第一次封锁期间。我们还发现，在第一次封锁期间，消费者迅速调整，通过转向线上购买来缓解流动性限制的影响，并且不同购买类型的适应性质有所不同。

records.title_en: Inflation, Output, and Welfare in the Laboratory
records.title_cn: 实验室中的通货膨胀、产出与福利
records.abstract_en: We develop an experimental framework to investigate the quantity theory of money and the real effects of inflation in an economy where money serves as a medium of exchange. We test the classical view that inflation reduces output and welfare by taxing monetary exchange. Inflation is engineered by constant money growth where newly-issued money is injected in one of three ways: to finance government spending, lump-sum transfers, or proportional transfers. Experimental results largely support theoretical predictions. Higher money growth leads to higher inflation. Output and welfare are significantly lower with government spending, output is significantly lower with lump-sum transfers, while there are no significant real effects with proportional transfers. A deviation from theory is that the detrimental effect of money growth depends on the implementation scheme and is stronger with government spending relative to lump-sum transfers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个实验框架，以研究货币数量论以及货币作为交换媒介的经济体中通货膨胀的实际效应。我们检验了古典观点，即通货膨胀通过对货币交换征税来降低产出和福利。通货膨胀是通过恒定的货币增长来实现的，新发行的货币以三种方式之一注入：用于政府支出、一次性转移支付或比例转移支付。实验结果在很大程度上支持理论预测。较高的货币增长导致较高的通货膨胀。在政府支出情况下，产出和福利显著降低；在一次性转移支付情况下，产出显著降低；而在比例转移支付情况下，没有显著的实际效应。与理论的一个偏差是，货币增长的不利影响取决于实施方案，并且相对于一次性转移支付，政府支出的影响更强。

records.title_en: It Pays to be big: Price discrimination in maritime shipping
records.title_cn: 大者有利：海运中的价格歧视
records.abstract_en: We explore theoretically and empirically the within-route price discrimination in liner shipping and condition it on the market density. Our simple model with informational frictions predicts carrier price discrimination against smaller importing firms under the condition that the number of available carriers on the route is sufficiently large. Using transaction-level data from over 200 Chilean import port-to-port routes, we confirm our theoretical predictions and demonstrate their robustness and economic significance. Ranked by their annual importing size, importers in the 10th percentile pay 18% higher freight rates than importers in the 90th percentile, but only on routes with more than three carriers. Our results indicate that reducing market power distortion in the upstream sector (transportation) may amplify the informational friction distortion and price discrimination in the downstream sectors (importing industries).
records.abstract_cn: 我们从理论和实证上探讨了班轮运输中的航线内价格歧视，并将其与市场密度相联系。我们的简单模型包含信息摩擦，预测在航线上的可用承运人数量足够多的情况下，承运人会对较小的进口企业实施价格歧视。利用来自智利超过200个港口到港口航线的交易级数据，我们证实了我们的理论预测，并展示了其稳健性和经济显著性。按年度进口规模排名，第10百分位的进口商支付的运费率比第90百分位的进口商高18%，但仅限于承运人超过三家的航线。我们的结果表明，减少上游部门（运输）的市场力量扭曲可能会放大下游部门（进口行业）的信息摩擦扭曲和价格歧视。

records.title_en: Monetary–fiscal crosswinds in the European Monetary Union
records.title_cn: 欧洲货币联盟中的货币-财政交叉风
records.abstract_en: We study the monetary–fiscal mix in the European Monetary Union. The medium and long-run effects of conventional and unconventional monetary policy are analysed by combining monetary policy shocks identified in a Structural VAR, and the general government budget constraint featuring a single central bank and multiple fiscal authorities. In response to a conventional easing of the policy rate, the cumulated response of the fiscal deficit is positive. Conversely, in response to an unconventional easing affecting the long end of the yield curve, the primary fiscal position barely moves. This is consistent with the long-run effect of unconventional monetary easing on the price index, which is about half that of conventional easing. The aggregate long-run cumulated surplus is mainly driven by Germany’s fiscal policy during the period in which unconventional monetary policy was adopted.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究欧洲货币联盟中的货币-财政组合。通过结合结构向量自回归中识别的货币政策冲击，以及具有单一中央银行和多个财政当局的广义政府预算约束，分析常规和非常规货币政策的中期和长期效应。对于政策利率的常规宽松，财政赤字的累积响应为正。相反，对于影响收益率曲线长端的非常规宽松，基本财政状况几乎不变。这与非常规货币宽松对价格指数的长期效应一致，该效应约为常规宽松的一半。在采用非常规货币政策的时期，总体长期累积盈余主要由德国的财政政策驱动。

records.title_en: Immigration and work schedules: Theory and evidence
records.title_cn: 移民与工作时间安排：理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We develop a theoretical framework to analyze the effects of immigration on native job amenities, focusing on work schedules. Immigrants have a comparative advantage in production at, and lower disamenity cost for nighttime work, which leads them to disproportionately choose nighttime employment. Because day and night tasks are imperfect substitutes, the relative price of day tasks increases as their supply becomes relatively more scarce. We provide empirical support for our theory. Native workers in local labor markets that experienced higher rates of immigration are more likely to work day shifts and receive a lower compensating differential for nighttime work.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个理论框架来分析移民对本地居民工作福利的影响，重点关注工作时间安排。移民在生产夜班工作方面具有比较优势，且对夜班工作的不适成本较低，这导致他们不成比例地选择夜间就业。由于白天和夜间任务是不完全替代的，随着白天任务供给相对变得更加稀缺，其相对价格上升。我们为我们的理论提供了实证支持。在移民率较高的地方劳动力市场中，本地工人更可能上白班，并且获得的夜班补偿性工资差异较低。

records.title_en: Structural change and productivity growth in Europe — Past, present and future
records.title_cn: 欧洲的结构变化与生产率增长——过去、现在与未来
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of structural change on the historical path of aggregate labor productivity growth for a large sample of European countries, and it builds a quantitative multi-sector growth model to analyze the potential impact that structural change may have on future productivity growth. We document that the observed reallocation of economic activity since the 1970s towards the service sector has exerted a strongly negative effect on aggregate productivity growth in most European countries. Moreover, we perform a quantitative analysis to show that the expected path of structural change might continue to have a sizeable dent on future productivity growth in Europe. By contrast, the impact in the U.S. is expected to rapidly diminish. We show that this differential result can be explained by the large expansion, in Europe, of certain service sub-sectors characterized by stagnant productivity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了结构变化对欧洲国家大样本历史总劳动生产率增长路径的影响，并构建了一个定量多部门增长模型来分析结构变化可能对未来生产率增长产生的潜在影响。我们记录了自1970年以来观察到的经济活动向服务业部门的重新配置对大多数欧洲国家总生产率增长产生了强烈的负面影响。此外，我们进行了定量分析，表明预期的结构变化路径可能继续对欧洲未来的生产率增长产生显著影响。相比之下，美国的影响预计将迅速减弱。我们表明，这种差异结果可以解释为欧洲某些以生产率停滞为特征的特定服务子部门的大幅扩张。

records.title_en: Absolute income mobility and the effect of parent generation inequality: An extended decomposition approach
records.title_cn: 绝对收入流动性与父代不平等的影响：一种扩展分解方法
records.abstract_en: We use full-population data to study trends in intergenerational absolute income mobility, measured as the ratio of children earning more than their parents, for 11 Swedish cohorts born 1972–1983. Absolute mobility during this period increases from 72% to 84% for men and from 76% to 86% for women—higher figures than in most other countries studied. To explain these results, we outline a novel decomposition strategy that accounts for cohort variation in parent-generation income inequality. All else equal, if income inequality is higher in the parent generation, more economic growth is required to achieve any given level of absolute mobility. We discuss implications for comparative research in intergenerational income mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用全人口数据研究代际绝对收入流动性的趋势，以子女收入超过父母的比率衡量，针对1972-1983年出生的11个瑞典队列。在此期间，绝对流动性从男性的72%增加到84%，女性从76%增加到86%——高于大多数其他研究国家。为解释这些结果，我们提出了一种新颖的分解策略，该策略考虑了父代收入不平等的队列变异。在其他条件相同的情况下，如果父代收入不平等程度更高，则需要更多的经济增长才能实现任何给定的绝对流动性水平。我们讨论了对代际收入流动性比较研究的启示。

records.title_en: The macroeconomics of age-varying epidemics
records.title_cn: 年龄变化流行病的宏观经济学
records.abstract_en: We incorporate age-specific socio-economic interactions in a SIR macroeconomic model to study the role of demographic factors for the COVID-19 epidemic evolution, its macroeconomic effects and possible containment measures. We capture the endogenous response of rational individuals who choose to reduce inter- and intra-generational social interactions, consumption- and labor-related personal exposure to the virus, while not internalizing the impact of their actions on others. We find that social distancing measures targeted to the elderly (who face higher mortality risk and are not part of the labor force) are best suited to save lives and mitigate output losses. The optimal economic shutdown generates small gains in terms of lives saved and large output losses, for any given type of social distancing. These results are confirmed by calibrating the model to match real epidemic and economic data in the context of a scenario exercise.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在SIR宏观经济模型中纳入年龄特定的社会经济互动，以研究人口因素对COVID-19疫情演变、其宏观经济影响及可能的遏制措施的作用。我们捕捉理性个体的内生反应，他们选择减少代际间和代际内的社会互动、消费和劳动相关的个人病毒暴露，同时不内化其行为对他人的影响。我们发现，针对老年人（他们面临更高的死亡风险且不属于劳动力）的社交距离措施最适合拯救生命并减轻产出损失。最优的经济停摆在任何给定的社交距离类型下，在拯救生命方面产生微小收益，而在产出损失方面产生巨大损失。这些结果通过校准模型以匹配情景演练中的真实疫情和经济数据得到证实。

records.title_en: Pioneer, early follower or late entrant: Entry dynamics with learning and market competition
records.title_cn: 先驱、早期跟随者或晚期进入者：具有学习和市场竞争的进入动态
records.abstract_en: Timing of market entry is one of the most important strategic decisions a firm must make, but its decision process becomes convoluted with information and payoff externalities. The threat of competition pushes firms to enter earlier to preempt their rivals while the possibility of learning makes them cautiously wait for others to take action. This combination amounts to a new class of timing games where a first-mover advantage first emerges as in preemption games but a second-mover advantage later prevails as in wars of attrition. Our model identifies under what conditions a firm becomes a pioneer, early follower or late entrant and provides efficiency implications by highlighting an elusive link between static market competition and dynamic entry competition.
records.abstract_cn: 市场进入时机是企业必须做出的最重要的战略决策之一，但其决策过程因信息和支付外部性而变得复杂。竞争的威胁促使企业更早进入以抢占先机，而学习的可能性则使它们谨慎地等待他人采取行动。这种组合构成了一类新的时机博弈，其中先发优势首先如抢占博弈中那样出现，但后发优势随后如消耗战中那样占据上风。我们的模型识别了在何种条件下企业成为先驱、早期跟随者或晚期进入者，并通过强调静态市场竞争与动态进入竞争之间难以捉摸的联系，提供了效率方面的启示。

records.title_en: Preventing financial disasters: Macroprudential policy and financial crises
records.title_cn: 防范金融灾难：宏观审慎政策与金融危机
records.abstract_en: The ultimate goal of macroprudential policy is to prevent and reduce the costs of systemic financial crises, and thus contribute to promoting sustainable economic growth. However, despite the active role played by such policies in recent decades, there is still limited empirical evidence regarding whether prudential regulation is effective to enhance financial stability by preventing and mitigating crisis risk. This paper seeks to close that gap by studying the relationship between macroprudential policy and both the likelihood and severity of financial crises. The contribution of the paper is twofold. First, I show that macroprudential policy tightenings are successful at reducing the frequency of systemic financial crises. Moreover, this result holds even if macroprudential policies are implemented when the economy is already experiencing a financial boom or when monetary conditions are rather accommodative. I point to the prevention and mitigation of financial booms as the main transmission mechanism through which macroprudential policy defuses crisis risk. Second, I find that macroprudential policy enhances the resilience of the financial system, by dampening the output losses associated with future systemic financial crises. The latter result implies that macroprudential policy not only makes financial crises less likely, but also less painful.
records.abstract_cn: 宏观审慎政策的最终目标是预防和降低系统性金融危机的成本，从而促进可持续的经济增长。然而，尽管此类政策在近几十年中发挥了积极作用，关于审慎监管是否能有效通过预防和缓解危机风险来增强金融稳定性的经验证据仍然有限。本文旨在通过研究宏观审慎政策与金融危机的可能性和严重性之间的关系来填补这一空白。本文的贡献有两方面。首先，我表明宏观审慎政策的收紧能够成功降低系统性金融危机的发生频率。此外，即使在经济已经经历金融繁荣或货币条件相当宽松时实施宏观审慎政策，这一结果仍然成立。我将预防和缓解金融繁荣视为宏观审慎政策化解危机风险的主要传导机制。其次，我发现宏观审慎政策通过抑制与未来系统性金融危机相关的产出损失，增强了金融体系的韧性。后一结果意味着宏观审慎政策不仅使金融危机更不可能发生，而且使其痛苦程度更低。

records.title_en: Market competition and discrimination
records.title_cn: 市场竞争与歧视
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of competition on ethnic discrimination by carrying out a field experiment in the context of the rice market in Bangladesh. We recruit professional rice buyers (middlemen) to act as judges in a rice competition by providing a quality rating and a price quote for rice samples that we randomly associate with farmers bearing ethnic majority or minority names. First, we find that there is no ethnic difference in buyers’ evaluation of rice quality. Second, we find that local buyers, who have local monopsony power, discriminate against ethnic minority farmers by quoting a lower price for their rice relative to that of ethnic majority farmers. Third, we find that wholesale buyers, who face fierce competition in the marketplace, do not price discriminate against ethnic minority farmers. A second lab-in-the-field experiment and survey information indicate that both local and wholesale buyers are prejudiced against ethnic minority farmers. This suggests that market competition can eliminate the discrimination of wholesale buyers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过在孟加拉国大米市场进行实地实验，研究竞争对种族歧视的影响。我们招募专业大米买家（中间商）作为大米竞赛的评委，对大米样品进行质量评级和报价，这些样品被随机与具有多数或少数族裔姓名的农民相关联。首先，我们发现买家对大米质量的评价不存在种族差异。其次，我们发现拥有当地买方垄断权力的本地买家会歧视少数族裔农民，对其大米报价低于多数族裔农民。第三，我们发现面临激烈市场竞争的批发买家不会对少数族裔农民进行价格歧视。第二个实验室实地实验和调查信息表明，本地和批发买家都对少数族裔农民存在偏见。这表明市场竞争可以消除批发买家的歧视。

records.title_en: Immigrant intergenerational mobility: A focus on childhood environment
records.title_cn: 移民的代际流动性：关注童年环境
records.abstract_en: Over 60% of immigrant parents in Sweden start off in the bottom quintile of the income distribution, yet only about 30% of their children are still in the bottom income quintile in adulthood. This progress notwithstanding, we show using administrative data that immigrant children who grow up in the 20th income percentile place three income ranks lower than native children of similarly low-income parents. This income gap cannot be explained by differences in parent education levels, family structure, or municipality of residence. The gap can, however, be explained by differences in immediate, 100 × 100 - m neighborhoods. Immigrant children grow up in relatively denser neighborhoods with fewer native-born and high-earning neighbors. Data from Stockholm suggest that immigrant families sort into different neighborhoods than natives due to Sweden’s rental housing allocation mechanism that is based on waiting time rather than market rents.
records.abstract_cn: 瑞典超过60%的移民父母起初处于收入分配的最底层的五分之一，但他们的子女中只有约30%在成年后仍处于收入最底层的五分之一。尽管有这种进步，我们使用行政数据表明，在收入百分位第20位成长的移民子女，其收入排名比收入同样低的本地父母所生的子女低三个收入等级。这一收入差距无法用父母教育水平、家庭结构或居住城市的差异来解释。然而，这一差距可以用直接的、100×100米的邻里差异来解释。移民子女成长的邻里相对更密集，且本地出生和高收入的邻居较少。来自斯德哥尔摩的数据表明，由于瑞典的租赁住房分配机制基于等待时间而非市场租金，移民家庭与本地家庭会选择不同的邻里居住。

records.title_en: Model selection accuracy in behavioral game theory: A simulation
records.title_cn: 行为博弈论中的模型选择准确性：一项模拟研究
records.abstract_en: We simulate a horse race between several behavioral models of play in one-shot games. First, we find that many models can lead to identical predictions, making it impossible to select a unique winning model. This is largely avoided by comparing only two models. But even then we find that cross-validation sometimes fails to select the true model, often because models are be estimated to be noiseless but then fail to predict out-of-sample data. The Bayesian Information Criterion avoids this problem, though the inflexibility of its parameter penalty appears to cause poor performance in certain settings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们模拟了一场在一次性博弈中几种行为模型之间的赛马。首先，我们发现许多模型可能产生相同的预测，使得无法选择唯一的优胜模型。通过仅比较两个模型，这在很大程度上得以避免。但即便如此，我们发现交叉验证有时无法选择真实模型，这通常是因为模型被估计为无噪声，但随后无法预测样本外数据。贝叶斯信息准则避免了这一问题，尽管其参数惩罚的不灵活性似乎在特定情境下导致性能不佳。

records.title_en: Germany’s capacity to work from home
records.title_cn: 德国居家办公能力
records.abstract_en: We propose an index of working from home (WFH) capacity for the German economy, drawing on rich survey and administrative data. We find that 56 percent of jobs are WFH feasible, most of which are located in urban areas and in highly digitized industries. Using individual-level data on tasks and work conditions, we show that heterogeneity in WFH feasibility is largely explained by differences in task content. WFH feasible jobs are typically characterized by cognitive, non-manual tasks, and PC usage. We compare our survey-based measure with popular task-based measures of WFH capacity, which usually rely on determining tasks that are incompatible with WFH, and show that task-based approaches capture variation in WFH capacity across occupations fairly accurately. A simple measure of PC use intensity will generally constitute a suitable proxy for WFH capacity. Finally, we demonstrate that our WFH index is a strong predictor of actual WFH outcomes during the Covid-19 crisis and discuss applications in the context of the pandemic and the future of work.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用丰富的调查和行政数据，为德国经济提出一个居家办公（WFH）能力指数。我们发现56%的工作岗位适合居家办公，其中大部分位于城市地区和高数字化行业。利用关于任务和工作条件的个体层面数据，我们表明居家办公可行性的异质性在很大程度上由任务内容的差异所解释。适合居家办公的工作通常具有认知性、非体力任务和电脑使用的特点。我们将基于调查的度量与流行的基于任务的居家办公能力度量进行比较，后者通常依赖于确定与居家办公不相容的任务，并表明基于任务的方法能够相当准确地捕捉各职业居家办公能力的差异。一个简单的电脑使用强度度量通常可以作为居家办公能力的合适代理指标。最后，我们证明我们的居家办公指数是新冠19危机期间实际居家办公结果的强预测因子，并讨论了在疫情和未来工作背景下的应用。

records.title_en: News shocks to investment-specific technology in business cycles
records.title_cn: 商业周期中投资专用技术的新闻冲击
records.abstract_en: Recent research in DSGE and VAR models has indicated that the most important drivers of business cycles are IST shocks, not traditional TFP and other shocks. Research in VAR models has also empirically identified IST news shocks as a significant driving force behind the U.S. business cycle. However, recent New-Keynesian DSGE models have found that IST news shocks do not produce comovement of aggregate variables, with the share of the forecast error variance explained by IST news shocks being very small in a flexible-price model and essentially zero in a sticky-price model. This paper uses the Bayesian methods to estimate the parameters and shock processes to study the business cycle effects of IST news shocks in a two-sector sticky-price DSGE model with consumer durables and collateral constraints. Our variance decompositions indicate that IST news shocks are a more relevant source of uncertainty than IST non-news and other shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 近期DSGE和VAR模型的研究表明，商业周期最重要的驱动因素是IST冲击，而非传统的TFP和其他冲击。VAR模型的研究也实证识别出IST新闻冲击是美国商业周期的重要驱动力。然而，近期的新凯恩斯DSGE模型发现，IST新闻冲击不能产生总量变量的共同运动，在弹性价格模型中，IST新闻冲击解释的预测误差方差份额非常小，在粘性价格模型中基本为零。本文使用贝叶斯方法估计参数和冲击过程，研究在包含耐用消费品和抵押品约束的两部门粘性价格DSGE模型中IST新闻冲击的商业周期效应。我们的方差分解表明，IST新闻冲击比IST非新闻冲击和其他冲击是更相关的不确定性来源。

records.title_en: Saving constraints, inequality, and the credit market response to fiscal stimulus
records.title_cn: 储蓄约束、不平等与财政刺激的信贷市场反应
records.abstract_en: We document substantial heterogeneity in the interest rate response to fiscal stimulus (IRRF) across OECD economies. The IRRF is negative in half of the OECD countries, and it declines with income inequality. To interpret this evidence we develop a model in which moderately-low-income households take on debt to maintain a consumption threshold (effectively a saving constraint). Now burdened with debt, these households use additional income to deleverage. In more unequal economies with more saving-constrained households, increases in government spending tighten credit conditions less (relax credit conditions more), leading to smaller increases (larger declines) in the interest rate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了OECD经济体中财政刺激利率反应（IRRF）的显著异质性。IRRF在半数OECD国家为负，且随收入不平等程度下降而降低。为解释这一证据，我们构建了一个模型，其中中等偏低收入家庭为维持消费阈值（实际上是储蓄约束）而举债。这些家庭现在背负债务，利用额外收入去杠杆。在储蓄约束家庭更多的不平等经济体中，政府支出增加对信贷条件的收紧程度较小（放松程度较大），导致利率上升幅度较小（下降幅度较大）。

records.title_en: Leadership under the shadow of the future: Intelligence and strategy choice in infinitely repeated games
records.title_cn: 未来阴影下的领导力：无限重复博弈中的智力与策略选择
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of intelligence on decision making in an infinitely repeated sequential public goods game. Using a two-part experiment, we collect data on subjects’ intelligence and a wide range of preference characteristics, and match these to their full contingent strategy profiles. We find that leaders are less likely to play a free-riding strategy as their intelligence increases. Followers are less likely to play a grim-trigger strategy as intelligence increases. Performing simulations using players’ strategies, we find that groups contribute more and are more profitable as intelligence increases. Our results have implications for the design of policies promoting group success.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了智力对无限重复序贯公共品博弈中决策的影响。通过一个两部分实验，我们收集了受试者智力及广泛偏好特征的数据，并将其与他们的完整条件策略概况相匹配。我们发现，随着智力的提高，领导者更不可能采取搭便车策略。随着智力的提高，追随者更不可能采取冷酷触发策略。利用参与者的策略进行模拟，我们发现随着智力的提高，群体贡献更多且更有利可图。我们的结果对促进群体成功的政策设计具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Gender-based price discrimination in the annuity market: Evidence from Chile
records.title_cn: 年金市场中的性别价格歧视：来自智利的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper provides the first evidence for discriminatory behaviour against female consumers in the annuity market. It focuses on Chile, where an electronic bidding system allows retirees to receive offers, simultaneously from several firms in the market for the same standardised annuity product. By exploiting within-individual variation in initial offers across firms, this analysis shows that firms with market power offer more unfairly priced annuities to women than to men. This result is driven by highly rated firms. Gender differences in financial literacy can explain why firms find it profitable to offer higher prices to women.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了年金市场中针对女性消费者歧视行为的首个证据。研究聚焦于智利，该国采用电子竞价系统，使退休人员能够同时从市场中的多家公司收到针对同一标准化年金产品的报价。通过利用个体内部不同公司初始报价的差异，本分析表明，拥有市场势力的公司向女性提供的年金定价比男性更不公平。这一结果由高评级公司驱动。金融素养的性别差异可以解释为何公司发现向女性提供更高价格是有利可图的。

records.title_en: Sources of Economic Policy Uncertainty in the euro area
records.title_cn: 欧元区经济政策不确定性的来源
records.abstract_en: We create economic policy uncertainty (EPU) indicators for the four largest euro area countries by applying two unsupervised machine learning algorithms to news articles. The procedure allows to uncover components of EPU endogenously for the four European languages. The uncertainty indices computed from January 2000 to May 2019 capture episodes of regulatory change, trade tensions and financial stress. In an evaluation exercise, we use a structural vector autoregression model to study the effects of uncertainty on investment and on private consumption. We document considerable effects for the political and domestic regulation uncertainty components on investment, while the other types show heterogeneous effects across countries. For instance, trade uncertainty influences Germany’s investment more than its counterparts. Moreover, we observe strong negative effects of uncertainty on consumption for countries such as Italy (political) and Spain (fiscal, political and domestic regulation).
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过将两种无监督机器学习算法应用于新闻文章，为欧元区四个最大的国家创建了经济政策不确定性（EPU）指标。该程序允许内生地揭示四种欧洲语言中EPU的组成部分。从2000年一月到2019年五月计算的不确定性指数捕捉了监管变化、贸易紧张和金融压力的时期。在评估练习中，我们使用结构向量自回归模型来研究不确定性对投资和私人消费的影响。我们记录了政治和国内监管不确定性成分对投资的显著影响，而其他类型在不同国家表现出异质性效应。例如，贸易不确定性对德国投资的影响大于其对应国家。此外，我们观察到不确定性对消费的强烈负面影响，例如意大利（政治）和西班牙（财政、政治和国内监管）。

records.title_en: Gains from monetary policy cooperation under asymmetric currency pricing
records.title_cn: 非对称货币定价下货币政策合作的收益
records.abstract_en: In most international trade transactions, the U.S. dollar is used. Hence, this study considers optimal monetary policy in a two-country model under asymmetric currency pricing (ACP) in which U.S. (Home) firms use producer currency pricing (PCP) while firms in the rest of the world (Foreign) use local currency pricing (LCP). In the ACP model, there is an additional inefficiency, namely, the internal relative price distortion compared with the LCP model and the distortion arising from deviations from the law of one price compared with the PCP model. Consequently, welfare gains from monetary policy cooperation in the ACP model are substantially greater compared with the LCP and PCP models. Moreover, the noncooperative Foreign policymakers in the ACP model can manipulate not only the internal relative price but also deviations from the law of one price in favor of their own welfare through nominal exchange rate adjustment, whereas the noncooperative Home policymakers can control neither. This result rationalizes the fact that the U.S. designates currency manipulators to protect its welfare. Therefore, gains from cooperation in Home are larger than in Foreign. Furthermore, I find that there are substantial gains from cooperation in the ACP model even under the conditions that remove gains from cooperation in the LCP and PCP models.
records.abstract_cn: 在国际贸易交易中，美元被广泛使用。因此，本研究考虑在非对称货币定价（ACP）的两国模型中的最优货币政策，其中美国（本国）企业采用生产者货币定价（PCP），而世界其他地区（外国）企业采用当地货币定价（LCP）。在ACP模型中，存在额外的低效率，即与LCP模型相比的内部相对价格扭曲，以及与PCP模型相比的一价定律偏离所产生的扭曲。因此，与LCP和PCP模型相比，ACP模型中货币政策合作的福利收益要大得多。此外，在ACP模型中，非合作的外国政策制定者不仅可以通过名义汇率调整操纵内部相对价格，还可以操纵一价定律的偏离以利于自身福利，而本国的非合作政策制定者则无法控制这两者。这一结果解释了美国指定汇率操纵国以保护其福利的事实。因此，本国合作的收益大于外国。此外，我发现即使在消除LCP和PCP模型中合作收益的条件下，ACP模型中仍存在可观的合作收益。

records.title_en: Climate, technology, family size; on the crossroad between two ultimate externalities
records.title_cn: 气候、技术、家庭规模；处于两个最终外部性之间的十字路口
records.abstract_en: We extend the Brock–Mirman model with endogenous growth through variety expansion, temperature rise affecting both the level and build up of TFP, human capital, and endogenous fertility. We derive closed-form solutions for capital investments, research, and the Social Cost of Carbon. Calibration of the fundamentals show that the social costs of carbon associated with reduced TFP growth are very large (median: 161 €/tCO2) compared to previous SCC estimates based on climate change TFP-level effects. We also compare the contribution of population growth to welfare through its effects on knowledge creation versus its effect on accelerated climate change. We find in most cases a net positive externality of children on average welfare for other dynasties (median: 22 k€/child).
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过品种扩张、影响全要素生产率水平和建设、人力资本和内生生育力的温度上升，扩展了布罗克-米尔曼模型的内生增长。我们为资本投资、研究和碳社会成本得出封闭式解决方案。基本面校准表明，与 SCC 之前基于气候变化 TFP 水平影响的估计相比，与 TFP 增长下降相关的碳社会成本非常大（中位数：161 €/tCO2）。我们还通过人口增长对知识创造的影响和对加速气候变化的影响来比较人口增长对福利的贡献。我们发现在大多数情况下，其他王朝的儿童平均福利具有净正外部性（中位数：22千欧元/儿童）。

records.title_en: Levelling the debt–equity playing field: Evidence from Belgium
records.title_cn: 平衡债务与股权的竞争环境：来自比利时的证据
records.abstract_en: I explore whether a Belgian policy that reduced the corporate tax bias towards debt finance was successful in lowering firm leverage. Using putatively exogenous time series variation in the cost of equity financing and a difference-in-differences strategy that includes similar firms from surrounding countries, I find that the policy did lead to increased equity ratios, with some evidence of a shift from short-term debt to long-term debt.
records.abstract_cn: 我探讨了比利时一项减少企业税收偏向债务融资的政策是否成功降低了企业杠杆。利用股权融资成本中假定外生的时间序列变化，以及一个包含周边国家类似企业的双重差分策略，我发现该政策确实导致了股权比率的提高，并有一些证据表明从短期债务转向长期债务。

records.title_en: How residence permits affect the labor market attachment of foreign workers: Evidence from a migration lottery in Liechtenstein
records.title_cn: 居留许可如何影响外国工人的劳动力市场依附：来自列支敦士登移民抽签的证据
records.abstract_en: We analyze the impact of obtaining a residence permit on foreign workers’ labor market and residential attachment. To overcome the usually severe selection issues, we exploit a unique migration lottery that randomly assigns access to residence permits for (prospective and current) workers with an employment contract in Liechtenstein, which is situated centrally in Europe. Using an instrumental variable approach, our results show that lottery compliers raise their employment probability in Liechtenstein by on average 24 percentage points across outcome periods (2008 to 2018) as a result of receiving a permit. Relatedly, their activity level and employment duration in Liechtenstein increase by on average 20 percentage points and 1.15 years, respectively, over the outcome window. These substantial and statistically significant effects are predominantly driven by individuals not (yet) working in Liechtenstein prior to the lottery rather than by previous cross-border commuters, but even for the latter group (generally living relatively close to the border), important positive employment effects emerge in the longer run. Indeed, we find both the labor market and residential effects to be persistent even several years after the lottery with no sign of fading out. These results suggest that granting resident permits to foreign workers can be effective to foster labor supply, despite the alternative of commuting cross-border from adjacent regions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了获得居留许可对外国工人劳动力市场和居住依附的影响。为克服通常严重的选样问题，我们利用了一项独特的移民抽签，该抽签随机分配在列支敦士登（位于欧洲中部）持有雇佣合同的（潜在和现有）工人获得居留许可的机会。使用工具变量方法，我们的结果显示，抽签合规者因获得许可而在列支敦士登的就业概率在结果期间（2008年至2018年）平均提高24个百分点。相应地，他们在列支敦士登的活动水平和就业持续时间在结果窗口内平均分别增加20个百分点和1.15年。这些显著且统计上显著的效果主要由抽签前未（尚未）在列支敦士登工作的个体驱动，而非之前的跨境通勤者，但即使对于后者群体（通常居住地相对靠近边境），在长期内也出现了重要的积极就业效应。实际上，我们发现劳动力市场和居住效应在抽签后数年仍然持续，没有消退迹象。这些结果表明，尽管存在从邻近地区跨境通勤的替代选择，但向外国工人发放居留许可可以有效促进劳动力供给。

records.title_en: Indebted sellers, liquidity and mortgage standards
records.title_cn: 负债卖家、流动性与抵押贷款标准
records.abstract_en: The effects of households’ indebtedness on their house selling decisions, the implications of these decisions for default and the effects of policies intended to reduce the incentive to default are studied in a dynamic model with search in the housing market and defaultable long-term mortgages. In equilibrium, both sellers’ asking prices and time-to-sell increase with the relative size of their outstanding debt. For sellers in financial distress, this behavior results in a positive relationship between debt and their individual risk of default. Prices and time-to-sell determine both the liquidity of the housing market and the aggregate risk of default. As such they determine the extent of profitable lending by competitive lenders. Calibrated to the U.S. economy, the model also generates, as observed, positive correlations (i) across sellers of asking prices with loan-to-value ratios, and (ii) over time of both house prices and time-to-sell with mortgage loan-to-value ratios at mortgage origination. Policies aimed at reducing default may be counterproductive if they raise the value of mortgages and thus lower lending standards, ultimately increasing the rate of default and reducing aggregate welfare. We consider also the implications of these policies for the effects of aggregate shocks on house prices and the rate and severity of mortgage default.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个具有住房市场搜索和可违约长期抵押贷款的动态模型中，研究了家庭负债对其房屋出售决策的影响、这些决策对违约的启示，以及旨在减少违约激励的政策效果。在均衡状态下，卖家的要价和售出时间均随其未偿债务的相对规模增加而增加。对于陷入财务困境的卖家，这种行为导致债务与其个人违约风险之间存在正相关关系。价格和售出时间决定了住房市场的流动性和总体违约风险，因此也决定了竞争性贷款机构可盈利贷款的程度。以美国经济为校准对象，该模型还如观察所示，产生了以下正相关关系：（i）不同卖家的要价与贷款价值比之间，（ii）房价和售出时间随时间与抵押贷款发放时的贷款价值比之间。旨在减少违约的政策如果提高了抵押贷款的价值从而降低了贷款标准，最终可能增加违约率并降低总体福利，从而适得其反。我们还考虑了这些政策对总冲击影响房价以及抵押贷款违约率和严重程度的影响。

records.title_en: Free riding in networks
records.title_cn: 网络中的搭便车行为
records.abstract_en: Players allocate their budgets to links, a local public good, and a private good. A player links in order to free ride on public good provided by others. We derive sufficient conditions for the existence of a Nash equilibrium, in which large contributors link to each other, while others link to them. If linking costs are sufficiently high, poorer players may contribute more and have more central positions in the network than richer ones do. In large societies, free riding reduces inequality only in networks in which it is initially low. Otherwise, richer players free ride more, as they can afford more links. Finally, we derive the policy implications for income redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 参与者将预算分配给链接（一种地方公共品）和私人品。参与者建立链接是为了搭他人提供的公共品的便车。我们推导出纳什均衡存在的充分条件，在该均衡中，大贡献者相互链接，而其他人则链接到他们。如果链接成本足够高，较贫穷的参与者可能比较富有的参与者贡献更多，并在网络中占据更中心的地位。在大型社会中，搭便车行为仅在初始不平等程度较低的网络中减少不平等。否则，较富有的参与者搭便车更多，因为他们能负担更多的链接。最后，我们推导出收入再分配的政策含义。

records.title_en: Firm behaviour under negative deposit rates
records.title_cn: 负存款利率下的企业行为
records.abstract_en: Using rich microdata from Denmark, the first country in the world to move its key monetary-policy rate below zero, we find that firms which become exposed to negative interest rates on their bank deposits increase their fixed investments and employment to a larger extent than what can be explained by the associated reduction in the level of interest rates. They also tend to rebalance their liquid portfolio, reduce their degree of leverage and become more inclined to change bank connections. Our results also indicate that it is the event of becoming exposed to negative rates (the extensive margin), not the share of deposits exposed to negative interest rates (the intensive margin), that matters for firm behaviour. These findings support the existence of a corporate channel of monetary transmission when bank deposit rates cross zero and become negative.
records.abstract_cn: 利用丹麦（世界上第一个将关键货币政策利率降至负值的国家）的丰富微观数据，我们发现，那些银行定期存款面临负利率的企业，其固定投资和就业的增加幅度超过了利率水平下降所能解释的范围。它们还倾向于重新平衡其流动性资产组合，降低杠杆率，并更倾向于更换银行关系。我们的结果还表明，是企业面临负利率的事件（广延边际），而非面临负利率的存款比例（集约边际），对企业行为产生影响。这些发现支持了当银行存款利率降至零以下时，存在企业渠道的货币传导机制。

records.title_en: A marriage-market perspective on risk-taking and career choices
records.title_cn: 婚姻市场视角下的风险承担与职业选择
records.abstract_en: We document that women are less likely than men to be in “risky” occupations, i.e., those that exhibit large within-occupation wage dispersion. We first demonstrate that a new theoretical channel—the competitive structure of the marriage market—may incentivize both men and women to choose riskier careers with lower wage returns. We then show that a unifying factor—women’s relative inability to reap the benefits of a risky career due to their shorter reproductive span and consequent career-family trade-off—can help rationalize a set of gender differences in labor-market and marriage-market outcomes. Using data from the United States, we provide empirical evidence that supports the model predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了女性比男性更不可能从事“高风险”职业，即那些职业内工资离散度较大的职业。我们首先证明了一个新的理论渠道——婚姻市场的竞争结构——可能激励男性和女性选择工资回报较低但风险更高的职业。然后我们表明，一个统一的因素——女性由于生育期较短及随之而来的职业与家庭权衡，相对无法从高风险职业中获益——有助于合理化劳动力市场和婚姻市场结果中的一系列性别差异。利用美国的数据，我们提供了支持模型预测的经验证据。

records.title_en: Taxation, social welfare, and labor market frictions
records.title_cn: 税收、社会福利与劳动力市场摩擦
records.abstract_en: Taking taxation inefficiencies as given, a well-known public finance result is that in partial equilibrium the elasticity of taxable income (ETI) is a sufficient statistic for the deadweight loss (DWL) from labor income taxation. We revisit this result using a general equilibrium macroeconomic framework with labor search frictions. Our theory parses out the extent to which search frictions in and of themselves can distort the DWL-ETI relationship. Numerical analysis suggests that DWL is nearly 10 percent above the ETI given search frictions, only. Accounting for externalities can drive this figure up to about 20 percent, and accounting unemployment benefits can increase this number up to nearly 40 percent. Parsing out these effects both analytically and quantitatively yields novel results that contribute jointly to the public finance and macroeconomic literatures.
records.abstract_cn: 在税收无效率既定的情况下，一个著名的公共财政结果是，在局部均衡中，应税收入弹性（ETI）是劳动所得税无谓损失（DWL）的充分统计量。我们使用具有劳动力搜索摩擦的一般均衡宏观经济框架重新审视这一结果。我们的理论解析了搜索摩擦本身在多大程度上可以扭曲DWL-ETI关系。数值分析表明，仅考虑搜索摩擦时，DWL比ETI高出近10%。考虑外部性可将这一数字推高至约20%，而考虑失业救济金可将这一数字增加至近40%。从分析和数量上解析这些效应，产生了新颖的结果，共同为公共财政和宏观经济文献做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Average inflation targeting and the interest rate lower bound
records.title_cn: 平均通胀目标制与利率下限
records.abstract_en: Under conventional inflation targeting (IT), the lower bound on nominal interest rates gives rise to a systematic downward bias in inflation that substantially reduces welfare. Using two variants of a New Keynesian model, we investigate whether a monetary policy strategy that aims to stabilize an average inflation rate—rather than a period-by-period inflation rate—leads to better outcomes. With rational expectations, price level targeting (PLT)—the limiting case of average inflation targeting (AIT)—is optimal, yet AIT with sufficient history dependence reaps most of the benefits of PLT. With boundedly rational expectations, PLT is no longer optimal unless the degree of bounded rationality is small. When deviations from rational expectations are sufficiently large, outcomes can be worse under PLT or AIT with strong history dependence than under IT. Finally, for both variants of the model, inflation conservatism improves welfare by eliminating the deflationary bias without invoking history dependence.
records.abstract_cn: 在传统通胀目标制（IT）下，名义利率的下限会导致通胀出现系统性下行偏差，从而大幅降低福利。我们使用两种新凯恩斯主义模型的变体，研究旨在稳定平均通胀率（而非逐期通胀率）的货币政策策略是否能带来更好的结果。在理性预期下，价格水平目标制（PLT）——平均通胀目标制（AIT）的极限情形——是最优的，但具有足够历史依赖性的AIT能获得PLT的大部分好处。在有限理性预期下，除非有限理性程度较小，否则PLT不再是最优的。当偏离理性预期的程度足够大时，PLT或具有强历史依赖性的AIT下的结果可能比IT下更差。最后，对于模型的两种变体，通胀保守主义通过消除通缩偏差而不诉诸历史依赖性来改善福利。

records.title_en: Inside the white box: Unpacking the determinants of quality and vertical specialization
records.title_cn: 白盒内部：解开质量与垂直专业化的决定因素
records.abstract_en: This paper explores patterns of quality differentiation and specialization relying on model-level panel data of retail sales and prices of refrigerators across 23 countries in the European Union. Unlike customs data aggregated at the product category, typically used in the trade literature, model-level data allow us to test for the presence of nonhomotheticities by comparing market shares of identical models across different markets. We measure quality at the model level, account for varying willingness-to-pay for quality at different incomes, and link quality measures to objective model attributes. Using originally assembled data on the country of manufacture of each model, we study patterns of quality specialization by brands with plants in multiple countries. We find that firms locate the production of their higher-quality models in richer countries and argue that the home-market effect linked to nonhomothetic preferences is a key driver of such patterns of quality specialization.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用欧盟23个国家冰箱零售销售和价格的模型级面板数据，探讨质量差异化和专业化的模式。与贸易文献中通常使用的按产品类别汇总的海关数据不同，模型级数据使我们能够通过比较相同模型在不同市场的市场份额来检验非齐次性的存在。我们在模型层面衡量质量，考虑不同收入水平下对质量的不同支付意愿，并将质量度量与客观模型属性联系起来。利用原始收集的每个模型制造国的数据，我们研究了在多个国家设有工厂的品牌的质量专业化模式。我们发现，企业将其更高质量模型的生产布局在更富裕的国家，并认为与非齐次偏好相关的本土市场效应是这种质量专业化模式的关键驱动因素。

records.title_en: Resource booms and group punishment in a coupled social-ecological system
records.title_cn: 资源繁荣与耦合社会-生态系统中的群体惩罚
